jobDescription:
Job Title Business Analyst-Process

Job Description Summary

The (Senior) Business Analyst Process plays a critical role in enhancing the effectiveness and efficiency of sales ecosystem across the Asia Pacific (APAC) region as part of our Organic Growth Team (OGT).

This role focuses on analysing, designing and improving core business processes that underpin sales operations and strategic enablement. It combines structured process design with quantitative data analysis to identify inefficiencies, assess root causes, and quantify the business impact of improvement opportunities.

The (Senior) Business Analyst will work closely with stakeholders across the OGT, as well as with broader Sales Enablement stakeholders and business leaders. The role will focus on analysing processes and developing business cases which articulate the requirements and benefits of improving our processes. A close partnership will exist with the newly formed Automation Team, which enacts findings from the process stream into practical workflow automations that further strengthen scalability, accuracy and efficiency.

This role will look to understand and improve sales ecosystem processes such as our cross-sell program, PlusONE, or our inquiry management process across APAC with a focus on supporting standardization, efficiency, governance and the creation of scalable, repeatable delivery frameworks.

While the primary focus will be on the APAC region, this role may collaborate with other regions including Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA) and the Americas to ensure global consistency and share best practices.

Job Description

PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES

Provide 7 10 Principal Responsibilities

Business analyst responsibilities will include:

  • BDS Sales Enablement and ATR Sales Leadership to capture and maintain robust pipeline with healthy distribution of short-, medium- and long-term opportunities, including but not limited to qualification protocols for RFPs, profitability assessments, competitors'' client mapping

The Business analyst responsibilities will include:

  • Process Mapping Analysis: Document, analyse and optimize business processes across Sales Pursuits workflows, identifying inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement.
  • Quantitative Process Analysis: Use data from Salesforce, Power BI and other systems to analyse process performance, cycle times and throughput to uncover trends and performance bottlenecks
  • Business Case Development: Quantify improvement opportunities through cost-benefit analysis, ROI modelling and scenario analysis to support prioritization and decision-making
  • Process Standardisation: Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, templates and frameworks that promote consistent and scalable delivery
  • Automation Collaboration: Work closely with the Automation stream to translate process insights into executable workflow automations that reduce manual effort and increase consistency
  • Performance Measurement: Work with the broader OGT to build and maintain dashboards and KPIs to track process efficiency, throughput and business impact
  • Continuous Improvement: Conduct root cause analysis on recurring issues, lead discovery sessions and recommend structured improvement actions.
  • Knowledge Management: Maintain a centralized repository of process maps, governance documents and performance metrics to ensure transparency and repeatability

Additional responsibilities for Senior Analysts:

SQL Server 2016/2017/2019/2022 installation and configuration.
T-SQL scripting - queries, stored procedures, functions, triggers.
Backup and restore strategies - full, differential, transaction log, COPY ONLY.
High Availability:Always On Availability Groups, Failover Cluster Instances (FCI).
Database monitoring using DMVs, SQL Server Profiler, and Extended Events.
Windows Server administration basics - services, event logs, disk/storage management.
Azure IaaS fundamentals - SQL Server on Azure VM, Azure Portal navigation.
Familiarity with Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance.
Experience with ITSM tools - ServiceNow ticket management.
Basic PowerShell scripting for automation of DBA tasks.

Azure PaaS:Administer Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance - elastic pools, service tiers, DTU/vCore sizing.
Configure and monitor Azure Database for SQL MI - failover groups, auto-failover, read replicas.
Manage Azure Storage accounts for database backups - LRS/GRS/ZRS replication, lifecycle policies, soft delete.
Use Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Azure Advisor for performance and health insights.
Implement Azure Private Endpoints and VNet service endpoints for secure database connectivity.
Manage Azure Key Vault integration for TDE keys, column encryption, and Always Encrypted.
Configure Azure Backup for SQL on IaaS VMs and Azure SQL Managed Instance backup policies.
Work with Azure NSGs, firewalls, and network topology to ensure secure DB access.
Participate in lift-and-shift and cloud migration projects - assessment, sizing, and post-migration validation.
Certifications (Preferred)
Microsoft Certified:Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) - preferred.
Microsoft SQL Server certifications (DP-300 associate level) - preferred.
ITIL Foundation - preferred.

Good verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work in rotational shifts including weekends and on-call.
Team player with a willingness to learn and adapt.
Attention to detail and methodical approach to problem solving.

ABOUT PRAYOGA
Prayoga is a not-for-profit organisation pursuing education and scientific research. Through programmes such as Kriya,
Anveshana, Prerana, Krd, Dhtu and Yuga, Prayoga works to make experiential, research-driven learning accessible
to every Indian child reaching thousands of students and schools across Karnataka.
ROLE SUMMARY
Prayoga is looking for a competent, detail-oriented Manager / Senior Analyst to lead the Project Management Office.
This role goes beyond reporting it is the operational backbone that connects programmes, departments, and
leadership through clear guidelines, reliable data, sound governance, and disciplined use of the organisation's ERP
system. The ideal candidate brings strong operations and project management experience, is fluent working with data
and systems end-to-end, and can drive process and financial discipline across a growing, multi-programme non-profit.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Operational Guidelines & Policies
Design, document, and maintain operational guidelines, SOPs, and policies for the PMO and across the
organisation.
Develop KRAs and KPIs at the project, department, and organisation level.
Establish review cadences and templates (project charters, status reports, dashboards) that standardise how work is
planned and tracked.
¢ Periodically review and update policies to reflect organisational growth, new programmes, and lessons learned.
Data Aggregation, Governance & Analysis
¢ Aggregate data from across programmes, departments, and field teams into a single, reliable source of truth,
primarily through the organisation's ERP.
¢ Define common data standards, definitions, and taxonomies so that information from different departments is
comparable and trustworthy.
¢ Analyse operational and programme data to assess effectiveness and efficiency, surfacing trends, gaps, and risks.
¢ Prepare regular MIS reports, dashboards, and briefing notes for the Executive Chairman and leadership team.
¢ Translate data findings into clear, actionable recommendations that inform decision-making and resource
allocation.
Budget & Resource Management
¢ Track project and departmental budgets against actuals within the ERP; flag variances early.
¢ Monitor utilisation of donor and grant funds to support timely, accurate compliance reporting.
Risk & Governance



¢ Maintain a risk register and escalation framework across projects; flag risks to leadership before they become
blockers.
¢ Run structured governance cadences (monthly/quarterly reviews) and prepare leadership- and board-ready
reporting packs.
¢ Support audit readiness by ensuring project documentation and approvals are complete and traceable.
Systems Ownership (ERP)
¢ Act as the PMO's power user/champion for the organisation's ERP system, particularly its project, budget, and
reporting modules.
¢ Configure ERP reports and dashboards to automate recurring MIS outputs, reducing manual data pulls.
¢ Partner with IT/ERP administrators to resolve data issues, extend ERP usage, and roll out new modules relevant to
PMO needs.
¢ Train programme and department teams on correct, consistent ERP usage to keep organisation-wide data clean at
the source.
Process Improvement & Change Management
¢ Identify inefficiencies in existing workflows and lead process redesign or improvement initiatives.
¢ Drive adoption of new processes, templates, and systems across teams through training and change management.
¢ Work closely with the Monitoring & Evaluation function to align PMO KPIs with programme impact metrics.
REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS
¢ Bachelor's degree required; MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification in operations, management, or a related
field preferred.
¢ 5 to 8+ years of experience in operations and project/programme management, ideally including exposure to a PMO
function.
¢ Demonstrated experience developing operational guidelines, SOPs, or policy frameworks, and setting
KRAs/KPIs.
¢ Strong experience working with data collecting, consolidating, and analysing information from multiple
sources to drive decisions.
¢ Hands-on experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle NetSuite, Zoho, Odoo, or similar) is strongly preferred,
including configuring reports/dashboards and training users; familiarity with standalone PM tools (Asana,
Monday, Notion, etc.) is a plus but secondary to ERP fluency.
¢ Working knowledge of budgeting, financial tracking, or grant/donor reporting is an advantage.
¢ Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to present data and recommendations clearly to
leadership.
KEY COMPETENCIES
¢ Operational rigour and process discipline
¢ Analytical thinking and data-driven decision-making
¢ Financial and budgetary discipline
¢ Systems fluency, especially ERP-based reporting and governance
¢ Project management and cross-functional coordination
¢ Change management and stakeholder influence
¢ Ownership, initiative, and follow-through
HOW TO APPLY
Interested candidates may send their resume and a brief cover note to info@prayoga.org.in with the subject line
Application PMO Manager/Senior Analyst.

About RARL

  • Ranjita Analytical and Research Laboratory (RARL) is one of India's largest integrated foods & water testing, and research facilities. RARL plans to expand its scope to beverages, fats, sugar, confectionery, and microbiological analysis.
  • The enormous growth in the Food & Agriculture sector in this era of rapid globalization does pose proportionate risks to consumers for food safety. To combat the threats, the Government of India has framed several stringent norms, which are covered under The Food Safety & Standards Acts of India (FSSA). India thus requires ultra-modern futuristic laboratories for the analysis of samples.

Job Description for the post of Senior Food Analyst


Introduction

As a food analyst working with Ranjita Analytical & Research Laboratory (RARL), one will need to be equipped with outstanding research and analytical skills along with exceptional technical and scientific expertise in the relevant field with excellent interpersonal and communication skills. He/She should have meticulous attention to detail. One should be logical in thinking with effective problem-solving skills, sound observational skills, and also have acceptable knowledge in the field of statistics. The selected candidate will be studying chemical analysis in food samples. He/She will be involved in testing food for safety and quality purposes.


What We Expect from You as a Senior Analyst:

  • Perform chemical analysis of all food parameters (For e.g., acid insoluble ash, moisture content, sucrose content, carbohydrates etc.) as per reference standards
  • Candidate must be familiar with the NABL audit experience for food samples
  • Perform Instrumentation analysis (Spectrophotometer, ICP-OES, GC, HPLC, Refractometer & FTIR). The candidate will be responsible for handling the instruments, their calibration and intermediate check
  • The candidate is expected to conduct the evaluation of the measurement uncertainty of various parameters in food samples
  • Candidate must have the ability to evaluate and interpret calibration or test results
  • The candidate must be able to perform standardization & re-standardization of various equipment
  • The candidate is expected to take responsibility for all food-related documentation in the lab (Raw data, logbook, SOPs, QSPs update)

Who Are We Looking For

  • Bachelor’s/master’s degree in chemistry/biotechnology/food technology
  • Minimum 3 years of laboratory experience in food & water NABL accredited laboratory
  • Experience participating in NABL Audit
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
  • Experience handling chemical laboratory equipment preferred
  • Experience in participating in PT, ILC & IQC programs.
  • Experience in providing training to laboratory personnel

title: Senior Statistical Programmer (SDTM)
jobDescription:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.   At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel:

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insight-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation, With Heart.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Senior Statistical Programmer to join our team in a remote capacity. As a Senior Statistical Programmer, you will provide technical expertise to support clinical trial analysis and reporting activities while serving as a key contributor to the delivery of high-quality statistical programming solutions. This role may act as a Statistical Programming Coordinator on projects, partnering closely with sponsors, Data Operations Leads, biostatisticians, and cross-functional teams to ensure timely, compliant, and effective study delivery.

You will support a broad range of programming activities related to clinical study data, including derived dataset programming, quality control, mapping specification development, import and export programming activities, and adherence to industry data standards. This position offers the opportunity to influence study outcomes, provide technical leadership, contribute to process improvements, and expand expertise across statistical programming and clinical development.

You’ll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on delivering quality, efficiency, and innovation in clinical research. With access to global teams, challenging projects, and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Statistical Programmer can further develop technical, leadership, and project delivery expertise while helping bring new therapies to patients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Demonstrated experience serving as an SDTM Lead on clinical research studies.
  • Experience in the development of SDTM Trial Design domains.
  • Proven ability to program and deliver complex SDTM datasets.
  • Experience coordinating study and project start-up activities.
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting and debugging macros of moderate complexity.
  • Strong understanding of efficacy endpoints and efficacy assessment methodologies, including RECIST and IMWG applications.
  • Experience reviewing Protocols and Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs) and providing feedback related to SDTM mapping strategies and implementation.
  • Solid foundational SAS programming skills.

You’ll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Strengths in SAS programming, clinical data standards, and technical problem solving.
  • Experience working in clinical research or another highly regulated environment.
  • The ability to collaborate across global teams and communicate clearly with internal and external stakeholders.
  • A quality-focused mindset, strong attention to detail, and commitment to regulatory compliance.
  • Comfort working with statistical programming processes, CDISC standards, import/export programming activities, and study reporting deliverables.

Required Qualifications

  • Degree in relevant discipline or equivalent work experience.
  • Relevant clinical trial industry experience.
  • Proficiency in SAS and strong knowledge of programming and reporting processes.
  • Knowledge of ICH-GCP, regulatory requirements, System Life Cycle methodologies, and industry technical standards including 21 CFR Part 11.
  • Experience supporting statistical programming activities related to clinical study analysis and reporting.
  • Excellent communication skills with competency in written and oral English.
  • Strong organizational skills, ability to manage competing priorities, and flexibility in a dynamic environment.
  • Demonstrated commitment to quality management, teamwork, and problem solving.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience serving as a Statistical Programming Coordinator or study lead on clinical research projects.
  • Familiarity with CDISC standards, mapping specification development, and regulatory submission requirements.
  • Experience developing standard macros, applications, or efficiency-enhancing programming solutions.
  • Experience providing technical training, mentoring, or guidance to team members.

title: Data Acquisition Lead
jobDescription:
Data Acquisition Lead What you will do
  • In this vital role, you will lead the acquisition, integration, and quality management of nonCRF (external/vendor) clinical trial data, ensuring it is timely, accurate, traceable, and fitforpurpose to support study delivery, analytics, database lock, inspections, and regulatory compliance.
  • Own the design, setup, and ongoing management of nonCRF data (e.g., central labs, imaging, wearables, precision medicine), ensuring seamless integration, traceability, and compliant ingestion into EDC and other clinical data systems.
  • Own, define, and maintain vendor data transfer specifications and agreements, aligned with protocol, study requirements, and downstream data needs; oversee test and production data transfers with suppliers.
  • Ensure timely, accurate, and compliant ingestion of external datasets, proactively reviewing incoming data for quality, completeness, and consistency; resolve formatting, mapping, and data quality issues in collaboration with vendors and study teams.
  • Lead reconciliation activities, initiating early and continuous reconciliation throughout the study lifecycle to prevent downstream delays and ensure ongoing data delivery and analysis readiness.

title: Senior Analyst, Data Management, IT
jobDescription:
Innovation starts from the heart. At Edwards Lifesciences, we are dedicated to developing ground-breaking technologies with a genuine impact on patients' lives. At the core of this commitment is our investment in cutting-edge information technology, enabling our global teams to collaborate, operate efficiently, and advance our patient-focused mission.


As part of our IT team, your expertise will help Edwards strengthen trusted, governed, and high-quality master data across the enterprise. We are seeking a Senior Analyst, Data Management to support critical master data domains, including Healthcare Professional and Supplier Master, while helping modernize Edwards' Master Data Management capabilities from Informatica IDMC MDM SaaS toward a multi-domain Semarchy MDM platform on Snowflake. This role combines data stewardship, governance, data quality, business analysis, and operational support with direct partnership across global and regional business teams.


How you will make an impact

  • Participate in the implementation and expansion of Semarchy MDM as a Snowflake-based, multi-domain enterprise Master Data Management platform.
  • Support the onboarding of new master data domains and contribute to migration planning, business validation, testing, and user adoption as domains transition from Informatica IDMC MDM SaaS to the future-state platform.
  • Partner with MDM leadership, architects, engineers, data stewards, application teams, and business stakeholders to define scalable master data processes, governance models, stewardship workflows, and platform requirements.
  • Support Healthcare Professional and Supplier Master domains operating on Informatica IDMC MDM SaaS, including application enhancements, release validation, testing, and production support.
  • Investigate and resolve master data issues, data quality exceptions, match and merge conflicts, hierarchy requests, workflow issues, and data synchronization problems across upstream and downstream applications.
  • Engage directly with regional business teams to understand business processes, data challenges, and master data requirements across multiple geographies and time zones.
  • Elicit, document, validate, and translate business requirements into scalable data management and MDM solutions that business and technical teams can execute.
  • Define, document, and maintain business rules, data standards, critical data elements, data definitions, stewardship procedures, and data quality controls.
  • Perform data profiling, analysis, root cause investigation, and remediation activities using SQL, Snowflake, and related data tools.
  • Develop and monitor data quality metrics, dashboards, and governance scorecards that improve data accuracy, consistency, completeness, and accountability.
  • Create and maintain process documentation, standard operating procedures, governance artifacts, test evidence, and user guidance.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve business processes, data quality, operational efficiency, and the user experience.

What you will need (Required)

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Management, Business, Engineering, or a related field and a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in master data management, data governance, data quality, business analysis, or enterprise data operations.
  • Practical experience supporting Master Data Management solutions, data stewardship processes, or governed enterprise data domains.
  • Experience eliciting, documenting, and validating business requirements and translating them into functional data or application requirements.
  • Experience with data profiling, root cause analysis, issue remediation, business rules, data standards, and data quality controls.
  • Working proficiency in SQL and experience analyzing data in Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate complex data issues across connected systems and processes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to facilitate discussions across business and technical teams.
  • Ability to work independently under general direction, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively across global time zones.
  • Adhere to all company rules and requirements, including Environmental Health & Safety rules, and take adequate control measures to prevent injuries, protect the environment, and prevent pollution under their span of influence or control.

What else we look for (Preferred)

  • Hands-on experience with Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud MDM SaaS, Semarchy MDM, or another enterprise multi-domain MDM platform.
  • Experience with Healthcare Professional, Supplier, Customer, Product, or other enterprise master data domains.
  • Experience supporting an MDM modernization or migration program, including business validation, testing, cutover readiness, and user adoption.
  • Experience with Snowflake-based data solutions and integrations among MDM, source applications, and downstream consumers.
  • Experience developing data quality dashboards, governance scorecards, stewardship workflows, or operating procedures.
  • Relevant industry experience in medical device, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, or another regulated environment.

Additional information

  • Develops solutions to a variety of complex data management problems and exercises judgment in selecting methods and techniques after considering business, data quality, governance, and technical implications.
  • Works with general direction focused on end results and may provide guidance to less-experienced team members or data stewards.
  • Travel may be required up to 5%.

jobDescription:
PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

The Senior Manager, Capital Projects and Facilities lead the planning, design, procurement, execution, and handover of all capital construction and renovation projects across the Academy - from initial brief through to commissioning and operation. The role carries end-to-end accountability for project scope, budget, schedule, quality, and regulatory approvals.


This includes responsibility for ensuring:

  • Capital projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality and safety standards, from initial brief through to handover and operation.
  • All capital works comply with Government, local authority, and municipality regulations, and with AKDN Green Buildings Guidelines and AKS standards.
  • Contractors, consultants, and vendors engaged on capital works perform to contract, on budget, and on schedule.
  • All buildings and facilities are safe, well maintained, and performing adequately.

The role also holds oversight responsibility for the Academy's facilities and soft services functions, which are managed day-to-day through the Facilities and Maintenance Manager and Assistant Admin Manager.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Capital Projects

  • Own the oversight and management of all phases of any capital construction project within Academy land - initial project brief development, design (concept, schematic, detailed), procurement, construction, commissioning, handover, and operation.
  • Develop the complete scope of work for each capital project, including technical specifications, drawings, and deliverables, in coordination with consultants and design teams.
  • Prepare Bills of Quantities (BOQ) for capital works, ensuring accurate measurement, specification, and pricing of materials and labour.
  • Prepare tender documents and packages for capital projects, including technical specifications, drawings, BOQ, conditions of contract, and evaluation criteria.
  • Manage the tendering process end-to-end - issuing tenders, responding to bidder queries, conducting technical and commercial evaluations, and recommending contractor award.
  • Lead contractor management for the full project duration: onboarding, contract administration, site supervision, progress monitoring, quality control, variation and claims management, and final account close-out.
  • Coordinate with local authorities to obtain construction and operational permissions and approvals.
  • Prepare project budgets, timelines, and scopes of work in coordination with the Head of Finance and Procurement.
  • Oversee the work of contractors, consultants, and vendors engaged on capital works; monitor contracts for compliance, quality, and cost control.
  • Form and lead taskforces for the rapid upgrading of facilities where required.
  • Ensure capital projects comply with Government, local authority, and municipality regulations, the AKDN Green Buildings Guidelines, and AKS standards.
  • Prepare and present project status, risk, and budget reports to the Head of Academy and Regional Head of Facilities.
  • Report on a regular basis to the Regional Head of Facilities on capital project pipeline, progress, budget performance, and key risks.
  • Prepare and monitor a multi-year repair and capital works plan based on evaluations and inspections of the facilities.

2. Facilities & Maintenance (Oversight)

  • Oversee the Facilities and Maintenance Manager, ensuring planned preventative maintenance, timely repairs, and a yearly maintenance program are in place for all facilities and systems (electrical, mechanical, sanitary).
  • Oversee the Assistant Admin Manager, ensuring catering, security, housekeeping, landscaping, pest control, and laundry services are fit for purpose and meet an appropriately high standard.
  • Prepare annual, medium, and long-term facilities planning budgets, in coordination with the Academy Head of Finance, and track costs against approved budgets.
  • Ensure daily facilities operations comply with Government, local authority, and municipality policy, regulations, best practices, and AKS standards.
  • Supervise facilities personnel, including recommendations for recruitment, performance evaluation, training, and problem resolution.
  • Review monthly operational and financial reports from the Facilities and Maintenance Manager and Assistant Admin Manager and consolidate these into reporting to the Head of Academy and Regional Head of Facilities
  • Conduct or commission annual facilities condition audits and ensure recommendations feed into the capital projects pipeline.
  • Perform miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.

3. General Responsibilities

  • The Senior Manager, Capital Projects and Facilities will form part of the Academy Extended Senior Leadership Team.
  • Develop, and work in accordance with, all necessary Standard Operating Procedures for capital projects and facilities management.
  • Be aware of local law and municipality requirements, ensuring that the Academy is fully compliant at all times.
  • Perform the role of primary coordinator between the capital projects and facilities teams, Academy Management, and third-party service providers.
  • Provide leadership of the capital projects team and oversight of the facilities teams.
  • Identify key risks and corresponding mitigation measures across all capital projects and facilities to minimize operational downtime and protect the value and life span of Academy assets.
  • Prepare funding requests for submission on a monthly basis.
  • Review, prepare, and approve invoices from third-party service providers and certify for payment.
  • Ensure all project and operational documentation is properly stored and filed, complying with the Document Management System (DMS).
  • Provide technical input in any third-party contract discussions.
  • Ensure that the interests of the Academy are protected at all times.
  • Demonstrate and champion the highest ethical, professional, and technical standards in all dealings with faculty, admin staff, student residences and dorm parents, suppliers, service providers, and the entire team.
  • Perform other responsibilities related to capital projects and facilities management as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Degree in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or Structural Engineering. Or Diploma in Project Management or Facilities Management, or a Degree with 10 years' experience in Project management.
  • Member of a relevant professional body (optional).

EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum 15 years' experience initiating and managing capital construction projects as an end user, including design, procurement, and contractor management.
  • Clear understanding of local legislation and processes for gaining necessary approvals and permits for minor and major capital projects.
  • Experience in multi-location Project management, preferably in educational facilities, gained alongside or in support of project delivery work.
  • Clear experience forming taskforces to deal with rapid upgrading of facilities.
  • Working understanding of legislation for the operation of buildings and facilities (sanitary, fire, environmental, electrical, health, safety, and welfare).

KNOWLEDGE AND COMPETENCIES

  • Strong project planning and delivery skills across the full capital project lifecycle - brief, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, handover.
  • Strong domain knowledge of construction methods, building materials, and mechanical/electrical/structural systems.
  • Skill in liaising with government bodies and local authorities to obtain necessary approvals and permits for capital projects.
  • Knowledge of accounting and budgeting practices, and ability to track project costs against approved budgets.
  • Working knowledge of Project management systems and software.
  • Ability to anticipate and resolve problems and advise management well in advance of decisions to be undertaken.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills in English.
  • Strong strategic focus and innovative, quick to adapt to change.
  • Skilled in team building, people management, and conflict resolution; skill in organizing resources and establishing priorities.
  • Credible, trustworthy, and high on integrity and ethical values.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to develop and maintain positive working relationships with diverse people, including contractors, consultants, third-party service providers, institutions, and the community at large.
  • Ability to develop and maintain recordkeeping and documentation systems for projects and facilities.
  • Ability to supervise, train, and mentor employees, including organizing, prioritizing, and scheduling work assignments.
  • Knowledge of emergency and disaster recovery planning.
  • Self-confidence, with the ability to write and present reports well.

jobDescription:
The Senior HR PMO AI Enablement Manager is accountable for translating the enterprise AI HR transformation strategy into remit-specific workforce approaches and for shaping, deploying, and enabling their adoption across Claims, Legal Compliance, and Global Operations. As Senior Manager, you will be a driver of AI-enabled initiatives, not just a project manager. You will draft playbooks, define KPIs, manage stakeholder alignment, and coordinate with the DPO, IT, and business units. You will serve as a strategic PMO and enablement hub, supporting HRs response to transformation by structuring thinking, connecting initiatives, and translating complexity into clear workforce narratives, decision frameworks, and coordinated HR actions. You will integrate inputs across AI use cases, workforce impact, Orion skills, organizational design, HR capability uplift, change enablement.

What youll be doing
What will your essential responsibilities include
HR AI Enablement
  • Structure and orchestrate people impact responses to AI transformation initiatives across Claims, Global Operations, and Legal Compliance.
  • Partner with business, AI, and transformation leaders to translate AI use cases into workforce implications (roles, skills, organization).
  • Work closely with the AI HR Taskforce (including HR Workforce Planning Transformation) to connect AI initiatives with workforce implications and HR activity into a coherent picture.
  • Shape and apply HR approaches based on taskforce outputs within the remit, ensuring consistency, scalability, and practical application.
    • Design and maintain practical HR frameworks to assess AI impact on work, roles, capacity, and skills; contribute to playbooks, templates, and governance materials.
    • KPI framework: develop concrete KPIs per use case and for the overall program (adoption rates, time-to-value, learning time, productivity impact, cross-functional collaboration).
Workforce Impact, Skills Organization Design
  • Contribute to the evolution of organizational design and job architecture
  • Structure options and scenarios to support informed decision-making as roles, skills, and work evolve.
  • Build capability through exposure to live cases and co-design of targeted evolutions; avoid end-to-end ownership to enable rapid learning and iteration.
Facilitation Capability Enablement
  • Design and facilitate HRBP and crossR sessions; lead business workshops on AI impact, humanAI collaboration, and role evolution.
  • Act as a connector across HRBPs, COEs, HR Transformation, and enterprise initiatives.
  • Equip HRBPs with practical playbooks, tools, and frameworks to support assured and composed engagement with leaders on AI use cases.
Change Management Adoption
  • Roll out a people-centric change approach for AI-driven transformation; embed change management early and align with ESS and global functions for sustained adoption.
Strategic PMO HR Orchestration Support
  • Provide strategic PMO and orchestration support to the Global HRBP across Legal, Claims, and Global Operations.
  • Orchestrate HR priorities, initiatives, and dependencies; maintain operating rhythms, governance forums, and milestones.
  • Support coordination of core HR processes, ensuring clear ownership, sequencing, and outcomes.
Stakeholder Management Governance
  • Act as an integrator across HRBPs, COEs, enterprise programs, and AI initiatives.
  • Anticipate risks and dependencies; surface them to senior HR leadership and ensure alignment of interconnected initiatives.
You will report to the Global Head of HR.


What youll bring
Were looking for someone who has these abilities and skills:
Experience Profile
  • Extensive, progressive experience in HR consulting, transformation, organizational change enablement roles in complex, matrixed environments.
  • Relevant advanced degree or certifications in change management, or AI-enabled transformations preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience structuring and orchestrating cross-functional initiatives (transformation programs, HR operating rhythms, governance, workshops, adoption).
  • Experience translating complex topics into practical frameworks, decision narratives, and executive-ready materials for senior stakeholders.
  • Curiosity and working knowledge of AI capabilities, limitations, and organizational implications.
Skills
  • Preferred: AI and process/flow thinking experience, ideally from a consulting or tech-forward background. Ability to design frameworks, drive adoption, measure impact, and upskill HR colleagues.
  • Cross-functional collaboration and facilitation to connect HRBPs, COEs, task forces, and business stakeholders into a coherent approach.
  • Authentic and impactful communication to craft clear workforce narratives, influence alignment, and communicate with credibility.
  • Agility, curiosity, innovation, and growth mindset to operate effectively in evolving AI and transformation contexts.
  • Performance excellence and resilience to deliver against deadlines and maintain quality under pressure.
  • Project Management to structure workplans, dependencies, milestones, and governance.
  • Change Management to support adoption and sustained behavior change across the remit.
  • Data-driven decision making and digital literacy to use insights, tools, and evidence in decisions.
  • Risk management and ethical judgment to navigate people risk, sensitive topics, and governance in a regulated environment.
  • Relationship management to build trusted collaboration and influence without formal authority.
  • Ability to operate autonomously in a highly matrixed environment, navigating complexity and ambiguity.

title: Senior Manager-Costing & Internal Audit
jobDescription:
Job Description Senior Manager -Costing & Internal Audit
Position: Senior Manager - Costing & Internal Audit
Experience: 10 to 15 Years
Industry Preference: Healthcare / Hospital
Qualification: CA / ICWA (CMA)
Location: Faridabad
Reporting To: CFO


Job Summary


We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager :Costing & Internal Audit to lead costing, financial analysis, internal audit, and process control activities across the hospital. The person will be responsible for identifying cost-saving opportunities, improving financial controls, monitoring operational efficiency, and ensuring compliance with internal policies.


Candidates with strong experience in the hospital/healthcare industry will be preferred.


Key Responsibilities
Costing & Cost Control

  • Develop and maintain costing models for hospital services, procedures, departments, and specialties.
  • Analyse departmental and service-line costs and identify areas of cost improvement.
  • Monitor actual costs against budgets and identify major variances.
  • Prepare cost analysis for surgeries, procedures, diagnostics, pharmacy, OT, ICU and other clinical services.
  • Work closely with clinical and operational teams to improve cost efficiency.
  • Identify areas of leakage, wastage, and unnecessary expenditure.
  • Support management in pricing and profitability analysis for various hospital services.

Internal Audit

  • Lead the internal audit function across hospital operations and support functions.
  • Prepare annual internal audit plans based on business risks.
  • Conduct audits of revenue, billing, procurement, inventory, pharmacy, payroll, expenses, cash management and other key areas.
  • Review processes and identify control gaps, financial leakages and compliance issues.
  • Ensure timely closure of audit observations and follow-up on corrective actions.
  • Coordinate with external auditors and management whenever required.

MIS & Financial Analysis

  • Prepare regular MIS and management reports related to costing, profitability and operational performance.
  • Analyse revenue, margins, expenses and departmental performance.
  • Develop dashboards and reports to support management decision-making.
  • Provide management with actionable insights based on financial and operational data.

Process & Controls

  • Review existing SOPs and financial processes and suggest improvements.
  • Strengthen internal financial controls across hospital units.
  • Ensure proper authorization and documentation of financial transactions.
  • Identify process gaps and recommend corrective measures.
  • Support implementation of best practices across hospitals/business units.

Business Partnering

  • Work closely with Finance, Operations, Procurement, Clinical, Pharmacy, Diagnostics and other departments.
  • Provide financial inputs for new projects, services and expansion plans.
  • Support management in evaluating profitability and cost implications of business decisions.

Candidate Profile

  • 10 to 15 years of relevant experience in Costing, Internal Audit, Finance, MIS and Financial Analysis.
  • CA / ICWA (CMA) qualification is mandatory.
  • Experience in the hospital/healthcare industry is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of costing, internal controls, audit processes and financial analysis.
  • Experience in analysing hospital/service-line profitability will be an added advantage.
  • Strong Excel and MIS skills; experience with ERP/HIS systems preferred.
  • Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

Key Competencies

  • Costing & Cost Control
  • Internal Audit
  • Financial Analysis
  • Budgeting & Variance Analysis
  • MIS & Reporting
  • Process Improvement
  • Internal Controls
  • Risk Management
  • Healthcare Finance
  • Stakeholder Management

Preferred Industry Experience
Hospitals / Healthcare / Healthcare Chains will be strongly preferred.

title: Senior Content Marketing Manager
tagsAndSkills: Content Writing,Video Scripting,Team Handling,Creative Writing,Content Marketing,Copy Writing,Content Strategy,Creative
jobDescription:
Senior Manager Content Marketing

Experience: 8–10 years

Location: Bangalore

Reports to: Head - Product Marketing

Team: Manages a team of content writers/executives


Role Summary

We are looking for a Senior Manager – Content Marketing to own content across paid and organic channels —

from high-performing social media ad copy to SEO-driven long-form content and social storytelling. This role

sits at the intersection of brand, performance marketing, and SEO, and requires someone who can write for both

algorithms and audiences, while managing a small team and collaborating across design, performance marketing,

and product teams.

Key Responsibilities

Content Strategy & Execution

  • Write high-quality video scripts for ad creatives, reels/shorts, and organic social video — structuring

narratives around strong hooks, pacing, visual direction and clear CTAs suited to each platform (Meta,

YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram)

  • Draft high-conversion ad copy for social media campaigns (Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube) in close

coordination with the performance marketing team

  • Write and oversee SEO-optimized long-form content (blogs, landing pages, program pages) aligned to

keyword and search-intent strategy

  • Drive organic social content — copy, captions, and content ideas that build brand engagement and

community


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with performance marketing to translate campaign briefs into ad copy variations for A/B testing,

using performance data (CTR, CPC, engagement) to iterate

  • Work with the design team to brief and review creative assets, ensuring copy-visual alignment
  • Coordinate with SEO/growth teams on keyword strategy and content structuring
  • Liaise with product and sales teams to ensure content accurately reflects program offerings and

messaging

Team & Quality Ownership

  • Manage and mentor a team of content writers/executives, setting clear briefs, reviewing output, and

maintaining quality/brand consistency

  • Establish and maintain content guidelines, tone-of-voice standards, and QC processes
  • Own content-related KPIs — organic traffic, engagement rates, leads/conversions sourced via content, ad

creative performance

Analytics & Optimization

  • Track content and campaign performance using Tableau, Google Analytics, and social analytics

dashboards

  • Use data to continuously refine messaging, headlines, and content formats

Requirements

  • 8–10 years of experience in content marketing, with exposure to both organic (SEO, social) and paid (ad

copy) content

  • Proven experience managing or mentoring a content marketing team
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating range — performance-driven ad copy, SEO content, and organic social

writing

  • Strong experience writing video scripts for short-form (reels/shorts) and ad creative — including

hook-writing for the first 3 seconds, scene/shot-level scripting, pacing for retention, and writing for

voiceover vs. on-screen text

  • Ability to collaborate with video editors/production teams to translate scripts into final cuts, and iterate

scripts based on watch-time/drop-off data

  • Working knowledge of SEO tools (SEMrush, Google Search Console)
  • Comfort working with performance marketing data (CTR, CPC, engagement metrics) to inform content

decisions

  • Experience collaborating with design and performance marketing teams in a fast-paced,

multi-stakeholder environment

  • Excellent editorial judgment and brand-voice consistency across formats

Good to Have

  • Experience in edtech, small scale startups, or B2C brands
  • Familiarity with A/B testing frameworks for ad creative
  • Basic understanding of paid campaign structures (Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads)

  • Prepare client RA Bills, subcontractor bills and work-order bills.
  • Verify quantities from drawings, site measurements and execution records.
  • Handle measurement books (MB), joint measurements and billing documentation.
  • Prepare rate analysis, deviation statements and extra-item claims.

  • Coordinate with Project, Planning, Contracts, Procurement and Accounts teams.

  • Prepare comparative statements and material/labour/equipment costing.

  • Ensure timely submission and certification of client bills.

  • Support management in commercial negotiations and cost-control decisions.

Required Skills

  • Excellent knowledge of BOQ, Rate Analysis, Billing and Quantity Surveying.
  • Experience in RA Bills, MB, Client Billing and Subcontractor Billing.

  • Strong analytical and numerical skills.

Preferred Experience

Key Performance Areas

  • Cost estimation accuracy.
  • Effective cost control and budget monitoring.

jobDescription:
Role & responsibilities

Particulars


Details

Designation / Position


Sr. Manager / DGM Maintenance

Department


Engineering & Maintenance

Job Location


Patancheru Hyderabad, Telangana

Industry


Chemical Manufacturing / Pharma

Experience


1520 Years

Qualification


B.E./B.Tech. in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering

Reporting To


Plant Head / Unit Head

Position Summary

The Sr. Manager / DGM – Maintenance will be responsible for leading the Engineering & Maintenance function of the chemical/pharmaceutical manufacturing plant. The role involves ensuring high equipment reliability and plant availability through effective preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance, while maintaining strict compliance with safety, quality, environmental and statutory requirements.

The position will lead the maintenance team, manage plant utilities and critical equipment, drive continuous improvement initiatives, support new projects, control maintenance costs and ensure uninterrupted production through efficient planning, execution and monitoring of maintenance activities.

Key Responsibilities

1. Plant Maintenance & Equipment Reliability

  • Lead and oversee all maintenance activities for the manufacturing plant, utilities and associated infrastructure.
  • Ensure maximum availability, reliability and efficiency of production equipment and utility systems.
  • Plan, schedule and execute preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance activities.
  • Minimize equipment breakdowns, downtime and production losses through effective maintenance strategies.
  • Monitor equipment performance and implement corrective and preventive actions.
  • Maintain equipment history cards, maintenance records and relevant technical documentation.
  • Develop and implement equipment reliability improvement programs.
  • Ensure proper maintenance practices with minimum wastage, equipment damage and maintenance-related losses.

2. Mechanical Maintenance

Hands-on knowledge and experience in maintenance of:

  • Reactors and process equipment
  • Centrifugal and positive displacement pumps
  • Gearboxes and agitators
  • Compressors and associated systems
  • Pipelines, valves and fittings
  • Heat exchangers
  • Insulation systems
  • Storage tanks and other process equipment
  • Mechanical utility systems

3. Electrical & Instrumentation

  • Oversee electrical maintenance activities across the plant.
  • Ensure electrical systems, motors, MCCs, panels, transformers and associated equipment are maintained effectively.
  • Drive electrical safety standards and improvement initiatives.
  • Coordinate instrumentation maintenance and troubleshooting activities.
  • Ensure calibration and maintenance of measuring and testing instruments.
  • Support troubleshooting of electrical and instrumentation-related breakdowns.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable electrical safety requirements.

4. Utilities Management

Manage maintenance and operational reliability of major plant utility systems, including:

  • Steam boilers and associated systems
  • Chilling plants
  • Air compressors
  • Cooling towers
  • DM/MB water treatment plants
  • HVAC systems, where applicable
  • Utility pipelines and distribution systems
  • Other critical plant utility equipment

Ensure reliable and cost-effective operation of utilities to support uninterrupted production.

5. Preventive & Predictive Maintenance

  • Develop and implement annual/monthly preventive maintenance plans.
  • Establish equipment-wise maintenance schedules and checklists.
  • Implement condition monitoring techniques for critical equipment.
  • Analyze recurring breakdowns and identify root causes.
  • Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for major equipment failures.
  • Implement corrective and preventive actions and track their effectiveness.
  • Drive predictive maintenance and reliability improvement initiatives.

6. Projects, Erection & Commissioning

  • Provide engineering support for new projects and plant expansion activities.
  • Participate in equipment selection, specification and technical evaluation.
  • Coordinate erection, installation, commissioning and qualification of new equipment.
  • Ensure projects are completed safely, within budget and according to approved specifications.
  • Support internal development and process improvement projects.
  • Identify opportunities for plant modification, automation, energy conservation and equipment improvement.

7. Safety, Quality & Compliance

  • Ensure strict adherence to plant safety, health and environmental requirements.
  • Promote safe maintenance practices and permit-to-work systems.
  • Drive electrical and mechanical safety improvement initiatives.
  • Ensure maintenance activities comply with applicable statutory and regulatory requirements.
  • Liaise with statutory authorities and regulatory agencies as required.
  • Ensure timely renewal/maintenance of statutory approvals, licenses and certifications related to Engineering & Maintenance.
  • Support integrated ISO systems covering Quality, Environment and Occupational Health & Safety.
  • Ensure proper implementation of corrective and preventive actions arising from audits, inspections and incidents.

8. AMC, Contractors & Vendor Management

  • Identify, evaluate and finalize competent agencies/vendors for AMC and specialized maintenance services.
  • Manage annual maintenance contracts for critical equipment.
  • Evaluate and approve mechanical, electrical, instrumentation and civil contractors.
  • Monitor contractor performance, quality, safety and adherence to schedules.
  • Ensure contractors comply with plant safety and work procedures.

9. Maintenance Planning, Budgeting & Cost Control

  • Prepare annual maintenance budgets covering spares, manpower, services, equipment and projects.
  • Control maintenance costs without compromising equipment reliability or safety.
  • Plan and maintain adequate inventory of critical spares.
  • Ensure timely procurement of required spare parts, equipment and consumables.
  • Identify opportunities for cost reduction and energy savings.
  • Monitor maintenance KPIs and departmental performance.

10. Team Leadership & People Development

  • Lead, supervise and motivate the Engineering & Maintenance team.
  • Plan manpower deployment and maintenance resources effectively.
  • Establish clear roles, responsibilities and performance expectations.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews and provide technical guidance.
  • Identify training requirements and arrange technical, safety and behavioral training.
  • Develop a competent and multi-skilled maintenance team.
  • Promote teamwork, accountability, discipline and continuous improvement.

11. Continuous Improvement

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives in maintenance, reliability, safety and energy efficiency.
  • Identify opportunities for reducing breakdowns, maintenance costs and energy consumption.
  • Implement improvement projects using appropriate problem-solving methodologies.
  • Encourage innovative ideas for equipment and process improvements.
  • Establish best maintenance practices and standard operating procedures.

12. Documentation & Maintenance Systems

  • Ensure proper maintenance documentation and records.
  • Maintain equipment history, preventive maintenance records and breakdown reports.
  • Ensure timely updating of maintenance databases/CMMS or other maintenance management systems.
  • Monitor maintenance KPIs such as:
    • Equipment availability
    • Breakdown frequency
    • MTBF
    • MTTR
    • Preventive maintenance compliance
    • Maintenance cost
    • Utility consumption
    • Critical equipment reliability

Key Technical Competencies

The ideal candidate should have strong practical knowledge of:

  • Chemical/pharmaceutical plant maintenance
  • Mechanical and electrical maintenance
  • Process equipment and reactors
  • Pumps, compressors and gearboxes
  • Piping and utility systems
  • Boilers and chilling plants
  • Cooling towers
  • DM/MB water treatment systems
  • Preventive and predictive maintenance
  • Condition monitoring
  • Root Cause Analysis
  • Electrical safety
  • Instrumentation and calibration
  • Erection and commissioning
  • Project execution
  • Maintenance planning and budgeting
  • AMC and contractor management
  • Statutory compliance
  • ISO Quality, Environment & Safety systems
  • Energy conservation and reliability improvement

Qualification & Experience

  • B.E./B.Tech. in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering from a recognized institution.
  • 15–20 years of overall experience in Engineering & Maintenance, preferably in a chemical/pharmaceutical manufacturing plant.
  • Proven experience in leading the Engineering/Maintenance function of a manufacturing facility.
  • Strong hands-on exposure to mechanical, electrical, instrumentation and utility maintenance.
  • Experience in managing maintenance teams, contractors, vendors and maintenance budgets.
  • Experience in project execution, equipment installation and commissioning will be preferred.

Behavioral & Leadership Competencies

  • Strong leadership and team management skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Good interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure and in a production-driven environment.
  • Strong decision-making and troubleshooting capabilities.
  • Ability to motivate and develop team members.
  • Strong focus on safety, quality, reliability and cost optimization.
  • Good computer skills, including MS Word, Excel and maintenance-related software/CMMS.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with Production, Quality, EHS, Projects, Procurement and other functions.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The position will be measured on:

  • Reduction in equipment breakdowns and unplanned downtime.
  • Improvement in plant and equipment availability.
  • Preventive maintenance compliance.
  • Improvement in MTBF and reduction in MTTR.
  • Maintenance cost optimization.
  • Critical spare availability and inventory control.
  • Utility reliability and energy efficiency.
  • Timely completion of maintenance projects.
  • Compliance with statutory, safety, quality and environmental requirements.
  • Successful implementation of continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Team capability development and training effectiveness.

Safety & Compliance Accountability

The incumbent will be accountable for ensuring that all Engineering & Maintenance activities are carried out in accordance with company policies, applicable statutory requirements and established Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) standards.

Particular emphasis will be placed on electrical safety, mechanical safety, permit-to-work systems, contractor safety, safe isolation/LOTO practices, statutory compliance and safe maintenance procedures.

Overall Accountability

The Sr. Manager / DGM – Maintenance will be accountable for the overall reliability, availability, safety and cost-effective maintenance of the plant's production equipment, utilities and engineering infrastructure. The incumbent will work closely with Production and other cross-functional teams to ensure uninterrupted manufacturing operations while continuously improving plant reliability, safety, quality and operational efficiency.


Note

The above responsibilities represent the minimum requirements of the position. Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned by the Department Head or Management based on operational requirements. This document serves as a guideline and is subject to revision and modification as required by the organization

title: Senior Manager
tagsAndSkills: Customer Quality,Supplier Quality,Audit Management,QMS,Regulatory Compliance,Manufacturing Process Planning,Continuous Improvement,Problem Solving
jobDescription:
Job Description Sr. Manager Quality Management System (QMS)
Job Title: Senior Manager Quality Management System (QMS)
Department: Quality
Reporting To: Chief Executive Officer (CEO) / Managing Director
Location: Bhayander / Vasai
Position Summary
The Senior Manager Quality Management System (QMS) is responsible for leading the organization's quality strategy, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives across multiple manufacturing facilities. The role ensures compliance with automotive quality standards, customer-specific requirements, and statutory regulations while driving operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and business performance.
The ideal candidate will have 15+ years of progressive experience in Quality Management within the Sheet Metal and Automotive Components industry, with expertise in QMS implementation, customer audits, supplier quality, manufacturing process control, and continuous improvement.
Key Responsibilities
Quality Leadership

  • Develop and implement the company's quality vision, policies, and strategic objectives.
  • Lead enterprise-wide Quality Management System initiatives aligned with business goals.
  • Establish quality culture and drive continuous improvement across all manufacturing operations.
  • Mentor and develop quality leadership teams across plants.

Quality Management System (QMS)

  • Lead implementation, maintenance, and continual improvement of Quality Management Systems.
  • Ensure compliance with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, MSIL customer-specific requirements, and applicable statutory standards.
  • Drive standardization of quality systems across manufacturing locations.
  • Review quality metrics and initiate improvement projects.

Customer Quality

  • Manage customer quality performance and ensure achievement of customer quality targets.
  • Lead customer audits and represent the organization during quality reviews.
  • Resolve customer complaints using structured problem-solving methodologies.
  • Strengthen customer relationships through proactive quality management.

Audit Management

  • Lead Internal Audits, Process Audits, Product Audits, Layered Process Audits (LPA), Supplier Audits, and System Audits.
  • Coordinate certification audits and customer assessments.
  • Ensure closure and effectiveness of audit findings within agreed timelines.
  • Drive audit readiness across all manufacturing facilities.

Manufacturing Process Quality

  • Ensure robust quality control throughout sheet metal manufacturing processes including:
    • Press Shop
    • Grinding
    • CNC Punching
    • VMC
    • Wire cut
    • HTR
    • SFD
    • Sizing Sorting
    • Progressive & Transfer Tooling
    • Laser Cutting
    • Bending
    • Assembly

  • Improve process capability and reduce variation through statistical methods.

Supplier Quality

  • Develop supplier quality systems and supplier development programs.
  • Monitor supplier performance and conduct supplier audits.
  • Lead supplier corrective actions and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Improve incoming quality and supplier PPM performance.

Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead structured problem-solving using:
    • 8D
    • 5 Why
    • Fishbone Diagram
    • PDCA
    • Kaizen
    • Six Sigma
    • Lean Manufacturing

  • Drive defect prevention and cost-of-quality reduction initiatives.

New Product Development (NPD)

  • Ensure quality planning for new product launches.
  • Review APQP deliverables.
  • Approve PPAP submissions.
  • Participate in design and process reviews.
  • Support successful customer approvals.

Risk Management

  • Drive implementation of PFMEA and DFMEA reviews.
  • Ensure Control Plans are effective.
  • Monitor Process Capability (Cp/Cpk).
  • Lead risk assessment and mitigation activities.

Performance Management
Monitor and improve:

  • Customer PPM
  • Internal PPM
  • Supplier PPM
  • COPQ (Cost of Poor Quality)
  • Scrap and Rework
  • Warranty Performance
  • First Pass Yield (FPY)
  • Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) from a quality perspective
  • CAPA effectiveness
  • Audit closure performance

Regulatory & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with automotive OEM requirements.
  • Maintain readiness for certification and surveillance audits.
  • Ensure compliance with environmental, health, and safety regulations related to quality operations.

Educational Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Master's Degree (MBA/Operations/Quality Management) preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum 15 years of experience in Quality Management within Sheet Metal and Automotive Components manufacturing.
  • At least 5 years in a senior leadership role (Head of Quality, General Manager Quality, AVP, or VP).
  • Experience working with automotive OEMs and Tier-1 customers.
  • Proven experience managing multiple manufacturing plants is preferred.

Technical Competencies

  • IATF 16949
  • ISO 9001
  • APQP
  • PPAP
  • FMEA
  • MSA
  • SPC
  • Control Plan
  • 8D Problem Solving
  • Root Cause Analysis
  • Lean Manufacturing
  • Six Sigma
  • Kaizen
  • Process Capability Studies
  • GD&T
  • Welding Quality Standards
  • Sheet Metal Manufacturing Processes
  • ERP/QMS Systems
  • Quality Cost Analysis

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic leadership
  • Team building and mentoring
  • Customer relationship management
  • Decision-making under pressure
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Change management
  • Negotiation and influencing skills
  • Strong analytical and communication skills

Preferred Certifications

  • IATF 16949 Lead Auditor
  • ISO 9001 Lead Auditor
  • VDA 6.3 Process Auditor
  • VDA 6.5 Product Auditor
  • Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt
  • Lean Manufacturing Certification
  • AIAG Core Tools Certification

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Customer PPM achievement
  • Supplier PPM reduction
  • Internal rejection reduction
  • COPQ reduction
  • Audit compliance score
  • CAPA closure effectiveness
  • Customer complaint closure time
  • Process capability improvement (Cp/Cpk)
  • Successful certification and customer audits
  • On-time PPAP approvals
  • Scrap and rework reduction
  • Employee competency and training effectiveness

Industry Preference
Candidates with experience in manufacturing automotive sheet metal components such as chassis parts, brackets, BIW components, structural assemblies, exhaust systems, seat structures, fabricated assemblies, and welded sub-assemblies supplying OEMs or Tier-1 automotive customers will be preferred.

jobDescription:
Responsibilities

Financial Reporting & Management Information

  • Own the preparation and timely release of the monthly Management Information System report to the leadership team on a defined reporting calendar.
  • Present financial performance against budget, with variance analysis that identifies cause, quantum and the accountable function.
  • Deliver reporting on product-wise and customer-wise profitability, working capital, cash position, receivable and payable ageing, inventory and capital expenditure.
  • Review and validate the weekly cash flow statement prepared by the Senior Manager, Finance & Accounts prior to its submission to management.
  • Provide financial analysis to support pricing, product mix, customer, vendor and capital investment decisions.

Accounting Operations & Financial Control

  • Own the accuracy, completeness and integrity of the books of account across all Group entities.

  • Establish and hold a defined monthly closing calendar.
  • Ensure all control accounts, including bank, debtors, creditors, inventory, inter-company and tax ledgers, are reconciled on a monthly basis.
  • Establish accounting policies and ensure their consistent application in line with applicable accounting standards and the Companies Act.
  • Ensure the physical verification programme for inventory and fixed assets is executed and that variances are investigated and resolved.

ERP Implementation, Finance & Accounts

  • Serve as the functional owner for the Finance & Accounts scope of the Company's Odoo implementation.
  • Define, prioritise and sign off finance requirements for the in-house development team, and validate delivered functionality before it goes live.
  • Establish Odoo as the single source of financial data, with parallel record keeping outside the system progressively retired.
  • Ensure financial controls, including approval workflows, delegation of authority limits, period locking and user access rights, are configured and enforced within the system.
  • Build the capability of the Finance & Accounts team to operate the system independently and accurately.

Costing & Profitability Analysis

  • Establish and maintain a standard costing framework covering raw material, utilities, conversion cost and overhead across the product portfolio.
  • Deliver monthly cost and contribution analysis at product level, with variance analysed by price, yield, usage and volume.
  • Partner with Production, Quality and Purchase on the financial impact of yield, downtime, rework and input cost movement.
  • Ensure costing is derived from ERP and plant data, providing a single validated cost base for commercial decision making.
  • Support the statutory Cost Audit and ensure cost records are maintained as required.

Budgeting & Budgetary Control

  • Lead the annual operating and capital expenditure budgeting exercise in consultation with department heads and management.
  • Establish department-wise and cost-centre-wise budgets with clear ownership resting at the department head level.
  • Publish monthly budget versus actual performance to each department and drive corrective action on adverse variance.
  • Institute budgetary control at the point of commitment, so that spending is validated before it is incurred.
  • Track and report the financial benefit of cost reduction and improvement initiatives across the organisation.

Treasury, Banking & Working Capital Management

  • Manage the Group's cash position, fund utilisation and working capital requirement.
  • Lead banking relationships and negotiate working capital limits, term facilities and trade finance on competitive terms.

  • Ensure timely and accurate submission of stock statements, QIS, CMA data and other lender requirements.
  • Drive improvement in the cash conversion cycle through receivable, payable and inventory management, in coordination with Sales, Purchase and Stores.
  • Manage foreign exchange exposure and hedging in respect of export receivables and import payables.
  • Manage the credit rating process and strengthen the Group's standing with lenders and rating agencies.

International Accounting & Group Consolidation

  • Own the accounting, closing and reporting for the Group's United States and European entities, aligning them to the same reporting calendar as the Indian operations.
  • Coordinate with overseas advisors and accounting firms on statutory filings, indirect tax and corporate tax obligations.
  • Ensure inter-company transactions are correctly recorded, reconciled and supported by transfer pricing documentation.
  • Deliver consolidated Group financial reporting to management.
  • Report entity-level profitability, receivables and cash position for the international business.

Statutory Compliance, Taxation & Audit

  • Own the compliance calendar across GST, TDS, TCS, income tax, PF, ESIC and ROC obligations, with full adherence to statutory timelines.
  • Manage assessments, notices, scrutiny proceedings and appeals before the Income Tax and GST authorities.
  • Manage statutory, internal, tax, cost and transfer pricing audits, ensuring timely closure and resolution of audit observations.
  • Provide management with periodic visibility of compliance status and any open exposure.

Internal Controls & Process Governance

  • Establish documented standard operating procedures for all core finance processes, including purchase to pay, order to cash, inventory accounting, fixed assets and month end closing.
  • Define and enforce a Delegation of Authority matrix covering approval limits for purchase, payment, expense and write off.
  • Institute segregation of duties and maker-checker controls across financial transactions.
  • Establish and administer the customer credit policy, including credit limits, credit terms and escalation for overdue accounts.
  • Identify control gaps and strengthen the control environment on a proactive basis.

Team Leadership & Capability Building

  • Lead, structure and develop the Finance & Accounts team, including the Senior Manager, Finance & Accounts.
  • Define clear roles, responsibilities and deliverables for each team member, supported by documented processes.
  • Build depth and cross-cover within the team so that critical activities are not dependent on any single individual.
  • Coach and develop the team, upgrading capability in ERP usage, analysis and reporting.
  • Set individual KPIs under the Company's Performance Management System and conduct monthly performance reviews.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Act as a business partner to Production, Purchase, Stores, Sales, Quality and Human Resources, providing financial insight that supports operating decisions.
  • Represent Finance & Accounts in management reviews and contribute to business planning and strategy discussions.

title: Consulting - Internal Audit/SOX – Senior Manager
