jobDescription:
EY_ Consulting _ SOX – Senior Manager

As part of our Consulting Enterprise Risk team, our clients look for EY’s expertise across the consulting solutions and specifically for engagements related to Internal Audit, Process compliance and reviews, SOX 404, Payment application, Developing Standard Operating Procedure manuals, Third Party Risk Management, Regulatory Compliance and Enterprise Risk Management.

 

There really is no average day in this role, since every client will have multi-faceted challenges and a distinct business environment. What it means is that you’ll have an opportunity to learn and adapt to our clients’ cultures and contribute towards developing unique solutions that are tailored to individual engagements. Whichever industry or client you’re working with, you’ll have plenty of opportunities to expand your business network and transform yourself into a truly global professional.

 

The opportunity

This is client-facing role in a rapidly growing practice, where you’ll build client relationships with key stakeholders, including management executives for some of the most globally recognized brands. It makes this the perfect place to gain a deeper understanding of complex businesses transactions, all the while recommending solutions to some of the most pressing business challenges and process inefficiencies. You'll also team with our performance improvement professionals in multidisciplinary engagements, helping major global clients transform and sustain business performance. The team is focused on leveraging emerging technologies like Robotics, AI, Advanced Analytics to enhance various Internal Audit and internal control solutions being provided to the client and actively work in building multiple tools and assets for efficient and effective client delivery. By plugging into our market-leading global network, you'll gain the experience you need to become an exceptional Risk Advisor

 

Your key roles and responsibilities

Delivery and Team management

  • Responsible for executing client related engagements in the areas of SOX 404 assistance, governance, risk & compliance, process reviews, standard operating procedures
  • Manage a team of Managers and Seniors (across locations) to manage delivery of the SOX engagements - including scoping, test of design, test of effectiveness and reporting – for multiple processes across clients
  • Lead control rationalization and standardization activity for business processes
  • Plan & schedule client engagements. Determine and deploy the right team with adequate skill sets for executing engagements and periodically review status of engagements and work products
  • Review compliance with internal quality & risk management guidelines
  • Review & package overall project findings into clear, concise & high quality work products
  • Maintain a strong client focus by effectively serving client needs and developing productive working relationships with client personnel. Stay abreast of current business and economic developments and new pronouncements/standards relevant to the client's business.
  • Demonstrate subject matter & industry expertise (deep understanding of the industry, emerging trends, issues/challenges, key players & leading practices).
  • Actively contribute to improving operational efficiency on projects & internal initiatives by leveraging on lessons learned from other projects.
  • Monitor engagement economics & ensure timely billing of invoices & actively follow-up on collections by managers/seniors.

 

Market Leadership and client management

  • Executive-level skills in client relationship management and the hold conversations with senior executives.
  • Partnering with onshore teams to understand client’s business & related industry issues / trends for global clients.
  • Contribute to new solution development basis the industry trends and client’s problem statement
  • Conduct knowledge sharing discussions & contribute to EY thought leadership.
  • Supports in responding to RFP / RFIs
  • Identify buyers, influencers & stakeholders in existing client engagements and build strong relationships.
  • Identify opportunities for cross-selling to current clients/introduce colleagues from other service lines.
  • Assist Partners/Directors in driving the account management agenda by focusing on high impact opportunities.
  • Identify opportunities for growing the existing solution
  • Play an active role in modernizing the SOX agenda via automation and innovation
  • Create innovative insights for clients, adapts methods & practices to fit operational team needs & contributes to thought leadership documents.
  • Represent the firm in various industry conferences and associations – network with individuals, contribute to key discussion items and explore business opportunities.

 

Operational Excellence

  • Suggest ideas on improving engagement productivity and identify opportunities for improving client service.
  • Manage engagement budgets and ensure compliance with engagement plans and internal quality & risk management procedures.

 

People related

  • Display teamwork, integrity and leadership. Work with team members to set goals and responsibilities for specific engagements. Foster teamwork and innovation.
  • Utilize technology & tools to continually learn and innovate, share knowledge with team members and enhance service delivery.
  • Understand EY and its service lines. Actively encourage team members to contribute ideas.
  • Conduct workshops and technical training sessions for team members. Contribute to the learning & development agenda and knowledge harnessing initiatives.
  • Drive campus recruitment initiatives

 

To qualify for the role, you must have

  • Overall 10 years of experience across “Big 4” or professional firm or professional industry experience in risks & controls, with more than 6 years of experience in SOX / internal controls
  • Strong understanding of SOX and COSO framework
  • CIA certification is preferred
  • Strong academic history (degree in Business, Accounting, Engineering or similar)
  • Strong multi-project management skills
  • Skilled at collaborating, motivating and guiding high performance teams.
  • Cognitive problem solving capabilities, quick decision making skills and ability to handle complex situations with a calm demeanor
  • Exceptional command on spoken and written English
  • Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations
  • Team player with strong interpersonal skills
  • Ability to think differently and innovate

 

Ideally, you’ll also have

  • Responsible for the performance and appraisal of direct reports, including training and developing necessary skill sets to enable them to grow in their careers.
  • Mentor and coach junior team members, enabling them to meet their performance goals and successfully grow their careers. 

 

What we look for

  • A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
  • Opportunities to work with EY Risk -Internal Audit practices global with leading businesses across a range of industries

 

What working at EY offers

At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

  • Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
  • Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
  • The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

title: Manager, Technical & Operations
tagsAndSkills: Production Engineering,Process Engineering,Cross Functional Teams,Manufacturing Engineering,Product Life Cycle Management,Industrial Engineering,AutoCAD,Production Management
jobDescription:
Manager Technical & Operations

Company: Krishitek Industries Pvt. Ltd. (www.krishitek.com)
Location: Santej (Ahmedabad), Gujarat
Department: Technical & Operations
Reports To: Managing Director
Experience: 10–15 Years
Industry Experience: Minimum 3–4 years in Agricultural Machinery / Tractor / Farm Equipment industry

About Krishitek

Krishitek Industries Pvt. Ltd. is an Indian manufacturer of agricultural machinery, focused on developing practical, reliable and farmer-oriented mechanization solutions.

We are looking for an experienced Manager – Technical & Operations who can lead our Design & Development and Production functions while driving effective cross-functional coordination across Purchase, Quality, Dispatch, After-Sales Service (technical support) and OEM/technical partners.

This is a senior, hands-on role for a professional who understands the complete product lifecycle — Design Development Manufacturing Quality Field Performance Product Improvement.


Key Responsibilities

1. Design & Product Development

  • Lead the Design & Development function and manage engineering priorities.
  • Lead new product development and existing product improvement initiatives.
  • Review and guide engineering drawings, BOMs, specifications and design changes.
  • Ensure products are practical, reliable, cost-effective and manufacturable.
  • Drive Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA).
  • Coordinate prototype development, testing, validation and implementation.
  • Convert field/customer requirements into meaningful product improvements.
  • Build engineering standards, documentation and design processes.

2. Production & Manufacturing

  • Lead and coordinate with the Production team to achieve production targets.
  • Identify and resolve production bottlenecks.
  • Improve productivity, manufacturing processes and resource utilization.
  • Ensure smooth transition of new/modified products from Design to Production.
  • Coordinate with fabrication, machining, assembly and outsourced manufacturing partners.
  • Reduce rejection, rework, downtime and production losses.
  • Ensure manufacturability is considered during product development.

3. Purchase & Vendor Technical Coordination

  • Define technical specifications for critical components and materials.
  • Technically evaluate and develop vendors.
  • Support Purchase in vendor selection and technical evaluation.
  • Identify alternate materials/components for cost, quality and availability improvement.
  • Resolve technical issues with suppliers.
  • Drive technical development of critical suppliers.

4. Quality & Root Cause Analysis

  • Work closely with Quality and Production teams to identify root causes of product/process issues.
  • Lead technical Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and corrective actions.
  • Eliminate recurring quality problems.
  • Analyse rejection, rework and field-failure trends.
  • Drive continuous improvement in product and process quality.

5. After-Sales & Product Performance

  • Provide technical support for major product/service issues.
  • Analyse field failures and identify design, manufacturing or process-related root causes.
  • Establish a feedback loop from Customer Service Design Production.
  • Drive product improvements based on field performance.
  • Reduce recurring technical complaints and warranty issues.

6. OEM & External Technical Coordination

  • Coordinate technical discussions with OEMs, technology partners and external agencies.
  • Understand OEM requirements and translate them into internal execution.
  • Lead technical trials, modifications and product integration.
  • Manage technical communication with external partners.

7. Process & Cost Improvement

  • Identify opportunities for product and manufacturing cost reduction.
  • Improve material utilization, process efficiency and product design.
  • Evaluate make-vs-buy opportunities.
  • Reduce unnecessary components, processes and manufacturing complexity.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives.

8. Management & Strategic Support

  • Provide the Managing Director with technical and operational insights for decision-making.
  • Analyse production constraints, product costs, technical risks, supplier issues and capacity requirements.
  • Support strategic decisions related to new products, manufacturing and process improvement.
  • Lead cross-functional projects involving multiple departments.

Candidate Profile

We are specifically looking for a cross-functional engineering and operations professional, not a conventional Design Manager or Production Manager.

Mandatory Requirements

  • 10–15 years of total professional experience.
  • 35 years of age or above.
  • Minimum 3–4 years of relevant experience in Agricultural Machinery / Tractor / Farm Equipment / Tractor Implements or closely related manufacturing.
  • Strong cross-functional experience across multiple functions such as:
    • Design & Development
    • Production / Manufacturing
    • Quality
    • Vendor Development / Purchase
    • After-Sales / Field Support
    • Operations
  • Engineering degree in Mechanical / Production / Industrial Engineering preferred.
  • Experience in mechanical product design and manufacturing.
  • Experience leading teams and cross-functional projects.
  • Strong understanding of engineering drawings, BOMs, materials and manufacturing processes.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making ability.
  • Hands-on approach with both engineering and shop-floor teams.

Career Stability

We value long-term commitment and organizational stability.

Preference will be given to candidates who have demonstrated:

  • 5+ year tenure in at least one organization.
  • Experience across 1–2 organizations rather than frequent job changes.
  • Progressive increase in responsibility during their career.

We Are Looking For Someone Who

Can move comfortably between:

Design Office Factory Floor Vendor Quality Service (technical support) Management

The ideal candidate should be able to understand not only how a product is designed, but also how it is manufactured, how it performs in the field, what it costs, why it fails and how it can be improved.

Key Performance Areas

Performance will be evaluated on:

  • New product development and successful implementation
  • Product reliability and design improvement
  • Production efficiency
  • Reduction in rejection and rework
  • Reduction in recurring technical complaints
  • Product and manufacturing cost reduction
  • Vendor technical development
  • Timely completion of engineering projects
  • Effective Design-to-Production transition
  • Process improvement
  • Cross-functional project execution
  • Team development

Career Growth

This position offers a long-term leadership opportunity.

Manager – Technical & Operations

Senior Manager – Technical & Operations

Head – Technical & Operations

Career progression will be based on demonstrated technical capability, leadership, ownership, business impact and ability to build and lead teams.

How to Apply

Interested candidates meeting the above criteria may share their updated CV on email id : info@krishitek.com or whatsapp : 7486029219 with details of:

  • Current CTC
  • Expected CTC
  • Notice Period
  • Current Location
  • Total Experience
  • Agricultural Machinery / Tractor Industry Experience

title: Consulting - SOX – Senior Manager
tagsAndSkills: SOX,Internal Financial Control,SOX Compliance,Internal Audit,Internal Control,ICOFR,ITR,Coso Framework
jobDescription:
EY_ Consulting _ SOX – Senior Manager

As part of our Consulting Enterprise Risk team, our clients look for EY’s expertise across the consulting solutions and specifically for engagements related to Internal Audit, Process compliance and reviews, SOX 404, Payment application, Developing Standard Operating Procedure manuals, Third Party Risk Management, Regulatory Compliance and Enterprise Risk Management.

 

There really is no average day in this role, since every client will have multi-faceted challenges and a distinct business environment. What it means is that you’ll have an opportunity to learn and adapt to our clients’ cultures and contribute towards developing unique solutions that are tailored to individual engagements. Whichever industry or client you’re working with, you’ll have plenty of opportunities to expand your business network and transform yourself into a truly global professional.

 

The opportunity

This is client-facing role in a rapidly growing practice, where you’ll build client relationships with key stakeholders, including management executives for some of the most globally recognized brands. It makes this the perfect place to gain a deeper understanding of complex businesses transactions, all the while recommending solutions to some of the most pressing business challenges and process inefficiencies. You'll also team with our performance improvement professionals in multidisciplinary engagements, helping major global clients transform and sustain business performance. The team is focused on leveraging emerging technologies like Robotics, AI, Advanced Analytics to enhance various Internal Audit and internal control solutions being provided to the client and actively work in building multiple tools and assets for efficient and effective client delivery. By plugging into our market-leading global network, you'll gain the experience you need to become an exceptional Risk Advisor

 

Your key roles and responsibilities

Delivery and Team management

  • Responsible for executing client related engagements in the areas of SOX 404 assistance, governance, risk & compliance, process reviews, standard operating procedures
  • Manage a team of Managers and Seniors (across locations) to manage delivery of the SOX engagements - including scoping, test of design, test of effectiveness and reporting – for multiple processes across clients
  • Lead control rationalization and standardization activity for business processes
  • Plan & schedule client engagements. Determine and deploy the right team with adequate skill sets for executing engagements and periodically review status of engagements and work products
  • Review compliance with internal quality & risk management guidelines
  • Review & package overall project findings into clear, concise & high quality work products
  • Maintain a strong client focus by effectively serving client needs and developing productive working relationships with client personnel. Stay abreast of current business and economic developments and new pronouncements/standards relevant to the client's business.
  • Demonstrate subject matter & industry expertise (deep understanding of the industry, emerging trends, issues/challenges, key players & leading practices).
  • Actively contribute to improving operational efficiency on projects & internal initiatives by leveraging on lessons learned from other projects.
  • Monitor engagement economics & ensure timely billing of invoices & actively follow-up on collections by managers/seniors.

 

Market Leadership and client management

  • Executive-level skills in client relationship management and the hold conversations with senior executives.
  • Partnering with onshore teams to understand client’s business & related industry issues / trends for global clients.
  • Contribute to new solution development basis the industry trends and client’s problem statement
  • Conduct knowledge sharing discussions & contribute to EY thought leadership.
  • Supports in responding to RFP / RFIs
  • Identify buyers, influencers & stakeholders in existing client engagements and build strong relationships.
  • Identify opportunities for cross-selling to current clients/introduce colleagues from other service lines.
  • Assist Partners/Directors in driving the account management agenda by focusing on high impact opportunities.
  • Identify opportunities for growing the existing solution
  • Play an active role in modernizing the SOX agenda via automation and innovation
  • Create innovative insights for clients, adapts methods & practices to fit operational team needs & contributes to thought leadership documents.
  • Represent the firm in various industry conferences and associations – network with individuals, contribute to key discussion items and explore business opportunities.

 

Operational Excellence

  • Suggest ideas on improving engagement productivity and identify opportunities for improving client service.
  • Manage engagement budgets and ensure compliance with engagement plans and internal quality & risk management procedures.

 

People related

  • Display teamwork, integrity and leadership. Work with team members to set goals and responsibilities for specific engagements. Foster teamwork and innovation.
  • Utilize technology & tools to continually learn and innovate, share knowledge with team members and enhance service delivery.
  • Understand EY and its service lines. Actively encourage team members to contribute ideas.
  • Conduct workshops and technical training sessions for team members. Contribute to the learning & development agenda and knowledge harnessing initiatives.
  • Drive campus recruitment initiatives

 

To qualify for the role, you must have

  • Overall 10 years of experience across “Big 4” or professional firm or professional industry experience in risks & controls, with more than 6 years of experience in SOX / internal controls
  • Strong understanding of SOX and COSO framework
  • CIA certification is preferred
  • Strong academic history (degree in Business, Accounting, Engineering or similar)
  • Strong multi-project management skills
  • Skilled at collaborating, motivating and guiding high performance teams.
  • Cognitive problem solving capabilities, quick decision making skills and ability to handle complex situations with a calm demeanor
  • Exceptional command on spoken and written English
  • Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations
  • Team player with strong interpersonal skills
  • Ability to think differently and innovate

 

Ideally, you’ll also have

  • Responsible for the performance and appraisal of direct reports, including training and developing necessary skill sets to enable them to grow in their careers.
  • Mentor and coach junior team members, enabling them to meet their performance goals and successfully grow their careers. 

 

What we look for

  • A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
  • Opportunities to work with EY Risk -Internal Audit practices global with leading businesses across a range of industries

 

What working at EY offers

At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

  • Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
  • Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
  • The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

title: Medical Superintendent
jobDescription:
1. Leadership and Clinical Management

  • Oversee and coordinate all clinical operations within the hospital, ensuring the delivery of effective, safe, and high-quality patient care.
  • Provide leadership and direction to clinical departments and teams, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, professionalism, and patient-centered care.
  • Supervise and support department heads, ensuring they meet hospital standards for clinical performance, patient care, and operational efficiency.
  • Monitor clinical services and implement strategies to improve patient care, reduce clinical errors, and ensure best practices across all departments.

2. Operational Oversight

  • Ensure that clinical operations, including patient admissions, diagnostics, treatment, and discharge procedures, are carried out smoothly and efficiently.
  • Collaborate with department heads and senior management to address operational challenges and implement improvements.
  • Manage hospital resources, including medical staff, equipment, and supplies, to ensure efficient utilization while maintaining high standards of care.
  • Coordinate the hospitals daily operations, ensuring adequate staffing levels, effective scheduling, and resource allocation.

3. Policy Development and Implementation

  • Develop, implement, and ensure compliance with hospital policies, procedures, and clinical guidelines that align with healthcare regulations and best practices.
  • Work closely with senior management to develop and execute the hospital's strategic plan, ensuring that clinical and operational goals align with organizational objectives.
  • Review and update policies related to patient care, safety, infection control, and ethical standards, ensuring hospital-wide adherence.

4. Quality Assurance and Compliance

  • Ensure the hospitals compliance with all regulatory requirements, including accreditation standards, legal guidelines, and patient safety protocols.
  • Lead hospital-wide initiatives for continuous quality improvement (CQI) and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to clinical outcomes, patient satisfaction, and operational efficiency.
  • Conduct regular audits of medical records, patient care processes, and safety protocols to ensure compliance with hospital standards and external regulations.

5. Staff Management and Development

  • Lead recruitment, training, and development programs for medical and clinical staff, ensuring that the hospital maintains a highly skilled and motivated workforce.
  • Conduct performance appraisals for clinical staff and provide guidance on professional development, training, and career growth.
  • Foster an environment of collaboration and effective communication among doctors, nurses, and other healthcare professionals.

6. Budgeting and Financial Management

  • Oversee the budget for clinical departments, ensuring that resources are allocated effectively to support patient care and hospital operations.
  • Monitor expenditures in medical and clinical departments, ensuring cost-efficiency without compromising patient care quality.
  • Provide input on the financial management of the hospital, including resource allocation, cost management, and investment in medical technologies.

7. Patient Care and Satisfaction

  • Ensure that patient care is consistent with the hospital’s mission of providing excellent, compassionate healthcare services.
  • Address patient complaints and concerns related to medical care, working with clinical teams to resolve issues effectively.
  • Promote patient-centered care by ensuring that all clinical staff are trained to communicate effectively with patients and their families.

8. Strategic Planning and Hospital Development

  • Collaborate with senior management to identify and implement opportunities for hospital growth, service expansion, and clinical innovation.
  • Evaluate the need for new clinical services or technological advancements, making recommendations to enhance the hospital’s capabilities and offerings.
  • Support the hospital’s research initiatives and clinical trials, fostering a culture of evidence-based medicine and innovation.

9. Emergency and Crisis Management

  • Lead the hospital’s emergency response efforts in case of public health emergencies, mass casualty incidents, or crises, ensuring effective coordination of medical resources and staff.
  • Develop and implement disaster preparedness plans, ensuring that clinical departments are equipped to handle emergencies efficiently.

US Brokerage- Team Leader Job Description

Job Summary

The Team Lead is a fulltime position responsible for providing operational leadership, administrative support and technical coaching to associates to ensure the accurate and timely identification, processing and update of shipment information. The role applies sound judgment and independent initiative to identify issues, analyze problems, and implement appropriate solutions in a fastpaced operational environment.   • Maintains current knowledge of system functionality, service features and process updates through training and knowledgesharing with the team.
  • Holds associates accountable to established performance standards and supports skill development through targeted coaching and training recommendations.

jobDescription:
Job Description: Collection Team Leader (BPO)

Location: Chennai

Experience Required: 2 to 4 years of hands-on experience in BPO Collections

CTC: 3,00,000 to 4,00,000 per annum (Depending on experience and interview performance)

Languages Known: Tamil and English (Proficiency in additional regional languages will be an added advantage)

Notice Period: Immediate joiners or max 15 days preferred

About the Role

We are seeking a dynamic, results-driven, and experienced Collection Team Leader to manage our BPO collection floor in Chennai. The ideal candidate will lead a team of collection specialists/telecallers, drive performance metrics, ensure targets are met consistently, and maintain compliance with collection guidelines and company policies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Team Management: Lead, mentor, and supervise a team of collection agents/telecallers to achieve daily, weekly, and monthly collection and recovery targets.
  • Performance Monitoring: Track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as recovery rate, PTP (Promise to Pay) conversion, call quality, and average handling time (AHT).
  • Floor Operations: Handle day-to-day operations of the collection floor, manage bucket-wise allocations, and monitor dialer performance.
  • Coaching & Feedback: Conduct regular one-on-one coaching sessions, performance reviews, and feedback sessions to bridge performance gaps.
  • Escalation Handling: Handle escalated customer calls/disputes effectively and negotiate mutually acceptable payment resolutions within company guidelines.
  • Reporting: Prepare and present daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports regarding team performance and collection metrics to upper management.
  • Compliance: Ensure the team complies with standard operating procedures (SOPs), data security policies, and ethical debt collection practices.

Candidate Profile & Requirements

  • Experience: 2 to 4 years of solid operational experience in BPO Collections / Tele-collections, with at least 12 years in a Team Leading or supervisory role.
  • Education: Graduation or equivalent from a recognized institution.
  • Language Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Tamil and English. Knowledge of any other regional language is an added advantage.
  • Technical Skills: Familiarity with dialer systems, CRM tools, and MS Excel (for reporting and data tracking).
  • Competencies: Strong negotiation skills, high-pressure handling capability, leadership qualities, and result-oriented mindset.

title: Walk-in || Registered Pharmacist
tagsAndSkills: Drug,FDA,Regulatory Affairs,Drug Licensing,Pharmaceutical,Drug Regulatory Affairs,Pharmaceutics,Drug Safety
jobDescription:
• JOB DESCRIPTION:

  • Position: Pharma Competent Person Wholesale Operations
  • Company: Dealplex Solutions Private Limited
  • Business Division: Dealplex B2B Pharmaceutical and Quick Commerce
  • Department: Pharmaceutical Operations and Compliance
  • Location: Jharkhand
  • Employment Type: Full Time

  • ABOUT THE COMPANY

  • Dealplex Solutions Private Limited is a technology driven B2B and quick commerce company focused on efficient procurement distribution and delivery of products. As part of its B2B Pharmaceutical business, the company is developing compliant and professionally managed wholesale pharmaceutical operations.

  • JOB PURPOSE:

  • Dealplex Solutions Private Limited is looking for a qualified and responsible Pharma Competent Person to oversee pharmaceutical wholesale operations and support compliance with applicable Drugs and Cosmetics laws, Drug Rules and requirements of the State Drug Licensing Authority.

  • The selected candidate will be responsible for supervising pharmaceutical procurement, storage, inventory, sale, distribution, documentation and regulatory compliance.

  • KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Act as the Competent Person for pharmaceutical wholesale operations subject to eligibility verification and acceptance by the applicable Drug Licensing Authority.

  • Support the application, renewal, maintenance and compliance requirements of the Wholesale Drug Licence.
  • Supervise the procurement, receipt, storage, sale and distribution of pharmaceutical products.

  • Ensure medicines are procured only from duly licensed manufacturers, distributors, wholesalers or authorised suppliers.

  • Verify and maintain purchase invoices, sales invoices, batch details, expiry records and other required statutory documents.

  • Ensure medicines are stored under appropriate temperature, environmental and storage conditions as applicable.

  • Monitor stock levels, batch numbers, expiry dates, damaged products, returns and product recalls.

  • Ensure proper segregation, handling and documentation of expired, damaged, recalled and returned medicines.

  • Maintain required registers, records and statutory documentation in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Coordinate with the Drug Inspector and State Drug Licensing Authority during inspections, verification and compliance activities.

  • Monitor day to day pharmaceutical operations and identify potential regulatory or operational compliance gaps.

  • Guide operational staff regarding proper handling, storage, documentation and movement of pharmaceutical products.

  • Ensure that pharmaceutical products are not procured, stored, sold or distributed in violation of applicable laws, licence conditions or regulatory requirements.

  • Assist management in establishing and maintaining appropriate pharmaceutical compliance processes as the B2B pharmaceutical business expands.

  • ELIGIBILITY AND QUALIFICATION:

  • Candidates meeting any applicable eligibility criteria prescribed under the Drugs and Cosmetics Rules and requirements of the State Drug Licensing Authority may be considered.

  • Preferred candidates should have a D Pharm or B Pharm qualification along with valid registration with the respective State Pharmacy Council.
  • Candidates with relevant experience in pharmaceutical wholesale, distribution, stockist operations or pharmacy business will be preferred.

  • OTHER ELIGIBLE CANDIDATES:

  • Graduates with the required experience in dealing with or selling pharmaceutical drugs may be considered wherever permitted under applicable rules.

  • Candidates satisfying any other Competent Person eligibility criteria prescribed or accepted by the applicable Drug Licensing Authority may also be considered.

  • PREFERRED CANDIDATE PROFILE:

  • Registered Pharmacist with valid Pharmacy Council registration.
  • Prior experience with a licensed pharmaceutical wholesaler, distributor, stockist or pharmacy business.

  • Good understanding of pharmaceutical wholesale operations and regulatory documentation.

  • Knowledge of pharmaceutical storage, batch management, expiry management and purchase and sales documentation.
  • Ability to coordinate effectively with Drug Inspectors and regulatory authorities.

  • Strong attention to compliance, documentation and operational accuracy.

  • Responsible and reliable with the ability to take ownership of pharmaceutical compliance activities.
  • Good communication and coordination skills.

  • REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:

  • Educational qualification certificates.
  • Pharmacy Council registration certificate or registration number where applicable.
  • Relevant pharmaceutical experience certificates.
  • Previous employment details.
  • Aadhaar Card and PAN Card.
  • Any licence, registration, declaration or other documents required by the applicable Drug Licensing Authority.

  • REGULATORY DISCLAIMER:

  • The appointment and designation of the selected candidate as Competent Person will remain subject to verification of eligibility and acceptance or approval by the applicable Drug Licensing Authority.
  • Meeting the stated qualification or experience criteria does not by itself guarantee acceptance or approval as a Competent Person by the regulatory authority.

  • WHY JOIN DEALPLEX:

  • Opportunity to work with an emerging B2B pharmaceutical and quick commerce business.
  • Opportunity to take ownership of pharmaceutical wholesale operations and regulatory compliance.
  • Professional work environment with exposure to technology enabled pharmaceutical distribution operations.
  • Opportunity to contribute to the development and expansion of a growing pharmaceutical business.

jobDescription:
Job Description: Ancillary Coder/QA

Position Summary

The Ancillary Lab Coder is responsible for accurately reviewing and assigning ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes and other required data elements to laboratory encounters based on physician documentation, payer guidelines, and client-specific requirements. The coder ensures coding accuracy, compliance with regulatory standards, and adherence to productivity and quality expectations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review laboratory requisitions, physician orders, pathology reports, and supporting clinical documentation.
  • Assign accurate ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes to laboratory encounters.
  • Validate medical necessity based on payer-specific Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs), National Coverage Determinations (NCDs), and client guidelines.
  • Identify missing, invalid, or conflicting documentation and escalate according to established processes.
  • Ensure coding complies with ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines, CMS regulations, and client-specific coding policies.
  • Verify diagnosis sequencing and coding completeness.
  • Maintain productivity, quality, and turnaround time (TAT) targets.
  • Participate in client updates, education sessions, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Maintain confidentiality and comply with HIPAA regulations.
  • Document coding decisions and maintain audit trails where applicable.
  • Communicate coding-related issues to Team Leads and Quality Analysts.

Required Qualifications

  • Graduate in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing, or an equivalent healthcare-related field.
  • Certification such as CPC, CCS, COC, CIC, or RHIT/RHIA preferred.
  • Min 1 year of experience in Ancillary medical coding.
  • Strong knowledge of ICD-10-CM coding guidelines.
  • Familiarity with laboratory testing, pathology, molecular diagnostics, and medical necessity guidelines.
  • Experience using coding encoders (3M, Optum, TruCode, etc.) and EHR systems.
  • Good analytical and communication skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.

title: Business Development & Marketing Manager (Medical Disposables)
tagsAndSkills: Marketing Strategy,Marketing Management,Brand Management,Strategic Marketing Planning,Marketing Communication,Marketing Budget,Marketing Campaigns,Marketing planning
jobDescription:
Arni Medica is seeking a commercially driven Business Development & Marketing Manager to develop domestic channels, appoint distributors, acquire hospitals and institutional accounts, build a marketing-led sales pipeline, and establish export opportunities.


The role will own growth for Hemodialysis Blood Tubing Sets (HDBT), IV Infusion Sets, IV Cannulas, catheters, and other sterile disposable medical-device products. The successful candidate will combine new-business development, distributor/channel management, institutional and government tender strategy, digital marketing, key-account development, and international distributor development.


Key Responsibilities


Business Development and Channel Growth

  • Develop and execute annual and quarterly business-development plans for HDBT sets, IV infusion sets, IV cannulas, catheters, other sterile disposable medical-device products, and approved contract-manufacturing opportunities.
  • Develop domestic and international business for Hemodialysis Blood Tubing Sets (HDBT), IV Infusion Sets, IV Cannulas, catheters, and other sterile disposable medical products.
  • Build product-wise market-entry and channel plans for hospitals, dialysis centres, nursing homes, clinics, medical distributors, surgical-product distributors, institutional buyers, and government-healthcare procurement organizations.
  • Identify, evaluate, appoint, train, and manage distributors across priority Indian states and cities.
  • Screen distributors for financial strength, medical-device/healthcare portfolio, territory coverage, customer base, ability to carry inventory, institutional access, sales capability, and expected volume.
  • Build relationships with hospitals, dialysis centres, nursing homes, clinics, medical distributors, surgical/medical suppliers, institutional buyers, healthcare procurement teams, and OEM/private-label prospects.
  • Build relationships with key decision-makers, including hospital procurement heads, supply-chain teams, dialysis-centre administrators, biomedical teams where relevant, nursing leadership, clinical stakeholders where appropriate, and government-institution buyers.
  • Lead strategic-account discussions, distributor negotiations, commercial proposals, annual volume plans, territory plans, and channel-development activities.
  • Present approved product features, commercial value proposition, packaging/configuration options, supply capability, and the approved complaint-escalation process accurately.
  • Identify cross-selling opportunities that increase customer value across HDBT, IV sets, IV cannulas, catheters, and the broader disposable-product portfolio.
  • Work closely with the Inside Sales Executive to ensure fast lead response, accurate lead qualification, timely quotation follow-up, CRM hygiene, and lead-to-order conversion.

Product-Specific Market Development

  • Develop HDBT-set opportunities with dialysis centres, hospital dialysis units, nephrology-focused institutions, and appropriate distributors.
  • Develop IV infusion-set, IV-cannula, and catheter opportunities with hospitals, nursing homes, clinics, government institutions, institutional buyers, and medical-supply distributors.
  • Develop the broader disposable portfolio according to approved commercial availability, product registration status, and target customer segment.
  • Ensure all product presentations, customer commitments, distributor materials, and tender submissions remain within approved technical, quality, regulatory, and commercial claims.

Marketing and Lead Generation

  • Plan and manage marketing campaigns across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, website, email, trade platforms, exhibitions, distributor meets, and other approved channels.
  • Develop product presentations, brochures, catalogues, company profiles, product comparison sheets, distributor kits, email campaigns, and sales-enablement materials in coordination with internal teams.
  • Build a lead-generation engine for domestic customers, distributors, institutions, and export partners.
  • Track marketing performance, including enquiries, qualified leads, conversion rate, cost per lead, campaign ROI, pipeline value, and channel-wise revenue contribution.
  • Gather and report competitor intelligence, price trends, customer feedback, product demand, distributor feedback, and market opportunities.

Institutional, Government and Tender Business

  • Develop a national institutional and government-sales strategy for HDBT sets, IV infusion sets, IV cannulas, catheters, and other eligible sterile disposable medical products.
  • Identify and build relationships with government hospitals, medical colleges, district hospitals, dialysis centres, public-health procurement bodies, and relevant healthcare institutions.
  • Lead tender pipeline development through GeM, CPPP, state e-procurement portals, TenderTiger, and institutional procurement channels.
  • Identify and qualify tenders containing HDBT sets, IV infusion sets, IV cannulas, catheters, hospital consumables, sterile disposable products, and related medical-supply categories.
  • Conduct formal bid/no-bid evaluations based on product fit, tender specifications, eligibility, available certificates, manufacturing capacity, delivery commitment, payment terms, EMD/security requirement, commercial viability, risk, and strategic value.
  • Lead pricing strategy for tenders, including approved minimum selling price, logistics costs, taxes, payment terms, gross-margin protection, and required internal approvals.
  • Review technical and commercial bid content before final submission in coordination with QA/RA, finance, operations, supply chain, and management.
  • Attend pre-bid meetings, customer meetings, technical discussions, distributor meetings, and reverse auctions where needed.
  • Build and maintain a reusable tender library of product specifications, compliance statements, certificates, declarations, catalogues, technical documents, approved commercial templates, and eligible past-performance documents.
  • Develop post-award execution plans covering purchase-order acceptance, production planning, delivery, invoicing, payment follow-up, performance-security requirements, and customer relationship management.
  • Analyze tender wins/losses, L1 pricing trends, competitor intelligence, disqualification reasons, and state-wise opportunity potential to improve future bid strategy.

Export Business Development

  • Research, prioritize, and develop export markets, starting with distributor and strategic-partner identification in the United States and other suitable countries.
  • Qualify potential export distributors based on market access, healthcare portfolio, regulatory capability, financial strength, sales coverage, customer base, inventory capability, and expected volume.
  • Conduct product/company presentations and lead commercial discussions with prospective export distributors and partners.
  • Support export quotations, distributor onboarding, annual forecasts, and commercial agreements in coordination with management.
  • Coordinate with QA/RA and operations for required documentation, approved product information, country-specific requirements, packaging/labeling inputs, and commercial readiness.
  • Maintain an accurate export opportunity pipeline and country-wise forecast in Zoho CRM.

CRM, Reporting and Internal Coordination

  • Maintain accurate opportunity records, account plans, distributor records, activity logs, campaign data, tender tracker, revenue forecast, and competitor feedback in Zoho CRM.
  • Provide weekly updates on leads, customer/distributor meetings, sales pipeline, tenders, campaign performance, risks, collections, and next actions.
  • Provide monthly product-wise, territory-wise, tender-wise, distributor-wise, and export-market forecasts.
  • Coordinate closely with QA/RA, production, supply chain, finance, logistics, and management before making product, delivery, tender, pricing, or regulatory commitments.

Required Skills

  • 48 years of experience in business development, marketing, channel sales, distributor management, hospital sales, institutional sales, government sales, tender sales, or export sales.
  • Preferred experience in medical devices, medical disposables, hospital consumables, IV therapy, infusion products, dialysis consumables, IV cannulas, catheters, surgical disposables, critical-care consumables, diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, or healthcare manufacturing.
  • Demonstrated ability to acquire distributors, develop B2B accounts, negotiate commercial terms, manage key accounts, and achieve sales targets.
  • Experience with institutional/government tendering, including GeM, CPPP, state e-procurement portals, TenderTiger, technical specifications, BOQ/commercial evaluation, compliance matrices, reverse auctions, and post-award execution.
  • Ability to understand product specifications, sizes/configurations, packaging, sterility-related documentation, and customer/tender requirements without making unapproved technical or clinical claims.
  • Strong knowledge of digital lead generation through social media, LinkedIn, email outreach, exhibitions, trade platforms, and partner networks.
  • Experience with Zoho CRM or another CRM platform, including pipeline management, forecasting, activity tracking, and sales reporting.
  • Strong presentation, communication, commercial negotiation, relationship-management, and analytical skills.
  • Strong English communication. Additional Indian languages are an advantage.
  • Willingness to travel across India and internationally as business requirements develop.

Preferred Candidate Profile

  • Experience launching or growing a medical-disposables, hospital-consumables, dialysis, infusion, IV-cannula, catheter, or healthcare-product portfolio.
  • Existing relationships with medical distributors, hospital procurement teams, dialysis centres, government-healthcare institutions, or institutional buyers.
  • Exposure to export distributor development, international B2B sales, international quotations, Incoterms, shipping coordination, product registration support, or country-level market development.
  • Experience in a startup, manufacturer, or high-growth environment where the employee has owned multiple commercial responsibilities.

Key Performance Indicators

  • New distributors appointed, trained, activated, and generating repeat sales.
  • New hospital, institutional, government, and key-account business secured.
  • Qualified pipeline value, new-business revenue, and gross margin.
  • Marketing-generated leads, lead-to-opportunity conversion, campaign ROI, and marketing-sourced revenue.
  • Government/institutional tender pipeline value, bids submitted, technical qualification rate, win rate, and award value.
  • Tender gross margin, approved pricing compliance, post-award execution, and collections.
  • Number and quality of export distributor prospects, qualified partners, and initial export opportunities.
  • Zoho CRM accuracy, forecast reliability, sales reporting discipline, and activity completion.
  • Competitor intelligence, market feedback, and state/country expansion opportunities identified.

Experience

48 years


Education

MBA/PGDM, B.Pharm, B.Sc., Biomedical, Life Sciences, Engineering, or equivalent preferred.

title: Team Lead
jobDescription:
Team Leader - New Tirupur Area Development Corporation Limited (NTADCL)

Project: NTADCL Combined Water Supply Scheme
Location: Tirupur, Tamil Nadu
Project Duration: 18 Months


About the Project:

The assignment involves Project Management Consultancy (PMC) for an 8.5 MLD Combined Water Supply Scheme supplying water to SIPCOT Defense Industrial Park, TIDCO Aerospace Industrial Park and TIDCO Semi-Conductor Industrial Park from NTADCL Water Distribution Station (WDS 24), Murugampalayam, Tirupur


Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the overall project management, construction management and contract administration activities.
  • Coordinate and manage the PMC team and ensure timely delivery of project outputs.
  • Supervise and monitor the Contractor's construction activities, quality, progress and contractual compliance.
  • Review project designs, drawings, technical specifications and estimates and ensure compliance with engineering standards.
  • Establish and monitor project Quality Assurance / Quality Control systems.
  • Coordinate with NTADCL, Contractors, SIPCOT, TIDCO, government departments and other stakeholders.
  • Monitor physical and financial progress and establish project performance monitoring and reporting systems.
  • Review contractual issues, variations, claims, extra items, new rates and extension-of-time requests and provide recommendations to the Client.
  • Assist in resolving contractual disputes and construction-related issues.
  • Support procurement, bid process management and contract award activities.
  • Oversee project planning, scheduling and monitoring using MS Project or similar project management software.
  • Conduct regular project review meetings and ensure preparation and circulation of minutes.
  • Ensure proper maintenance of project records, MIS and documentation.
  • Monitor compliance with safety, environmental and social safeguard requirements.
  • Assist the Client with statutory approvals, permits and coordination with government agencies.
  • Review and certify progress/payment-related submissions from Contractors.
  • Verify and certify as-built drawings and support completion and final acceptance of works.
  • Monitor defects during the Defects Liability Period and ensure rectification by the Contractor.
  • Prepare and submit periodic progress, quality, financial and other reports required by the Client.

Qualification

  • Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering.
  • Postgraduate qualification in Environmental Engineering / Public Health Engineering / Structural Engineering is preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum 15 years of total professional experience.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in construction management of water / wastewater projects.
  • Experience in a similar Team Leader / Construction Manager / Project Manager capacity.
  • Strong experience in construction supervision, contract administration and project management.
  • Sound knowledge of contract conditions and contract management is preferred.

Job Title


Payment Posting Executive U.S Medical Billing (US Healthcare) | Chennai

We are hiring Payment Posting Executives for our US Healthcare Medical Billing (RCM) process in Chennai. The role involves accurate posting of insurance and patient payments, ERAs/EOBs, adjustments, and denials into the billing system in line with client-specific guidelines and turnaround times.

title: Walk-in || Nursing Officer
jobDescription:
Role & responsibilities

a { text-decoration: none; color: #464feb; } tr th, tr td { border: 1px solid #e6e6e6; } tr th { background-color: #f5f5f5; }

Job Summary

The OT Nurse is responsible for providing comprehensive nursing care to patients before, during, and after surgical procedures. The role involves assisting surgeons and anesthetists, maintaining aseptic techniques, preparing operation theatres, handling surgical instruments, ensuring patient safety, and delivering high-quality perioperative nursing care in accordance with hospital policies and clinical protocols.

Key Responsibilities

Pre-Operative Responsibilities

  • Prepare and arrange operation theatre equipment, instruments, and consumables required for scheduled surgeries.
  • Verify patient identity, consent forms, investigations, and surgical site markings.
  • Ensure compliance with surgical safety checklists and infection control standards.
  • Prepare patients physically and psychologically for surgical procedures.
  • Coordinate with surgeons, anesthetists, and other healthcare teams regarding surgical requirements.

Intra-Operative Responsibilities

  • Assist surgeons and anesthetists during surgical procedures.
  • Maintain strict aseptic and sterile techniques throughout surgeries.
  • Perform duties as a Scrub Nurse and Circulating Nurse as required.
  • Count surgical instruments, sponges, and needles before, during, and after procedures.
  • Monitor patient safety and promptly report any concerns to the surgical team.
  • Handle, prepare, and maintain surgical equipment and instruments.

Post-Operative Responsibilities

  • Assist in transferring patients safely to the recovery area.
  • Monitor patients for immediate post-operative complications.
  • Complete surgical documentation accurately.
  • Ensure proper cleaning, sterilization, and maintenance of OT equipment and instruments.
  • Prepare the theatre for subsequent procedures.

Quality & Safety Responsibilities

  • Adhere to NABH, infection control, and patient safety guidelines.
  • Participate in code blue and emergency situations when required.
  • Report incidents, near misses, and equipment malfunctions promptly.
  • Ensure proper biomedical waste segregation and disposal.
  • Maintain confidentiality of patient information.

Qualification

  • B.Sc. Nursing / GNM Nursing from a recognized institution.
  • Valid State Nursing Council Registration.
  • Additional certification in OT Nursing or Critical Care will be an added advantage.

Experience

  • 2 to 10 years of experience in Operation Theatre Nursing.
  • Experience in handling major, minor, emergency, and specialty surgeries.
  • Exposure to specialties such as General Surgery, Orthopedics, Neuro Surgery, Cardiac Surgery, Gastro Surgery, Urology, Gynecology, or Transplant Surgery is preferred.

Job Description
Job description
Role Summary
The Senior Technology Project Manager leads the successful delivery of complex, strategic technology initiatives across the EMEA and APAC regions. The role is accountable for delivering projects from initiation through implementation and operational handover, ensuring outcomes are achieved within agreed scope, schedule, budget and quality parameters while maximising business value. Working closely with business stakeholders, engineering teams, vendors and senior leadership, the role provides strong governance, proactively manages risk and dependencies, and drives successful business outcomes through effective project leadership.
Job purpose
Lead the end-to-end delivery of technology projects and programmes, ensuring successful execution against agreed scope, schedule, budget and quality objectives while maintaining effective governance, stakeholder engagement, financial control and risk management
Key Responsibilities
Project Delivery
oLead multiple concurrent technology projects from initiation through to operational handover, ranging from medium to large scope and complexity (typically 100-1000+ effort days).
oDevelop, maintain and actively manage integrated project plans, delivery roadmaps and milestone schedules.
oDefine project scope, objectives, deliverables and success criteria.
oDrive project execution, ensuring delivery against agreed scope, schedule, budget, quality and business outcomes.
oCoordinate cross-functional delivery teams across multiple countries and time zones.
oMatrix-manage delivery teams across internal and external teams.
Stakeholder Management
oBuild trusted relationships with business sponsors, technology teams, business leaders and key stakeholders across the organisation.
oLead governance forums, steering committees and executive reporting, ensuring informed decision-making and effective escalation where required.
oManage stakeholder expectations and communicate project progress, risks and decisions effectively.
Risk, Governance Financial Management
oMaintain comprehensive RAID management, proactively identifying, assessing and mitigating risks, issues, assumptions and dependencies.
oOwn project financials, including budgeting, forecasting, cost control and financial reporting.
oEnsure compliance with Experian governance standards, security policies, architectural principles and applicable regulatory requirements.
oEscalate delivery risks appropriately and recommend mitigation strategies.
Delivery Excellence
oOperate with a high degree of autonomy, exercising sound judgement and making informed decisions in complex delivery environment
oLead the resolution of complex delivery challenges by balancing competing priorities, risks and stakeholder expectations.
oChampion Agile, Waterfall and hybrid delivery methodologies, selecting the most appropriate approach for successful project outcomes
oDrive continuous improvement through automation, data-driven reporting and responsible adoption of AI-enabled project management capabilities.
oSupport PMO reporting, governance standards and portfolio management activities.
oIdentify opportunities to improve delivery efficiency through automation and AI-enabled project management practices


Qualifications
Qualifications

  • Demonstrable experience (typically 7+ years) managing complex technology projects including infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity or enterprise technology implementations.
  • PMI Accredited Project Management Professional (PMP) qualification.

  • (Preferred) Agile certification (Scrum Master, SAFe, AgilePM or similar).
  • (Preferred) Experience working within global matrix organisations.

Position: Purchase Executive (Pharmaceutical)

About the jobOur Team: Drive Labeling Value to maximize Sanofis competitive advantage


Main responsibilities:

  • Prepare and/or update corporate labeling documents (CCDS, USPI and EU SmPC) and corresponding patient text for assigned marketed and life cycle products for company and/or agency approval.
  • Coordination of labeling review and approval throughout the E2E labeling process, which includes preparation of labeling components for submission to regulatory agencies, participation in labeling negotiations with agencies resulting in product approvals or labeling updates, and release of labeling for use throughout the company for mature/marketed products.
  • Support cross-functional teams (LWG) as a labeling expert and contribute to the global regulatory strategy and to the preparation of of labeling components of submission dossiers or responses to Health Authorities
  • For the maintenance and compliance of existing Marketing Authorizations (be a member of Response Teams within procedures such as European Arbitration/referrals, or work sharing, PRAC questions (signal detection)
  • Anticipates any hurdles and informs manager as appropriate
  • Coordinate and create the presentation of labeling proposals to be presented to Senior Executive Management via Labeling Review Committee
  • Perform labeling competitive/comparator analysis
  • Meet established submission timelines and quality standard for labeling deliverables
  • Chairs multi-disciplinary labeling working groups, presenting labeling proposals and developing/reaching consensus on proposals resulting in presentation of labeling proposals to the Labeling Governance Committee for internal approval of proposed labeling.


About you

  • Experience: Knowledge of the principles and concepts of Labeling (including generics), and the dynamics of Labeling Team purpose and objectives.
  • Knowledge of labeling requirements for drugs (CCDS EU, US); organizational and networking skills; and ability to coordinate discussions across a multi-functional group (LWG) to reach resolution on labeling topics.

  • Ability to connect regulatory strategy into labeling strategy
  • Ability to work autonomously for routine tasks but needs oversight on more complex topics (as needed)

  • Must be able to construct a Company Response (MAH response) for health authority (EU/US) questions related to labeling

  • Defined experience requirement: 3-5 years of relevant industry or functional experience.
  • Technical skills: Highly detail oriented, strong analytical and organization skills, project management skills, self-starter, critical thinking required, ability to network and coordinate discussions across all levels of the company to reach resolution on labeling topics. Ability to build/learn scientific knowledge (e.g. statistics, disease area).Ability to search for public data on labeling elements (enabling digital capabilities)

jobDescription:
Job Summary

We are looking for a creative and results-driven Social Media Content Creator & Marketing Executive to manage and grow the digital presence of our London-based pharmaceutical company. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in social media content creation, digital marketing, and audience engagement across multiple platforms. Candidates with graphic designing skills will have an added advantage.


Key Responsibilities

  • Create engaging and high-quality content for social media platforms including LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X (Twitter), and YouTube.
  • Plan, schedule, and manage social media content calendars aligned with marketing campaigns.
  • Develop creative posts, reels, short videos, carousels, and promotional content related to the pharmaceutical and healthcare industry.
  • Manage day-to-day social media activities, including publishing posts and engaging with the audience.
  • Monitor social media performance and prepare regular analytics and performance reports.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to create marketing campaigns and product awareness content.
  • Research industry trends, competitor activities, and healthcare-related topics to create relevant content.
  • Support digital marketing initiatives to increase brand visibility and audience engagement.
  • Maintain brand consistency across all digital platforms.

Required Skills

  • Strong communication skills in English (written and verbal).
  • Expertise in social media content creation and content planning.
  • Hands-on experience in social media marketing and audience engagement.
  • Knowledge of Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or other graphic designing tools is preferred.
  • Experience creating reels, short-form videos, and visual content for social media.
  • Understanding of social media analytics and performance metrics.
  • Creative thinking with attention to detail and branding.

Preferred Candidate Profile

  • 3 - 5 years of experience in social media content creation and digital marketing.
  • Experience handling healthcare, pharmaceutical, wellness, or life sciences brands will be an added advantage.
  • Basic graphic designing and video editing skills are preferred.
  • Self-motivated, creative, and comfortable working in a remote environment.

What We Offer

  • Remote work opportunity with a London-based pharmaceutical company.
  • Exposure to international healthcare and pharmaceutical marketing.
  • Competitive salary based on experience and skills.
  • Opportunity to work on global digital marketing campaigns and brand-building initiatives.

jobDescription:
Security Operation Center (SOC) Tier1/Level 1

Incedo is a US-based consulting, data science and technology services firm with over 2,000 people helping clients from our six offices across US and India. We help our clients achieve competitive advantage through end-to-end digital transformation. Our uniqueness lies in bringing together strong engineering, data science, and design capabilities coupled with deep domain understanding. We combine services and products to maximize business impact for our clients in telecom, financial services, product engineering and life science & healthcare industries.

Working at Incedo will provide you an opportunity to work with industry leading client organizations, deep technology and domain experts, and global teams. Incedo University, our learning platform, provides ample learning opportunities starting with a structured onboarding program and carrying throughout various stages of your career. A variety of fun activities is also an integral part of our friendly work environment. Our flexible career paths allow you to grow into a program manager, a technical architect or a domain expert based on your skills and interests.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The SOC Analyst (Level 1) will use a variety of tools to investigate incidents and take immediate action or recommend a course of action to safeguard Incedos Managed Services Clients. The SOC Analyst (Level 1) is responsible for monitoring and responding to security related alerts triggered in the SIEM tool within Incedos Technology Partners Managed Service Clients. Primary responsibilities include incident triage, correlation of data from firewall, endpoint security, SASE and IPS logs; determining if a critical system or data set has been impacted; provides recommendations on remediation; and provides support for new analytic methods for detecting threats.


Role and responsibilities:

  • Ensure that all SOC (Security Operations Center) tickets are handled and resolved within SLAs (Service Level Agreements).
  • Perform detailed analysis of threats and security events, using sound analytical skills, knowledge, and experience, with a clear narrative to support conclusions.
  • Maintain records of security events investigated, detailed notes of security incident resolution, and incident response activities, utilizing ticketing systems.
  • Make situational incident response recommendations based on best practice security policies that address the client’s business need.
  • Research and stay up to date with current security vulnerabilities, attacks, threat actors, security advisories and the MITRE Attack Framework.
  • Manage, maintain, and monitor security alerting systems from remote communications sites to ensure company compliance.
  • Create and run search queries in SIEM tool to help with identifying and troubleshooting security issues.
  • Utilize tools (e.g., Wireshark, Nmap, PCap, etc.) to identify and map devices on the network.
  • Open, track and close trouble tickets.
  • Answer incoming hot line calls and monitor various e-mail accounts and act according to SOC procedures and processes.
  • Interface with client through email, phone calls, and meetings or Aspire field personnel to mitigate security incidents.
  • Assist with the preparation of SOC reports, research papers, and blog posts.
  • Investigate and provide technical analysis of various security incidents and possible compromise of systems.
  • Works as Tier I/L1 support and will work directly with Tier II/L2 and TIER III/L3 and NOC Engineers for issue resolution.
  • Provide direct communication to affected users and companies on security incidents and maintenance activities.
  • Maintain customer technical information within defined documentation standards.
  • Obtain/maintain technical/professional certifications applicable to position or as directed.
  • Communicate with customers, peers, team, and managers regarding incident and change management.
  • Provide emergency on-call support on a rotating schedule.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications: Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Experience of 2 to 3 years relevant experience.
    • 1+ year of professional work experience in cyber security field
    • 1+ year of experience with Security Event / Alert Management, Incident Response, and Change Management Processes
    • 1+ year of experience handling security events related to Malware Detection and Analysis, Indicators of Compromise (IOC), Email Phishing, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR)
    • Knowledge of Runbooks, Playbooks and following Standard Operating Procedures

Shift Details: 24X7 3 Shifts Rotation

Work Location: Gurgaon
