title: Pediatrician
jobDescription:
Job Title: Associate Professor (Department of Paediatrics)


Primary Healthcare Landmark Northeast Region Location: Regional Capital City, Northeast India Facility: 500-bed, Nationally Accredited Multi-Super Speciality Teaching Hospital Academic Affiliation: Prominent, decades-old University


Role Summary The Associate Professor in Paediatrics will occupy a pivotal faculty position within a leading multi-super speciality teaching hospital that serves as the primary healthcare landmark for the Northeast region. This role requires a senior academician and clinician capable of integrating high-level clinical care with rigorous medical education and research. Operating within a facility equipped with 24x7 advanced diagnostic imaging and extensive intensive care units (NICU/PICU), the successful candidate will mentor the next generation of medical professionals while delivering expert care in a broad range of paediatric medical services.


Mandatory Qualifications and Eligibility Criteria Applicants must strictly adhere to the National Medical Commission (NMC) Teachers


Eligibility Qualifications.


Academic Qualifications

  • MBBS degree from a recognised medical institution.
  • MD, MS, or DNB in Paediatrics from an NMC/MCI recognised university or college.

Experience

  • A minimum of 4 years of teaching experience as an Assistant Professor in Paediatrics in a recognised medical college or teaching institution.
  • Completion of 1 year as a Senior Resident in Paediatrics in a recognised medical college after acquiring the postgraduate degree.
  • Priority will be given to candidates with extensive work experience in recognised university or college settings, demonstrating a proven track record in academic administration and bedside teaching.

Research and Publications

  • Must have at least two research publications as per the latest NMC guidelines.
  • Publications must be original papers, meta-analyses, systematic reviews, or case series published in journals indexed in Medline, PubMed, Central Science Citation Index, Science Citation Index Expanded, Embase, Scopus, or Directory of Open Access Journals (DOAJ).
  • Should have completed the Basic Course in Medical Education Technology (BCMET) and the Basic Course in Biomedical Research (BCBR) from NMC-designated institutions.

Core Responsibilities and Technical Expertise


Clinical Excellence

  • Provide expert paediatric care in a 500-bed multi-super speciality environment, overseeing the management of complex cases in General Paediatrics and sub-specialities.
  • Supervise and provide high-level clinical input in the 24x7 Intensive Care Units (NICU/PICU) and Emergency Paediatric services.
  • Utilise advanced diagnostic imaging and laboratory data to formulate precise treatment plans for acute and chronic childhood illnesses.

Academic Leadership

  • Deliver structured theoretical lectures, seminars, and clinical bedside teaching for undergraduate (MBBS) and postgraduate (MD/DNB) students.
  • Facilitate Competency-Based Medical Education (CBME) and evaluate student performance through formative and summative assessments.
  • Mentor postgraduate students in thesis formulation, research methodology, and evidence-based clinical practices.

Research and Innovation

  • Lead and participate in departmental research initiatives, ensuring adherence to ethical standards and contributing to the institution’s academic output.
  • Foster a culture of inquiry by staying abreast of contemporary advances in child health and regional health challenges.

Administrative and Supervisory Duties

  • Assist the Head of Department in managing clinical rotations, curriculum development, and departmental administration.
  • Ensure rigorous documentation of clinical case details, including morbidity and mortality data, for institutional and regulatory audits.
  • Participate in interdisciplinary collaborations with other super-speciality departments to ensure holistic patient management.

Subject-Specific Expertise

  • In-depth knowledge of growth and development, neonatal care, and paediatric infectious diseases.
  • Proficiency in performing and teaching essential paediatric procedures and neonatal resuscitation.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Salary: 22,00,000 to 24,00,000 per annum (commensurate with experience and academic credentials).
  • Professional environment within a long-standing, prestigious institution affiliated with a prominent, decades-old university known for academic excellence.
  • Opportunities for career progression and involvement in high-impact regional health initiatives

title: Nephrologist
jobDescription:
Role: Consultant Nephrologist


Organization Overview

This position is with a nationally accredited, 500-bed, multi-super speciality teaching hospital located in a major regional capital city. Established decades ago, the facility stands as the primary healthcare landmark for the Northeast region, housed in a nine-storied structure with over 300,000 square feet of floor space. The institution is academically affiliated with a prominent, decades-old University renowned for excellence in medical education and healthcare.


The hospital is equipped with state-of-the-art infrastructure, including 13 general specialities, multiple super-speciality departments, and 12 dedicated operation theatres. It provides comprehensive 24x7 services, including a fully equipped trauma care unit and advanced diagnostic imaging featuring 1.5 Tesla MRI, 64-slice CT scan, and digital X-ray facilities. Critical care capabilities are extensive, supported by 46 well-equipped ICU beds (covering ICU, SICU, NICU, PICU, CCU, and ITU) and round-the-clock emergency services.


Role Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and dedicated Nephrologist to join our team as a Clinical Practitioner. The successful candidate will manage the diagnosis and treatment of kidney-related diseases, providing expert care to inpatients and outpatients. While the role is primarily clinical and does not require an extensive academic portfolio, the institution places a high priority on candidates who possess relevant work experience within recognized university or medical college hospital settings.


Key Responsibilities

  • Clinical Management: Provide comprehensive clinical care for patients with acute and chronic kidney diseases, electrolyte imbalances, hypertension, and other renal disorders.
  • Dialysis Services: Oversee and manage the Dialysis Unit, which is equipped with modern hemodialysis machines (currently 8 units, including isolation facilities) and expertise in Continuous Ambulatory Peritoneal Dialysis (CAPD).
  • Critical Care Nephrology: Collaborate with the intensive care team to manage complex cases requiring renal replacement therapy (CRRT, SLED) in the 46-bed ICU setup.
  • Patient Consultation: Conduct regular outpatient consultations, providing holistic treatment plans that include lifestyle modification and dietary guidance in coordination with nutritionists.
  • Interdepartmental Collaboration: Work closely with General Medicine, Cardiology, Urology, and other specialities to ensure a multidisciplinary approach to patient care, particularly for diabetic and hypertensive nephropathy.
  • Procedures: Perform necessary nephrological procedures such as renal biopsies and placement of temporary vascular access for dialysis.
  • Quality Assurance: Adhere to national accreditation standards (NABH protocols) and hospital policies to ensure the highest quality of patient safety and care delivery.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Essential Post-Graduate Qualification: M.D. or DNB in General Medicine or Paediatrics from a recognized institution.
  • Required Super Speciality Qualification: D.M. in Nephrology (Recognized by the National Medical Commission) / M.Ch Nephrology.
  • Experience: 1 to 4 years of experience post-completion of the super specialization (D.M.) / M.Ch Nephrology.
  • Experience Preference: Crucially, priority will be given to candidates who have gained their experience in recognized university or teaching hospital settings.
  • Note: Experience is strictly counted only after the completion of the super specialization.

Compensation

  • Salary Range: INR 3.5 Lakhs to INR 4.5 Lakhs per month.
  • Determination: Final offer will be commensurate with the candidate's specific post-DM / M.Ch experience and expertise.

Additional Information

  • Nature of Role: This is a full-time Clinical Practitioner position.
  • Academic Profile: While an academic profile (publications, research) is not mandatory, the clinical expertise gained in an academic environment is highly valued.
  • Facility Highlights: The selected candidate will practice in a facility that acts as a tertiary care referral centre for the entire state and neighbouring regions, backed by comprehensive support services including a 24-hour central laboratory and blood bank.

We are looking for a skilled Mobile Application Tester to ensure the quality, performance, and usability of mobile applications across Android and iOS platforms. The candidate will be responsible for manual and automation testing of mobile apps to deliver high-quality user experiences.

title: B Tech Intern | AI & Robotics Products Smart Hospital
jobDescription:
Job Description B.Tech Intern | AI & Robotics Products – Smart Hospital

Position

B.Tech Intern – AI & Robotics Product | Smart Hospital Project

Location

Gurugram / Delhi NCR

Internship Type

Full-Time Internship | Freshers

About the Role

We are looking for a B.Tech fresher with an interest in Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Automation, and Healthcare Technology to support our Smart Hospital Project.

The intern will work on AI and Robotics products for hospitals, including product research, technology evaluation, market intelligence, competitor analysis, use-case identification, and product implementation support.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to build a career at the intersection of AI + Robotics + Healthcare + Product Management.

Key Responsibilities

AI & Robotics Product Research

  • Research emerging AI, Robotics, Automation, and Smart Hospital products.
  • Identify AI and robotic solutions that can be implemented in hospitals.
  • Study products from global and Indian AI/Robotics OEMs and technology companies.
  • Evaluate product features, technology, applications, pricing, and business models.
  • Prepare comparative analysis of competing AI and Robotics products.

Smart Hospital Use Cases

  • Understand hospital workflows and identify opportunities for AI and robotic automation.
  • Research applications such as:
    • Robotic delivery and transportation
    • Pharmacy automation
    • Disinfection robots
    • Patient assistance robots
    • AI-based hospital workflow automation
    • AI-powered diagnostics and decision-support solutions
    • Smart inventory and asset management
    • AI-based patient monitoring
    • Autonomous navigation and service robots

Product & Market Analysis

  • Conduct market research to identify market size, customer segments, competitors, and emerging technologies.
  • Build databases of AI and Robotics products, OEMs, distributors, and hospital applications.
  • Analyze product specifications, technical capabilities, and commercial viability.
  • Support preparation of Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), product comparison sheets, and business cases.
  • Track new product launches and technology developments.

Technical & Data Support

  • Support basic AI/ML, Python, data analysis, and automation activities.
  • Assist in testing and evaluating AI/Robotics products and Proof of Concepts (PoCs).
  • Analyze product and market data and prepare dashboards/reports.
  • Work with technical and business teams to convert hospital requirements into potential product solutions.

Required Qualification

  • B.Tech / B.E. – Freshers
  • Preferred specialization:
    • Computer Science
    • Artificial Intelligence
    • Machine Learning
    • Robotics
    • Data Science
    • Information Technology
    • Electronics & Communication
    • Related Engineering disciplines

Required Skills

  • Basic understanding of AI / Machine Learning.
  • Basic knowledge of Robotics and Automation.
  • Basic programming knowledge, preferably Python.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to conduct technology and market research.
  • Good knowledge of MS Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Interest in understanding technology products and their business applications.

Preferred Skills

Candidates having exposure to any of the following will be preferred:

  • Generative AI / LLM
  • Computer Vision
  • Machine Learning
  • Robotics
  • IoT
  • Autonomous Systems
  • Python / AI Libraries
  • Data Analytics / Power BI
  • RPA / Process Automation
  • APIs and software integration
  • Healthcare Technology / Hospital IT

Key Competencies

  • Technology Curiosity
  • Product Thinking
  • Analytical Ability
  • Market Research
  • Problem Solving
  • Learning Agility
  • Communication & Presentation
  • Interest in Healthcare Innovation

Internship Outcome

The selected intern will get hands-on exposure to AI and Robotics product evaluation and Smart Hospital transformation, including:

Technology Research Product Evaluation Hospital Use Case Competitor Analysis PoC Business Feasibility Product Recommendation

Who Should Apply?

We are looking for a B.Tech fresher who is passionate about AI and Robotics and wants to understand how emerging technologies can be converted into real healthcare products and solutions.

Freshers with strong AI/Robotics project work, academic projects, hackathons, or certifications are encouraged to apply.Role & responsibilities

Sales & Marketing Intern Full-Time Conversion Opportunity


Role Type: 3-Month Paid Internship with Full-Time Conversion Opportunity


Function: Field Sales + Marketing


About the Role

We are looking for an energetic, confident and execution-oriented person who enjoys meeting people, building relationships and creating marketing content.


This is a hands-on role combining field sales and marketing. You will spend time visiting apartment communities and corporate offices, identifying the right decision-makers, creating opportunities for us to reach their communities/employees, and helping close partnerships.

You will also help create marketing content for both online and offline campaigns.


This is not a desk-only marketing role. You should be comfortable going into the field, approaching new people and starting conversations.


What You Will Do

Field Sales & Partnerships

  • Visit apartment communities, residential societies and corporate offices across Bangalore.
  • Meet apartment association representatives, presidents, committee members, facility managers, HR/Admin teams and other decision-makers.
  • Identify and obtain the contact details of the right decision-maker.
  • Build relationships and create a channel for us to communicate with apartment residents or corporate employees.
  • Get permission/opportunities to run promotions, events, campaigns or other marketing activities within these communities.
  • Follow up with prospects and move opportunities forward.
  • Present our offering clearly and confidently.
  • Where appropriate, negotiate and close partnerships/deals.
  • Maintain a simple pipeline of visits, contacts, follow-ups, opportunities and conversions.
  • Learn from what works in the field and suggest better ways to acquire customers.

Marketing & Content

  • Create simple, engaging marketing content for Instagram, WhatsApp and other digital channels.
  • Create content and messaging for posters, flyers, standees, apartment campaigns and offline events.
  • Take photos/videos and create short-form content from field activities.
  • Come up with creative campaign ideas to generate awareness and leads.
  • Work with the team to test different messages, offers and marketing approaches.

Who We Are Looking For

You don't need years of experience. We care more about your communication, confidence, attitude and ability to get things done.


You should:

  • Be comfortable speaking in English, Hindi, and any other launguages and communicating with new people.
  • Be confident approaching people you have never met before.
  • Have good interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
  • Be willing to travel locally and spend significant time in the field.
  • Be persistent with follow-ups and comfortable hearing "no."
  • Have an interest in sales, marketing and business development.
  • Be comfortable creating basic marketing content.
  • Be proactive and able to work independently.

2026 graduates and freshers are welcome to apply.


What Success Looks Like

Your success will primarily be measured by:

Apartment/Corporate Visits Decision-Maker Contacts Marketing Access/Partnerships Leads Conversions

For marketing, we will look at the quality and consistency of content and campaigns you create and how they contribute to awareness and customer acquisition.


Full-Time Opportunity


This is a 3-month paid internship designed as a pathway to a full-time Sales & Marketing role.

Strong performers who demonstrate ownership, communication skills, field execution and the ability to generate business will be considered for a full-time offer after the internship.


If you enjoy being in the field, meeting people, creating things and seeing your work directly contribute to business growth, we'd love to hear from you.

jobDescription:
Customer Strategy & Design | Pricing Strategy - Consultant

THE TEAM

The Customer” offering portfolio integrates our most differentiated, globally recognized “customer” businesses. It focuses on owning the commercial agenda through growth strategy, enhanced user experiences, and engagement through the entire customer lifecycle.

Customer Strategy and Design (CS&D) offering, as part of Customer portfolio, helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, customer engagement and service strategies, channel strategies, sales strategies, and pricing strategies.

Deloitte’s Pricing Strategy practice is a part of the CS&D offering and helps clients address the spectrum of revenue management strategies, processes and to align the organization's capabilities with its business, market, and channel strategies. Starting with the drivers of customer value and layering on transaction-level analysis and insight, we help companies disaggregate their business for them to see its many parts, identify the economic value of each product and customer and devise ways to communicate and deliver that value to customers at prices that meet profit objectives and improves overall market value, design the sales and service capabilities to bring the commercial strategy to market, enable commercial agility by selecting the technology platforms required to support the commercial agenda.

The USI Pricing Strategy team works in close collaboration with US teams to design and implement pricing strategies, processes and solutions that generate significant impact for its clients. This practice works on pricing, commercial transformation, and platform design across all sectors. The team includes recognized thought leaders and specialists in advanced data modeling with decades of collective experience base built from the delivery of multiple pricing and commercial transformation projects across a wide range of industry settings.

WORK YOU’LL DO

As part of the Pricing Strategy team, you shall be responsible for providing clients with strategic advice, market-leading practices, and tools, along with proven and pragmatic solutions to make better, more profitable pricing decisions. As part of your role, you may be required to, but not limited to:

1. Pricing and Commercial Strategy Development:

  • Design and implement comprehensive pricing strategies based on market research, competitive analysis, and financial modeling.
  • Work with product management / sales / Account/ Finance / Brand client teams to align pricing strategies with market positioning and business goals.
  • Develop appropriate pricing models, technology design and capabilities to effectively capture true value of products and services.
  • Assist clients with building value-based pricing solutions to ensure maximum potential.
  • Develop segmented pricing and offering structures based on customer willingness to pay and perceived value.
  • Assist clients in establishing promotional objectives and a toolkit to track and measure promotion effectiveness.
  • Support clients in driving favorable perception by identifying key value items and establish a merchandising strategy that optimizes store performance.
  • Analyze current process & future requirements to design a win-win Commercial investment frameworks for client and their trade partners.

2. Data Analysis and Financial Modeling:

  • Analyze pricing data and market insights to identify trends and opportunities for optimization.
  • Develop and maintain sophisticated financial models to forecast the impact of pricing decisions.
  • Analyze the significant pricing drivers, conduct transactional level analysis, and evaluate various pricing/revenue optimization opportunities based on potential financial and business impact to support clients with the best feasible solution for long term sustained benefit realization.

3. Pricing Process and capability assessment:

  • Analyze client’s current CPQ (Configure-Price-Quote) process and capabilities to develop strategic recommendations for maximizing return on commercial productivity solutions.
  • Implement pricing solutions to achieve profitable growth and improve both top- and bottom- line performance for clients.
  • Facilitate adoption of new pricing tools and methodologies to maximize the benefits of pricing transformation program.
  • Oversee the implementation of pricing strategies and tools.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of pricing strategies and make recommendations for continuous improvement.

4. Stakeholder Engagement:

  • Collaborate with senior management and key stakeholders to gather inputs and align pricing strategies with overall business objectives.
  • Present pricing analysis and strategic recommendations to stakeholders and executive leadership.

5. Market Intelligence:

  • Keep abreast of industry trends and regulatory changes that may affect pricing strategies.
  • Conduct competitor analysis to benchmark pricing and promotional strategies.
  • Assess current performance and pricing capabilities & policies; benchmark them against industry leading practices and assist with (re)design of the pricing process and developing a target operation model.
  • Understand and apply pricing research methodology including survey design, analysis, and application of findings.

6. Market Access:

  • Design and implement innovative pricing strategies for pharmaceuticals, and biotechnology products.
  • Develop comprehensive market access plans that include pricing, reimbursement, and patient access strategies.
  • Engage with key stakeholders including payers, healthcare providers, and patient advocacy groups to gather insights and support effective market access strategies.
  • Ensure that all pricing strategies comply with local and international healthcare laws and regulations.
  • Work closely with clinical, regulatory, and commercial teams to integrate clinical and economic evidence into market access strategies.

You will drive commercial growth by supporting colleagues with practice development & eminence and acting as a key topic content lead for proposals or other business development work in the Pricing space.

You will also contribute towards building Pricing expertise within Deloitte and increase firm’s external profile by creating new solutions and methodologies, publishing ideas and thought leadership, and building repeatable toolkits for use by project teams.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

Deloitte is looking for an Experienced Practitioner with deep content expertise in Pricing strategy and technology, strong industry experience along with good analytical skills to be part of the Pricing & Commercialization Strategy practice.

  • Professional experience: Experience in strategy consulting from consulting firms, Big 4 firms, OR experience within pricing department in industry with a focus on pricing strategy, planning and technology.
  • Industry experience: across below listed industries is preferable.
  • Retail, Consumer Goods & Industrial Products
  • Telecom, Media & Technology
  • Life Sciences & Healthcare
  • Energy & Industrial

Good understanding of how businesses price the products and services to different customers in a B2B or B2C or B2B2C environment. Resource Pricing or BFSI Industry experience is not required.

  • Pricing skills: in one or more of the following areas - pricing/revenue management, promotions management, pricing strategy, price setting & execution, transactional pricing analysis, pricing transformation, quantitative methodologies, pricing technology, CPQ process and technology transformation.
  • Core Consulting skills: Managing the pace and delivery of projects including coordination with key project stakeholders, reporting key findings, and contributing to the wider business unit through business development, knowledge sharing and other activities.
  • Analytical skills: A strong technical foundation in building analytical solutions and experience with complex data sets, performing quantitative analysis (descriptive and prescriptive) and research (primary and secondary); synthesizing and presenting insights and recommendations from data.
  • Tools experience: Working proficiency in any of the data analytics and visualization tools preferred – Tableau, PowerBI, R, SQL, VBA etc.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • MBA from a premier school in India or abroad
  • 2 - 3 years for Consultants

Preferred Qualification

  • Exposure to working in non-India Geographies (preferably US) and/or interacting with global stakeholders.

HOW YOU’LL GROW

At Deloitte, we have invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities— including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. No two people experience learning same way. So, we provide a range of resources including live classrooms, team-based learning, and eLearning. DU: The Leadership Center in India, our state-of- the-art, world-class learning Center in the Hyderabad offices is an extension of the DU in Westlake, Texas, and represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to our people’s growth and development. BENEFITS

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

DELOITTE’S CULTURE

Our positive and supportive culture encourages our people to do their best every day. We celebrate individuals by recognizing their uniqueness and offering them the flexibility to make daily choices that can help them to be healthy, centered, confident, and aware. We offer comprehensive well- being programs and are continuously looking for new ways to maintain a culture that is inclusive, invites authenticity, leverages our diversity, and where our people excel and lead happy lives. Learn more about Life at Deloitte.

CORPORATE CITIZENSHIP

Deloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to the relationships that we have with our clients, our people, and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill- based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities. Position: Relationship Manager (Pharmaceutical Companies)

Position Purpose

Strategic Business Development - Pharmaceutical Companies

  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities and follow up on opportunities identified by Axios business leaders for new projects or for expanding projects with the pharmaceutical industry at local and regional levels
  • Capture business development opportunities in the business development CRM. Similarly capture stakeholder insights in the related database.
  • Request, support and present compelling business proposals and presentations to potential clients
  • Conduct competitive analysis and market research to identify growth opportunities and understand the local changes that may affect business opportunities as well as Axios projects
  • Present monthly business opportunity reports using the CRM with clear metrics and KPIs
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers in pharmaceutical companies

  • Attend industry events, conferences, or networking sessions
  • Represent, the company at trade shows and industry forums
  • Monitor industry regulations and policy changes that may impact Axios' business operations, providing strategic guidance and advocacy as needed.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on Axios' programs, services, and industry trends, providing training and support to internal teams and external stakeholders as needed.

Technical skills, Professional skills and competencies

  • Deep understanding of pharmaceutical industry regulations, compliance requirements, and market dynamics
  • Proficiency in CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite
  • Experience in patient support programs or market access is a plus

Excellent presentation and communication skills in English Strong negotiation and closing abilities



Educational Background and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, MBA, or related field
  • 5+ years Experience working with pharmaceutical services companies (consulting, quality assurance, marketing agency, patient support program provider or regulatory affairs)
  • Proven track record of achieving business development targets and driving business growth across the pharma sector specifically.
  • Extensive network of contacts within the pharmaceutical industry (key decision-makers, procurement managers, quality heads, regulatory professionals) at local and regional levels.
  • Network extending to healthcare providers, hospitals, pharmaceutical distributors, wholesalers, supply chain partners and pharmacy chains
  • Fluency in English and Local Languages is essential for this role

Job Circumstances

  • The position is based in Mumbai, India and it requires frequent travel to client sites across local and regional territories and other sites to represent Axios
  • Flexibility in the ability to travel as well as working hours is essential.
  • Frequent travel required to client sites across local and regional territories.
  • Attendance at industry events, including occasional evening or weekend activities.

jobDescription:
Subject Matter Expert

Walk In Drive 24th August 2026 to 25th August 2026


Job Description


At Enovis we pay attention to the details. We embrace collaboration with our partners and patients and take pride in the pursuit of scientific excellence with the goal of transforming medical technology as we know it.

Because thats how we change the lives of patients for the better. And thats how we create better together. Why work at Enovis? See for yourself.

As a key member of the Revenue Cycle Management team, you will play an integral part in helping Enovis drive the medical technology industry forward by transforming patient care and improving patient outcomes.

Job Title: Subject Matter Expert

Location: Hyderabad, India

Business Unit: Revenue Cycle Management


Role Summary:
The Subject Matter Expert serves as a bridge between clinical documentation and revenue cycle operations, ensuring accurate medical record review, coding support, charge capture validation, payer compliance, and denial prevention. This role collaborates with healthcare providers, coders, billing teams, and payers to optimize reimbursement while maintaining compliance with US healthcare regulations and payer guidelines.

The position requires strong communication skills, analytical abilities, and knowledge of revenue cycle management (RCM) to resolve claim issues, reduce outstanding AR, and improve cash flow. Additionally, the Senior Process Executive will mentor junior associates and contribute to process improvements.

This is an incredible opportunity to work in a fast-moving, patient-focused setting amongst extraordinarily talented professionals dedicated to making life-changing innovations possible in orthopedics and beyond with brands such as DonJoy, Aircast, ProCare and Exos.


Key Responsibilities:

Clinical Documentation Review

  • Review medical records to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with payer requirements.
  • Identify documentation gaps that may impact coding accuracy and reimbursement.
  • Support Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI) initiatives.
  • Educate providers on documentation best practices.

Revenue Cycle Support

  • Analyze claims for documentation-related denials and underpayments.
  • Assist in resolving clinical denials, medical necessity denials, and authorization-related denials.
  • Review appeals and prepare supporting clinical documentation.
  • Ensure accurate charge capture and reimbursement optimization.

Coding & Compliance Collaboration

  • Work closely with medical coders to ensure accurate ICD-10-CM, CPT, and HCPCS coding.
  • Validate medical necessity requirements based on payer policies.
  • Monitor compliance with CMS, Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payer regulations.
  • Support internal and external audits.

Denial Management

  • Investigate denied claims and identify root causes.
  • Prepare clinical appeal letters and supporting documentation.
  • Track denial trends and recommend corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with AR and billing teams to reduce denial rates.

Required Skills


Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Nursing, Life Sciences, Healthcare Administration, Pharmacy, or related healthcare field.
  • RN (Registered Nurse), BPT, B.Pharma, M.Pharma, or equivalent clinical qualification preferred.

Experience

  • 2–5+ years of experience in US Healthcare RCM, Clinical Documentation Review, CDI, Utilization Management, or Denial Management.
  • Experience working with Medicare, Medicaid, and Commercial Insurance payers.
  • Knowledge of medical necessity guidelines and payer policies.

Technical Knowledge

Candidate should have an understanding of:

  • ICD-10-CM
  • CPT/HCPCS coding fundamentals
  • Medical terminology
  • Anatomy and physiology
  • CMS guidelines
  • Revenue Cycle Management processes
  • EMR/EHR systems

Preferred Certifications

  • Certified Clinical Documentation Specialist (CCDS)
  • Certified Documentation Improvement Practitioner (CDIP)
  • CPC, CCS, or CRC certification
  • RN License (if applicable)

jobDescription:
Medical Billing Specialist | US Healthcare | Noida


Location: Noida

Work Mode: Work from Office / Hybrid

Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Medical Billing Specialist with hands-on experience in US Medical Billing and Revenue Cycle Management (RCM). The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of claims processing, insurance verification, payment posting, AR follow-up, denial management and healthcare billing workflows.


Key Responsibilities

  • Handle end-to-end US Medical Billing and Revenue Cycle Management activities. 
  • Review patient and insurance information for billing accuracy. 
  • Perform insurance eligibility and benefits verification where applicable. 
  • Prepare and submit medical claims to insurance payers. 
  • Monitor claim status and perform timely claims follow-up. 
  • Investigate and resolve claim denials, rejections and billing discrepancies. 
  • Perform Accounts Receivable follow-up and work on outstanding claims. 
  • Post insurance and patient payments accurately. 
  • Review EOBs, ERAs and payer responses and take appropriate action. 
  • Perform charge entry and billing-related data validation where applicable. 
  • Coordinate with healthcare providers, insurance companies and internal teams to resolve billing issues. 
  • Maintain accurate billing records and documentation. 
  • Follow established US healthcare billing procedures and productivity standards. 
  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA and applicable company policies. 
  • Identify recurring billing issues and support process improvement initiatives.

Epic, Cerner, Athenahealth, AdvancedMD, Kareo, NextGen, eClinicalWorks, Waystar, Change Healthcare, Availity, Microsoft Excel; experience with other EHR, EMR, practice management or RCM platforms will also be considered.


Healthcare Billing & Compliance Knowledge

Qualifications & Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Life Sciences or a related field.

tagsAndSkills: Behavioural Training,Capability Building,Skill Development,Training And Development,Leadership Training,Learning And Development,Sales Training,Training
jobDescription:
Job Title: DGM/Sr. DGM- Sales Leadership Capability (L&D)
Skills: Non-Technical training, Soft skills training, interpersonal skills training, professional skills training, capability development training

Experience: 10-15 years
Qualification: MBA or equivalent 

Location: Corporate Office- Govandi East, Mumbai

Working Days: Monday to Saturday(2nd and 4th Saturday off, 1st,3rd and 5th Saturday operational)

Department:  Domestic Sales & Marketing


USV is a leading Indian pharmaceutical company with a turnover exceeding 5,000 crore and a strong presence in over 65 countries. Ranked among the top companies in the cardiometabolic space, USV has built a robust portfolio across diabetes and cardiovascular therapies, with leading brands such as Glycomet GP, the Jalra range, Roseday range, Ecosprin range, Udapa range, andTazloc range.

In addition to its leadership in prescription therapies, USV is expanding its footprint in consumer health through its Cosmo-Nutra portfolio. Backed by a workforce of over 7,000 professionals,


Role Objective

The Senior DGM Sales Leadership Capability (L&D) is responsible for designing and driving

a high-impact capability system across the sales hierarchy (Medical Representatives, ABMs,

RBMs, ZBMs, and NBMs). The role focuses on strengthening managerial effectiveness,

coaching quality, and field execution to improve sales productivity and consistency.

The mandate includes building a future-ready sales leadership pipeline, embedding structured on-the-job learning, and enhancing data-driven decision-making and execution discipline across territories. The role partners closely with Sales and Commercial Excellence to ensure that capability interventions directly improve field performance, review effectiveness, and overall business outcomes.


Key Responsibilities


Capability Strategy & Roadmap

Define and drive the Sales Leadership Capability roadmap aligned to field productivity, execution excellence, and managerial effectiveness across MR, ABM, RBM, ZBM, and

NBM levels.

Manager Effectiveness & Coaching Excellence

Strengthen on-ground coaching capability by institutionalizing ICEP as a structured coaching tool and improving the quality of field interactions, feedback, and performance discussions.

Sales Review & Governance (SRS)

Drive adoption and effectiveness of SRS to enhance review rigor, agenda discipline, data usage, and actionable follow-through across managerial levels.

Root Cause & Problem-Solving (RCA)

Embed structured RCA capability across managers to improve decision quality, territory interventions, and performance recovery in weak HQs/regions.

Leadership Development & Pipeline

Lead ASPIRE and CEJx programs with a focus on readiness for next roles and sustained performance across reps and managers.

Future Skills & Capability Building

Drive capability development in coaching, data-driven decision making, AI-assisted planning, and key account management for institutional, channel, and trade teams.

Sales Competency Framework (USV Ahead)

Implement and sustain the sales competency framework,integrating it with hiring, training, performance management,and career progression.

Learning Model & Field Integration

Shift from classroom-led training to structured on-the-job learning (10-20-70), linked to field execution, JFW coaching,and business outcomes.

LMS & Digital Enablement (e-Gurukul)

Use LMS as a performance enablement platform through learning nudges, coaching support, and tracking of capability versus performance outcomes.

Stakeholder Collaboration(Sales-Focused)

Partner with Sales Heads, NBMs, and ZBMs to diagnose capability gaps and drive targeted, performance-linked interventions.

Budget & External Partnerships

Manage L&D investments and external partners with focus on measurable impact on sales capability, productivity, and execution quality.


Stakeholder Interaction

Internal

  • CMO, BU Heads, NBMs, ZBMs, RBMs, ABMs alignment on capability priorities and

performance improvement

  • L&D ecosystem (internal team, content developers, artists/visualizers) design and

delivery of capability interventions

  • HR talent development, pipeline, and integration with performance systems
  • Commercial Excellence (SFE/BI) alignment with dashboards, analytics, and field

execution

  • IT & LMS Support – enablement of platforms, dashboards, and digital learning systems

External

  • Selective vendors – capability programs, tools, and specialized interventions (as required)
  • Industry / capability networks – benchmarking and adoption of best practices

Job Requirements

Professional Experience and Relevant Skills

Experience 15+ years of overall experience, with 8–10 years in sales capability, L&D, or salesforce effectiveness roles within large, distributed sales organizations (FMCG, Consumer, B2B, Tech,or Pharma). Experience in transforming field capability and improving sales productivity is preferred.

Leadership Breadth

Proven track record of building and scaling sales capability systems across multiple managerial layers (frontline to manager of managers). Experience in driving coaching effectiveness, review governance, and performance-led capability interventions.

Strategic Expertise

Strong experience in capability architecture, change management, leadership development, and workforce transformation. Ability to translate business priorities into measurable capability outcomes.

Core Skills

High influence and stakeholder management ability across complex organizational structures.

Strong orientation toward data-driven decision making, problem solving, and driving execution discipline.

Ability to build performance-driven, learning-led cultures.


Academic Qualifications

  • Postgraduate degree (MBA or equivalent) from a reputed institute.
  • Certifications in sales capability, coaching, or learning and development such as CPSL,

CPSP, CISP, Challenger Sales or equivalent programs, Sales Management Association

certifications, ICF or similar coaching credentials, and L&D certifications like

ATD/CPTD are desirable, along with exposure to digital learning platforms, analytics,

and AI-enabled capability systems.

title: Credit Associate
jobDescription:
Location: Pune work from office
Working days: Monday to Saturday
Working hours: 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM
Experience required: 24 years
CTC: 57 lakh, depending on practical skills and experience
Reports to: Head Business Operations


Please check before applying

Apply only if all the following are true:

  • You have 2–4 years of relevant experience in credit, lending, banking, an NBFC, a CA firm, debt advisory or loan operations.
  • You have prepared CMA data and financial projections independently or with limited guidance.
  • You can understand a profit and loss account, balance sheet, GST returns, bank statements and existing loan statements.
  • You are comfortable doing both financial analysis and case coordination.
  • You are willing to work from our Pune office, Monday to Saturday.
  • You are comfortable with occasional visits to bank branches in Pune.
  • The published CTC range of 5–7 lakh broadly matches your expectations.

Please do not apply if:

  • You are a fresher with no relevant practical experience.
  • Your experience is only in sales, telecalling or lead generation.
  • Your experience is limited to bookkeeping, GST filing or income-tax-return filing.
  • You have never prepared or worked on CMA data or financial projections.
  • You are looking for a work-from-home or five-day position.
  • You want a purely desk-based analyst role with no client, accountant or lender coordination.

About Finansh: Finansh is a Pune-based debt-advisory, capital-structuring and credit-intelligence firm. We work with individuals, MSMEs, promoters and renewable-energy businesses. Our work includes working capital, term loans, machinery finance, property-backed lending, HNI home loans and renewable-energy project finance.

Business mandates generally begin at 1 crore, and Finansh works across a network of 18+ lending institutions.


This is an in-house position with direct exposure to the Founder and Head of Business Operations.


About the role

We need a Credit Associate who can understand a borrower’s financial position and also take responsibility for moving the case forward.

This is deliberately a mixed role:

  • Approximately 45% credit analysis and preparation
  • Approximately 40% case execution and coordination
  • Approximately 15% post-disbursement and compliance support

The exact mix will vary depending on the cases being handled.


This role suits someone who wants to understand and own the complete lending process—not only prepare spreadsheets or only follow up for documents.


What you will do

Credit Analysis

  • Analyse audited and provisional financial statements, income-tax returns, GST returns, bank statements, existing loans, CIBIL/credit-bureau reports and repayment history.
  • Prepare CMA data, financial projections, cash-flow statements and loan-repayment calculations.
  • Calculate and understand ratios such as current ratio, debt-equity, TOL/TNW, DSCR and ISCR.
  • Check whether information in financial statements, GST returns, bank statements and loan records is consistent.
  • Identify important discrepancies or missing information before submitting a case to a lender.
  • Prepare borrower summaries, initial credit notes and replies to lender queries.
  • Assist in assessing working-capital, term-loan, machinery-finance, property-backed, renewable-energy and complex self-employed borrower cases.
  • Maintain clear assumptions and supporting sources for financial models.

Case Execution

  • Own assigned cases from document collection through lender submission, sanction conditions and disbursement.
  • Maintain clear document checklists, pending requirements, next steps and target dates.
  • Coordinate with clients, accountants and lender representatives for documents and clarifications.
  • Review files for completeness before internal review or lender submission.
  • Track lender queries, approvals, sanction conditions, documentation and disbursement progress.
  • Support interest-payment follow-ups, lender audits and other assigned post-disbursement requirements.
  • Visit Pune bank branches when a case requires proper coordination, clarification or compliance support.

Routine courier and document-delivery work is not the purpose of this position.


Qualifications and Skills

  • M.Com, MBA Finance, CA or CMA. (Preferred)
  • Strong accounting and financial-statement understanding.
  • Practical Excel skills, including formulas, linked schedules and financial models.
  • Ability to explain financial movements and credit issues clearly.
  • Professional written and spoken English.
  • Working communication ability in Hindi and Marathi.

Growth at Finansh: A strong Credit Associate can progress towards a Senior Credit Associate position and ownership of a defined case portfolio or lending vertical within approximately 18–24 months.


Progression will depend on work quality, judgement, reliability and the ability to handle cases independently.


Selection Process:

1. Initial telephone or video screening.

2. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for one office visit.

3. The office visit will normally include:

    • A practical exercise using sample financial and case information.
    • Discussion of the candidate’s approach.
    • Interviews with the Head of Business Operations and Founder.

4. Reference and background checks will follow for the selected candidate.


Please do not visit the Finansh office without a confirmed interview appointment. Walk-in applications will not be considered.


How to Apply:

Submit your CV together with answers to all the following questions:

  1. How many years of relevant credit or lending experience do you have?
  2. How many CMA or financial-projection assignments have you prepared?
  3. Did you prepare them independently or under supervision?
  4. Which loan products and borrower profiles have you handled?
  5. Have you coordinated any case from application through sanction or disbursement?
  6. Are you comfortable working from the Pune office, Monday to Saturday?
  7. Are you comfortable with occasional Pune branch visits?
  8. What are your current location, current CTC, expected CTC and notice period?

Applications without answers to these questions may not be reviewed.

jobDescription:
Job Description: Risk Manager – Medical Device New Product Development (NPD)

Role: Risk Manager / Product Safety & Risk Management Lead
Experience: 10 to 15+ Years
Domain: Medical Devices / Healthcare Products / Safety-Critical Systems

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Risk Manager to lead and govern end-to-end product risk management activities for Medical Device New Product Development (NPD) programs. The role will be responsible for establishing and executing risk management processes across the entire product lifecycle, ensuring compliance with applicable standards and regulatory requirements.

The ideal candidate should have deep expertise in product safety, hazard analysis, risk assessment, reliability engineering, and cross-functional risk management involving hardware, firmware, software, systems engineering, cybersecurity, usability, manufacturing, and clinical domains.

This role will work closely with Systems Engineering, R&D, V&V, Quality, Regulatory, Clinical, Cybersecurity, Manufacturing, and Program Management teams to ensure safe and compliant product development.

Key Responsibilities

Product Risk Management Leadership

  • Lead end-to-end risk management activities throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Establish and maintain Risk Management Plans aligned with project and regulatory requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with:
    • ISO 14971
    • IEC 62304
    • ISO 13485
    • IEC 60601 Series
    • IEC 62366
    • FDA Safety & Risk Management expectations
  • Define and implement risk management processes, procedures, and templates.

Hazard Identification & Analysis

  • Drive comprehensive hazard identification activities across:
    • Hardware
    • Firmware
    • Software
    • Mechanical Systems
    • Electrical Systems
    • User Interfaces
    • Cybersecurity
    • Manufacturing Processes
  • Facilitate:
    • Hazard Analysis
    • Hazardous Situation Analysis
    • Harm Identification
    • Use Error Analysis
    • System-Level Risk Analysis
  • Establish traceability between hazards, hazardous situations, harms, mitigations, and verification evidence.

Risk Assessment & Evaluation

  • Perform quantitative and qualitative risk assessments.
  • Facilitate severity and probability assessments.
  • Evaluate residual and overall product risks.
  • Conduct benefit-risk analyses where applicable.
  • Support risk acceptance decisions based on organizational criteria.

Must-Have Skills

  • Strong expertise in ISO 14971 Risk Management for Medical Devices
  • Deep understanding of:
    • Safety Engineering
    • Product Risk Management
    • Reliability Engineering
    • Human Factors Engineering
    • Systems Engineering
  • Experience performing:
    • Hazard Analysis
    • Harm Analysis
    • FMEA (DFMEA, PFMEA, SFMEA)
    • Fault Tree Analysis (FTA)
    • Reliability Assessments
    • Risk-Benefit Analysis
  • Experience working with:
    • Hardware Systems
    • Embedded Firmware
    • Software Applications
    • Integrated Medical Device Systems
  • Strong understanding of medical device development lifecycle and design controls.
  • Experience supporting regulatory submissions and audits.
  • Excellent facilitation, stakeholder management, and communication skills.

Experience

  • 10 to 15+ years of experience in medical device product development.
  • 5+ years in Product Risk Management, Safety Engineering, or Reliability Engineering roles.
  • Proven experience in New Product Development (NPD) programs from concept through commercialization.
  • Experience leading cross-functional risk management activities for complex medical devices.

title: Regional Head- Land Acquisition(Rajasthan)
tagsAndSkills: Government Liaison,Land Development,Land Acquisition,Renewable Energy,Land Purchase,Wind Project,Acquisition,Development
jobDescription:
Description:

Reports To: Lead Land Acquisition

1) Job Purpose:

To manage and oversee land acquisition activities for renewable energy projects particularly in the Pathan region. The role involves identifying suitable land parcels, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, and liaising with key stakeholders to facilitate the acquisition process for project development.

2) Key Responsibilities:

Land Identification and Feasibility:

• Identify suitable land parcels for renewable energy projects (wind/solar) in the Pathan region.
• Conduct feasibility analysis to determine the viability of potential land for hybrid (solar/wind) projects.
• Collaborate with internal teams for land survey, assessment, and technical evaluations.

Liaison and Coordination:

• Liaise with government authorities, local farmers, village leaders, sarpanches, talatis, MLAs, and other relevant stakeholders for land acquisition.
• Build relationships with local communities and key influencers to ease negotiations and ensure smooth land acquisition processes.
• Work closely with land brokers, legal teams, and other parties to manage land acquisition-related matters.

Legal Compliance and Documentation:

• Coordinate with legal authorities, land acquisition, and marketing departments to ensure compliance with all statutory and regulatory requirements.
• Facilitate the collection of required documentation from Gram Panchayat offices, Mamlatdar offices, DILR offices, Forest offices, etc.

• Manage the preparation and submission of documents for NOCs, clearances, and approvals from relevant departments, such as forest and mining. 

Site Visits and Surveys:

• Conduct site visits with Circle Officers, Mining Officers, Range Forest Officers, and other officials for location inspections, demarcation, and NOC-related work.
• Oversee all types of survey work, including government wasteland, private land, sathani land, and forest land.
• Familiar with GPS, Total Station, D-GPS, and other surveying tools for accurate land measurement and demarcation.

Stakeholder Engagement and Reporting:

• Regularly report the progress of land acquisition activities, highlighting challenges and suggesting solutions to overcome obstacles.
• Liaise with the marketing department for customer site visits and provide necessary support for client interactions.

Compliance and Risk Management:

• Ensure compliance with legal and statutory requirements for land acquisition.
• Proactively mitigate risks by addressing legal, community, and environmental concerns that could impact project timelines.

3) Key Skills and Competencies:

• Strong experience in land acquisition processes, particularly in the renewable energy sector.
• Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence various stakeholders.
• Good knowledge of land laws, regulations, and statutory compliance.
• Proficiency in GPS-based land surveys and experience using tools like MapSource, Google Earth, and UTM.
• Ability to work independently and manage multiple stakeholders in a fast- paced environment.

4) Qualifications:

• Degree in Land Management, Geography, Law, or related field.
• Minimum of 15 years of experience in land acquisition, with a focus on renewable energy projects.

Company: ASMEP Design & Build Pvt. Ltd.
Department: Electrical Design

Designation :- Graduate Trainee Engineer (Electrical Design)
Industry: Industrial Projects / EPC
Experience: Fresher / 01 Year
Qualification: B.E./B.Tech Electrical Engineering
Location: Navi Mumbai


Job Responsibilities

  • Assist senior engineers in electrical design and engineering for industrial projects.
  • Prepare and update Single Line Diagrams (SLD), electrical layouts and schematic drawings.
  • Assist in electrical load calculations, cable sizing and voltage drop calculations.
  • Prepare load schedules, cable schedules and equipment schedules.
  • Assist in preparation of Electrical BOQ/MTO and material specifications.
  • Design and coordinate layouts for power distribution, lighting, small power, earthing and lightning protection.
  • Develop basic understanding of HT/LT systems, transformers, DG sets, PCC/MCC, motors, VFDs and UPS systems.
  • Coordinate electrical designs with Mechanical, Civil, HVAC and Instrumentation teams.
  • Review drawings and documents as per project requirements and applicable IS/IEC standards.
  • Maintain design calculations, drawings and technical documentation.
  • Incorporate comments and revisions in drawings under the guidance of senior engineers.

Technical Skills

  • Good understanding of basic Electrical Engineering concepts.
  • Knowledge of Electrical Power Distribution and Industrial Electrical Systems.
  • Understanding of SLD, load calculations, cable sizing, voltage drop and protection systems.
  • Basic knowledge of AutoCAD is required.
  • Knowledge of ETAP / EPLAN / DIALux will be an added advantage.
  • Good working knowledge of MS Excel and MS Office.

Candidate Profile

  • B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineering – Fresher.
  • Strong interest in Electrical Design Engineering.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Good technical aptitude and attention to detail.
  • Willingness to learn design software and industrial design practices.
  • Good communication and coordination skills.

Career Opportunity

Opportunity to develop a career in Electrical Design Engineering for Industrial Projects, working on engineering drawings, calculations, design documentation and multidisciplinary project coordination.

title: Full Stack, Backend & Frontend Developer_Trainees
jobDescription:
Full Stack, Backend & Frontend Developer Trainee

Three engineering trainee tracks Frontend, Backend and Full Stack for graduating engineers who have built strong, hands-on projects during their coursework and are ready to turn that into a production career.

Positions


Frontend Developer (Trainee)

Backend Developer (Trainee)

Full Stack Developer (Trainee)

Reporting To


Solution Architect

Location


Hebbal, Bangalore

Work Mode


In-office. No WFH / hybrid. Open only to candidates based in Bangalore.

Programme Structure


3-month paid traineeship full-time absorption on successful completion

Experience


0 years (freshers) — strong academic / graduation project work required


The Trainee Programme

This is a fresher-friendly entry point into Sustainext's tech team, designed for candidates who don't yet have professional work experience but have demonstrated real engineering ability through strong projects completed as part of their graduation curriculum or self-driven builds.

How it works

  • Months 1–3 (Traineeship): You join as a Trainee on a fixed stipend. This period is used for structured onboarding, mentored project work, and a genuine evaluation of fit on live or near-live engineering problems.
  • On successful completion: You are absorbed into a full-time role on the relevant track (Frontend / Backend / Full Stack Developer), with the compensation structure and statutory benefits described under Remuneration & Perks below.
  • Extension/exit: If more time is needed to assess fit, the traineeship may be extended by mutual agreement; if the fit isn't right, the engagement ends at or before the 3-month mark.


Frontend Developer — Trainee


As a Frontend Developer Trainee, you'll work on the interfaces ESG analysts, auditors and enterprise admins use - dashboards, multi-step disclosure workflows, schema-driven forms, and real-time/streaming views into GaiaLM's agentic outputs. You will pair closely with backend engineers and designers to ship production UI, not just static screens.

Must-Have Skills (project, academic, or self-taught experience)

  • React and Next.js (App Router) — building and structuring real applications, not just single-page demos.
  • TypeScript, and ideally exposure to React 19.
  • State management at scale using Redux Toolkit.
  • Tailwind CSS (Tailwind v4 exposure is a plus) for building consistent, responsive UI.
  • Experience building schema-based / dynamically-generated UI (forms or components driven by a data schema rather than hard-coded).
  • Axios interceptor patterns — handling cookie-based JWT injection and 401/403 responses gracefully.
  • TanStack Query (v5 exposure is a plus) for data fetching, caching and server state.
  • Consuming SSE / streaming APIs (e.g., displaying token-by-token or incremental responses from a backend/LLM service).
  • Comfort integrating with an auth-as-a-service provider (e.g., Auth0, Clerk, Firebase Auth, Supabase Auth, or similar).

Good to Have

Experience migrating a codebase from JavaScript to TypeScript.

Charting libraries — Chart.js or Nivo Charts.

Azure Blob Storage integration from the client side.

Client-side generation of .docx / .xlsx files.

Having built a design system or reusable component library from scratch.

Debugging React 19 effect-dependency and callback-identity issues (stale closures, unnecessary re-renders).

What You'll Do

  • Build and ship UI features in React/Next.js against real product requirements, under the guidance of senior engineers.
  • Translate designs and schema definitions into responsive, accessible, cross-browser-compatible interfaces.
  • Integrate frontend components with backend APIs, including authenticated and streaming endpoints.
  • Write clean, typed, testable code and participate in code reviews — as both a recipient and, over time, a reviewer.
  • Debug issues across the stack boundary, from state-management bugs to API integration mismatches.
  • Document your components and decisions for the rest of the team.

Backend Developer — Trainee


As a Backend Developer Trainee, you'll work on the systems that compute, store and serve ESG and carbon data at enterprise scale — deterministic calculation engines, secure multi-tenant APIs, async job pipelines, integrations with client ERPs, and the plumbing behind GaiaLM's retrieval and agentic workflows.

Must-Have Skills (project, academic, or self-taught experience)

  • Python, with hands-on project experience in Django 4.2 and Django REST Framework (async views via adrf are a plus).
  • Authentication with SimpleJWT and/or django-allauth.
  • PostgreSQL — schema design, queries, and working with an ORM.
  • Background job processing with Celery and Celery Beat on Redis.
  • Exposure to Azure-based deployment concepts: containerizing to Azure Container Registry, deploying to App Service, and using Blob/Queue/Table storage; Azure Pipelines for CI/CD is a plus.
  • Server-side report generation — WeasyPrint, docxtpl, or LibreOffice-based document/PDF generation.
  • Awareness of enterprise system integrations (SAP, Salesforce, Xero, or similar ERPs) - understanding how to consume third-party/enterprise APIs.
  • Additionally valuable: Python 3.13, async FastAPI with Pydantic v2, asyncpg or hand-written SQL against Postgres (including Row-Level Security), Docker.
  • Any exposure to production RAG (vector databases, embeddings), LLM API integration and streamed LLM responses, JWT verification, or Redis for caching/rate-limiting is a strong plus for this track.

Good to Have

django-simple-history for audit/versioning; encrypted model fields for sensitive data.

drf-spectacular for API documentation/schema generation.

Familiarity with uv (Python packaging) and pytest-django for testing.

LLM evaluation frameworks/practices.

Continuous integration with GitHub Actions; deployment experience with Railway.

Vector databases such as Qdrant, embedding providers such as Voyage AI, prompt evaluation, or Supabase.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain REST/async APIs that power the Sustainext platform, under senior engineering guidance.
  • Design database schemas and write efficient, correct queries against PostgreSQL.
  • Implement background/async workflows for data processing, report generation and integrations using Celery.
  • Work with authentication, authorization and multi-tenant data isolation correctly and securely.
  • Contribute to deployment pipelines on Azure and support production issue triage.
  • Write automated tests and participate in code review.
  • Progressively pick up FastAPI/async and applied-AI work (RAG, LLM integration) as you grow in the role.

Full Stack Developer — Trainee


As a Full Stack Developer Trainee, you'll work across the entire request lifecycle — from the React/Next.js interface, through authenticated APIs, to the Django/FastAPI backend and PostgreSQL data layer — on features that span both layers. This track suits candidates whose graduation projects genuinely spanned frontend and backend, end to end (e.g., a full web app with its own API and UI, not just one half).

Must-Have Skills — Frontend Layer

  • React and Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
  • State/data fetching fundamentals — Redux Toolkit and/or TanStack Query.
  • Ability to consume authenticated and streaming (SSE) APIs from the client, including handling 401/403 flows via an interceptor pattern.

Must-Have Skills — Backend Layer

  • Python, with project experience in Django + DRF, or FastAPI with Pydantic.
  • PostgreSQL — schema design and querying.
  • Building and securing REST APIs, including JWT-based authentication.
  • Comfort with Git-based workflows and basic cloud deployment concepts (Azure preferred).

Good to Have

Celery/Redis for background jobs; Docker for containerization.

Any exposure to LLM API integration, streaming responses, or RAG pipelines.

Chart.js/Nivo for data visualisation; server-side report generation (WeasyPrint/docxtpl).

Testing frameworks (pytest) and CI pipelines (GitHub Actions/Azure Pipelines).

What You'll Do

  • Own features end-to-end — from UI to API to database — with support from frontend- and backend-focused senior engineers.
  • Build schema-driven UI backed by real APIs you also help design and implement.
  • Debug issues that cross the frontend/backend boundary faster than a single-layer specialist could.
  • Contribute to both codebases' quality — types, tests, code review — and rotate emphasis as the team's needs shift.

- You are not willing to travel and meet customers regularly.

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced Freelance Content Writer with a strong background in the Travel & Tourism industry to create high-quality, engaging, informative, and SEO-friendly content for our travel website.

The ideal candidate should understand the online travel industry and be capable of producing original, well-researched, plagiarism-free content written by the writer and not generated using AI tools.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create high-quality content for travel websites, destination pages, flight-related pages, blogs, landing pages, promotional pages, and other marketing content.
  • Conduct independent research on destinations, airlines, airports, routes, travel requirements, and other travel-related topics.
  • Write SEO-friendly content using appropriate keywords, headings, internal linking opportunities, and search intent.
  • Ensure all content is 100% original, unique, and plagiarism-free.
  • Content submitted must be human-written and not AI-generated.
  • Maintain a natural and engaging writing style while incorporating SEO requirements without keyword stuffing.
  • Fact-check travel-related information before submission.
  • Write compelling page titles, meta titles, meta descriptions, headings, FAQs, and website copy where required.
  • Understand the difference between informational and commercial/search-intent content and write accordingly.
  • Edit and proofread content to ensure excellent grammar, spelling, readability, and consistency.
  • Follow the company's brand tone and content guidelines.
  • Revise content based on editorial or SEO feedback when required.
  • Meet agreed deadlines and maintain consistency in content quality.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Minimum 2 years of professional content writing experience.
  • Previous content writing experience in the Travel & Tourism industry is mandatory.
  • Strong understanding of SEO content writing and on-page SEO fundamentals.
  • Excellent command of written English, grammar, punctuation, and sentence structure.
  • Ability to research and understand travel-related topics independently.
  • Good understanding of airlines, flights, destinations, airports, travel terminology, and the online booking journey.
  • Ability to write content that is informative while also encouraging conversions.
  • Strong proofreading and editing skills.
  • Ability to adapt writing style according to the target audience and market.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to factual accuracy.
  • Ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple content assignments independently.

Content Quality Requirements

All submitted content must be:

  • Original and unique
  • Plagiarism-free
  • Human-written and not AI-generated
  • SEO-friendly
  • Factually accurate and properly researched
  • Grammatically correct
  • Easy to read and engaging
  • Relevant to the intended search query and target audience
  • Written specifically for our brand rather than copied or rewritten from competitor websites.

Preferred Qualities

Candidates with experience writing for OTAs, airlines, flight booking websites, travel agencies, tourism companies, or travel comparison websites will be preferred.

Knowledge of Google search intent, keyword research, content structure, internal linking, EEAT principles, and conversion-focused writing will be an added advantage.

Application Requirements

Interested candidates should share:

  1. A brief introduction and details of relevant experience.
  2. 2–3 samples of travel-related content written personally by the applicant.
  3. Details of previous experience working with travel/OTA websites.
  4. Expected rate per word / per article / per project.
  5. Average content-writing capacity per week.
  6. Availability and typical turnaround time.

title: Compiler Engineer, Programming Language Developer.
tagsAndSkills: Compiler Design,C++,Languages C,LLVM,Compiler Development,Rust,GDB,Abstract Syntax Tree
jobDescription:
About IndianBrand Technology


IndianBrand Technology is a Hyderabad-based technology company building India's complete digital sovereignty stack INDDN (India's own search engine at inddn.in), IndianBrand Browser, IndianBrand OS, and now INK — India's first programming language.


INK is a systems programming language with the speed of C, the simplicity of Python, and the safety of Rust. Every INK file ends in .in — India in every file, in every computer, in every country in the world. This is genuinely historic work — no Indian has ever built a programming language before.


JOB TITLE: Language Engineer — INK

Location : 100% Work From Home — anywhere in India

Employment Type : Part Time / Freelance / Full Time — your choice

Working Hours : Fully flexible — async communication

Experience : 5 to 8 years

Salary : 50,000 – 1,00,000/month based on experience

Joining : Immediate


SPECIAL NOTE

This role is open to everyone — including homemakers, women returning to tech after a career break, researchers, and academics. If you have built a compiler, interpreter, or programming language — in any form, at any scale — we want to talk to you. Career gaps are never a barrier here.


WHAT IS INK

INK is India's first programming language. It is designed to:


  • Write the IndianBrand OS kernel — like C
  • Write web servers and AI models — like Python
  • Be safe by design — no null crashes, no buffer overflows
  • Compile to native machine code via LLVM — ARM64 + x86-64
  • Use .in as the file extension — India in every file worldwide

Tagline: Write the Future

Website: ink-lang.in (coming soon)

GitHub: github.com/IndianBrand/ink


ABOUT THE ROLE

You will be the founding engineer of the INK programming language. You will design and build the compiler from the ground up — lexer, parser, type system, semantic analyser, LLVM code generation, standard library, and build tools. This is a rare opportunity that very few engineers in India — or the world — have ever had.


You will work directly with the founder. Your decisions will shape the language that millions of Indian developers will use for decades.


WHAT YOU WILL BUILD

Phase 1 (Months 1–3)

  • Lexer — tokenises INK source code character by character
  • Parser — builds Abstract Syntax Tree from tokens
  • Basic evaluator — variables, functions, if/else, loops
  • Hello World: ink run hello.in prints Jai Hind!

Phase 2 (Months 3–6)

  • Type system — int, float, text, bool, list, map
  • Type inference — let x = 5 without writing int
  • Custom types — type Person { name: text, age: int }
  • Error handling — or keyword, Result types, Optional ?
  • Collections — list, map, set with built-in operations

Phase 3 (Months 6–9)

  • LLVM backend — compiles INK to native x86-64 machine code
  • ARM64 target — compiles for smartphone chips
  • Basic standard library — io, file, text, math modules
  • ink build produces a real executable binary

Phase 4 (Months 9–12)

  • System mode — @system annotation for OS/kernel development
  • Raw pointer support — ptr[u8](0xB8000) for VGA buffer
  • Manual memory control in system mode
  • Write IndianBrand OS kernel in INK — milestone!

Phase 5 (Year 2)

  • Web standard library — web.route, web.listen, json
  • Database library — db.find, db.save, db.all
  • Self-hosting — INK compiler written in INK itself
  • inkpkg — INK package manager
  • VS Code extension — syntax highlighting and autocomplete

MUST HAVE SKILLS — TECHNICAL

Compiler Theory (Essential)

Lexical analysis — tokenisation, regular expressions, finite automata

Parsing — recursive descent parser, LL(1) grammars, Abstract Syntax Tree

Semantic analysis — type checking, scope analysis, symbol tables

Intermediate representation — IR design, SSA form

Code generation — translating AST/IR to target instructions


Programming Languages (Essential)

C — expert level — the entire INK compiler is written in C first

C++ — strong — needed for LLVM integration

Assembly — x86-64 or ARM64 — understanding of generated code

At least one of: Rust, Go, Haskell, OCaml — functional/systems thinking


Tools & Infrastructure (Essential)

LLVM — understanding of LLVM IR and the LLVM toolchain

GCC/Clang — experience building and working with compilers

GDB — debugging compiled code at assembly level

Git — version control, branching, pull requests

Linux — comfortable on Ubuntu or similar

CMake or Make — build systems


Language Design (Strong Plus)

Type system design — static typing, inference, generics

Memory model design — ownership, lifetimes, automatic management

Standard library design — API design, module systems

Error handling design — Result types, exceptions, propagation

Syntax design — grammar definition, readability principles


NICE TO HAVE SKILLS

Prior programming language implementation — any language, any scale

Rust — memory safety concepts directly applicable to INK

ANTLR or Yacc/Bison — parser generators

OCaml or Haskell — functional languages used by compiler researchers

Language Server Protocol (LSP) — for VS Code extension

WebAssembly (WASM) — future INK compilation target

Operating system internals — INK is used to write IndianBrand OS

Academic background in computer science — PL theory, type theory

Prior open source contributions to compilers (GCC, LLVM, Rust)


MUST HAVE — PERSONAL QUALITIES

Curiosity — you read programming language papers for fun

Patience — building a language takes years, not weeks

Ownership — you treat INK like your own language

Communication — you explain complex things simply

Self-motivated — you work without being told what to do next

Honest — if something will take longer, you say so early

Passion — you genuinely care about building something historic for India


WHAT WE OFFER

80,000 – 3,00,000/month based on experience and commitment

Claude AI Fable-5 Pro subscription — 1,700/month value — provided

100% Work From Home — no commute ever

Fully flexible hours — async communication only

Part time or full time — your choice

Your name in INK language credits — permanent and historic

Direct collaboration with the founder

Equity discussion possible for exceptional candidates

Be the founding engineer of India's first programming language

Career gap is never a barrier — skill is everything


HOW TO APPLY

careers@inddn.in

Subject: Language Engineer — INK — [Your Name]


Please include:


1. GitHub link or any compiler/interpreter you have built — even a toy language counts


2. Answer these 3 questions:

a) What is the difference between a lexer and a parser?

b) What is an Abstract Syntax Tree? Draw one for: let x = 5 + 3

c) What is LLVM and why do programming languages use it?


3. Your preferred commitment — part time hours per day OR full time


4. Any career break details — we understand and welcome returning engineers


Note: Candidates without any compiler, interpreter, or language implementation experience will not be considered — even if they have 10 years of general software development. This role requires very specific skills.


INK — Write the Future

inddn.in | ink-lang.in | Hyderabad, India

Jai Hind!
