About NCR Eduservices

NCR Eduservices Pvt. Ltd. is an education-focused organization providing comprehensive solutions across online tutoring, academic delivery, content development, quality management, and education support services.

We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented HR Recruiter who can manage end-to-end recruitment and contribute to building a strong talent pipeline for our growing organization.


Job Summary

The HR Recruiter will be responsible for managing the complete recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing and screening candidates to interview coordination, selection, offer rollout, and onboarding support.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with recruitment platforms, strong communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple requirements simultaneously in a target-driven environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the end-to-end recruitment process for multiple positions.
  • Source candidates through Naukri, Indeed, LinkedIn, social media, referrals, and other recruitment channels.
  • Screen resumes and conduct initial telephonic interviews to assess candidates based on skills, experience, communication, availability, and salary expectations.
  • Understand hiring requirements and candidate profiles in coordination with hiring managers.
  • Draft, publish, and update Job Descriptions (JDs) across relevant hiring platforms.
  • Schedule interviews and coordinate between candidates, interviewers, and hiring teams.
  • Follow up with candidates throughout the recruitment process and ensure timely feedback.
  • Maintain candidate pipelines, recruitment trackers, databases, and daily hiring reports.
  • Manage salary discussions, candidate negotiations, and offer rollout.
  • Coordinate with selected candidates regarding documentation and joining formalities.
  • Meet recruitment targets and timelines while maintaining quality of hire.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or a related specialization.
  • Strong working knowledge of Naukri, Indeed, LinkedIn, and other recruitment platforms.
  • Experience with end-to-end recruitment and candidate management.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong interviewing and candidate assessment skills.
  • Good negotiation and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong organizational and time-management abilities.
  • Ability to handle multiple vacancies and priorities simultaneously.
  • Proficiency in MS Office, Excel, recruitment trackers, and ATS/recruitment software.
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with the HR and hiring teams.
  • Target-oriented and proactive approach toward recruitment.

Preferred Candidate Profile

  • Prior experience in Education, EdTech, Online Tutoring, BPO, or service-based organizations will be preferred.
  • Candidates comfortable working in a high-volume recruitment environment will be preferred.
  • Strong follow-up skills and ability to maintain candidate engagement.
  • Self-motivated, organized, and result-oriented.
  • Comfortable working in a remote setup with regular coordination through online communication tools.

Best Regards,

title: Kernel Developer
jobDescription:
About the Company


IndianBrand Technology is a Hyderabad-based technology company building India's complete digital sovereignty stack INDDN (India's own search engine), IndianBrand Browser, and IndianBrand Mobile OS — India's first 100% from-scratch mobile operating system. Not based on Android. Not based on Linux. Every byte written in India.


Job Title: Kernel Engineer (Part Time / Freelance)


Location: 100% Work From Home — anywhere in India

Employment Type: Part Time / Freelance / Contract

Working Hours: Flexible — work at your own pace and schedule

Weekly Off: You choose your own days off

Experience: 2–6 years

Salary: 15,000 – 40,000/month based on hours and experience

Joining: Immediate


Special Note


This role is open to everyone — including homemakers, mothers, and women returning to work after a career break. If you have the technical skills, we welcome you. You set your own schedule. You work from home. You contribute to something India will be proud of.


About the Role


We are building IndianBrand Mobile OS — India's first 100% from-scratch operating system. We need a Kernel Engineer who can write bare-metal C code and understand how operating systems work at the lowest level. This is rare, exciting, and genuinely historic work.


Required Skills


  • C Programming (expert level) — you must be comfortable writing C without any standard library
  • x86 or ARM Assembly — basic understanding of Assembly language
  • Operating system fundamentals — memory management, process scheduling, interrupts
  • Linux development environment — comfortable on Ubuntu or similar
  • GDB — debugging compiled code
  • Git — version control

Key Responsibilities


  • Write and improve kernel code in C — memory manager, interrupt handlers, process scheduler
  • Write Assembly code for low-level hardware initialisation
  • Test kernel changes in QEMU virtual machine
  • Document code clearly for the team
  • Collaborate asynchronously with other developers via Git and email
  • Research and implement OS concepts from OSDev Wiki and reference documents

Phase 1 is already complete — bootloader, kernel, VGA driver, keyboard driver, and basic shell all working in QEMU. You will work on Phase 2 (memory manager, interrupts) and beyond.


Nice to Have


  • Rust — for memory-safe kernel components
  • ARM64 experience — for Phase 4 phone hardware port
  • Prior OSDev or embedded systems experience
  • Familiarity with QEMU, Bochs, or other emulators
  • Understanding of device drivers
  • Computer Science degree or equivalent self-taught background

What We Offer


15,000 – 40,000/month based on hours and experience

Claude AI Pro subscription — worth 1,700/month

100% Work From Home — no commute ever

Fully flexible hours — work during school hours, after bedtime, whenever suits you

No fixed office hours — async communication only

Part time — 2 to 4 hours/day is enough

Be part of India's most ambitious OS project

Your name in the IndianBrand OS credits — historic contribution

Direct collaboration with the founder


How to Apply


Send your resume to:

careers@inddn.in

Subject: Kernel Engineer — [Your Name]


Please include:

  • Any OS development projects, GitHub links, or OSDev work
  • Your answer to this one question: What is the purpose of the GDT in x86 protected mode?
  • Your preferred working hours per day
  • Any career break details — we understand and respect career breaks

Note: We evaluate purely on technical skill. Career gaps, location, and schedule flexibility are never a barrier here.

title: Work From Home: HR Recruiter: Female : 5.5 Days Work : Apply Now
jobDescription:
Outpace Consulting is looking for dynamic, confident and result-driven HR Recruiters with experience in recruitment or candidate calling.


This opportunity is ideal for individuals who enjoy interacting with people, are confident on calls, and have the ability to engage, convince and close candidates.


Eligibility & Requirements

  • Graduate in any stream.
  • Minimum 3 months of experience in Recruitment / Candidate Calling.
  • Internship or full-time job experience - both are considered.
  • Strong communication skills in Hindi with basic conversational English.
  • Confident and comfortable with extensive calling and candidate interaction.
  • Good interpersonal, convincing and follow-up skills.
  • Target-oriented and result-driven approach.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Comfortable working with daily calling and hiring targets.
  • Own laptop and stable internet connection are mandatory.

Who Are We Looking For?

  • Enjoys talking to and interacting with people.
  • Has a natural flair for calling and candidate engagement.
  • Can confidently explain opportunities and handle candidate objections.
  • Is proactive, disciplined and self-driven.
  • Can take ownership of assigned hiring requirements.
  • Is comfortable working in a performance-driven environment.
  • Is serious about building a long-term career in recruitment.

Role Overview


As an HR Recruiter, you will manage the recruitment cycle from candidate sourcing and screening to interview coordination, follow-ups, selection and joining closure across multiple hiring requirements.


A. Candidate Sourcing & Screening

  • Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, social media, WhatsApp groups, references and other relevant channels.
  • Understand Job Descriptions and hiring requirements.
  • Screen candidates based on experience, eligibility and role requirements.
  • Assess candidates' communication skills and overall suitability.
  • Build and maintain an active candidate pipeline.

B. Candidate Calling & Engagement

  • Connect with shortlisted candidates through outbound calls.
  • Explain the job profile, salary, location, shifts, eligibility and selection process.
  • Understand candidate expectations and career requirements.
  • Handle basic queries and objections professionally.
  • Generate candidate interest and drive them towards interviews.

C. Interview Coordination & Closure

  • Schedule and coordinate candidate interviews.
  • Maintain regular follow-ups before interviews.
  • Ensure strong interview show-up rates.
  • Track candidate progress through different interview stages.
  • Follow up with selected candidates until joining.
  • Focus on improving selection-to-joining conversion.

D. Candidate Management

  • Build professional relationships with candidates.
  • Keep candidates engaged throughout the recruitment process.
  • Provide timely interview and selection updates.
  • Handle candidate dropouts and follow-up requirements.
  • Maintain an organized pipeline of active candidates.

E. MIS & Performance Reporting


  • Maintain daily recruitment trackers and MIS.
  • Track calls, screenings, lineups, interviews, selections and joinings.
  • Share daily performance updates with the Team Lead.
  • Work towards assigned recruitment targets and KPIs.

Why Join Outpace Consulting?

  • 100% Work From Home flexibility.
  • Performance-driven growth opportunities.
  • Hands-on exposure to live recruitment.
  • Opportunity to work across multiple hiring requirements.
  • Strong exposure to candidate sourcing, calling and closure.
  • Fast-paced and learning-oriented work environment.
  • Opportunity to develop practical recruitment and candidate-management skills.

This Role Is For You If...
You enjoy calling, interacting with people, convincing candidates and achieving hiring targets - and want to build a serious career in recruitment.


How to Apply
Please apply through Naukri.com. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted by our recruitment team.

About Allegis Global Solutions (AGS)

Allegis Global Solutions (AGS), a part of Allegis Group, is a global leader in Managed Services Provider (MSP) and Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO) solutions. AGS partners with organizations worldwide to deliver innovative workforce solutions and help businesses attract, engage, and retain top talent.


Job Summary

We are seeking a confident, customer-focused, and proactive Full Cycle Recruiter to manage end-to-end recruitment activities for client requirements. The ideal candidate will have experience in full-cycle recruiting and be comfortable working closely with candidates, hiring managers, and stakeholders in a fast-paced, client-facing environment.

This role requires strong communication skills, ownership, stakeholder management, and the ability to deliver a high-touch candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle from requisition intake to onboarding follow-up.
  • Partner with Hiring Managers and stakeholders to understand hiring needs and candidate requirements.
  • Source candidates through job portals, internal databases, referrals, social networking platforms, and other sourcing channels.

  • Work in a target-driven environment while maintaining recruitment quality and candidate experience.

Required Qualifications

  • 1 to 2+ years of recruitment experience with exposure to full-cycle recruitment.

The Talent Marketing Digital Experience Specialist will support the management, optimization, and continuous improvement of NTT DATAs digital talent marketing experiences, with a strong focus on the user experience across the careers site and broader candidate journey.
This includes careers site content, CMS updates, landing pages, campaign pages, chatbot and Talent Companion experiences, Alumni community and Candidate Concierge management, SEO/search optimization, analytics, and performance reporting.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining creativity, digital content, user experience, marketing operations, and technology-enabled delivery to create engaging, accessible, and effective candidate experiences. The specialist will help translate NTT DATAs employer brand and talent value proposition into compelling digital experiences that attract, engage, and convert relevant talent.

  • Support the day-to-day management and optimization of NTT DATAs careers site and related digital candidate experience platforms.

  • Use search insights and performance data to identify content gaps and optimization opportunities.
  • Recommend updates to improve visibility, traffic, engagement, and candidate conversion.
Talent Marketing Campaigns and Content Execution

Analytics, Reporting and Continuous Improvement
  • Track and analyze performance across careers site pages, landing pages, campaign pages, chatbot interactions, and candidate journeys.
  • Partner with Talent Analytics team to provide regular insights and recommendations on traffic, candidate engagement, conversion, campaign performance, and content effectiveness.
  • Ensure accurate campaign tracking, attribution, reporting, and analytics across Talent Marketing initiatives.
  • Use data and candidate behavior insights to recommend content, UX, campaign, and SEO improvements.
Stakeholder and Vendor Coordination
  • Work closely with Global Talent Marketing, Talent Acquisition, PC, IT, regional stakeholders, and external vendors to deliver effective digital candidate experiences.
  • Gather stakeholder requirements and translate them into practical digital content, campaign, and experience updates.
  • Coordinate timelines, approvals, feedback, dependencies, and delivery of digital talent marketing assets.
  • Partner with external platform stakeholders where Talent Marketing activity intersects with CRM workflows, recruitment processes, talent communities, candidate nurture activity, or shared candidate journeys.
  • Contribute to a consistent, high-quality, and globally aligned Talent Marketing experience across regions.
Required Skills and Experience
  • Experience in Talent Marketing, Recruitment Marketing, Employer Brand, Digital Marketing, Creative Operations, Campaign Operations, Content Management, or Digital Candidate Experience.
  • Hands-on experience managing digital content through CMS platforms.
  • Strong writing, editing, and content optimization skills, with the ability to create clear and candidate-focused messaging.
  • Understanding of SEO/search optimization principles and how they apply to digital content and candidate attraction.
  • Good understanding of digital user experience principles, including content structure, navigation, accessibility, usability, and conversion-focused candidate journeys.
  • Experience supporting digital campaigns, landing pages, content updates, and candidate engagement journeys.
  • Ability to interpret analytics and turn insights into practical recommendations.
  • Strong attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple content, campaign, and stakeholder requests.
  • Comfortable working with cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-moving environment.
Preferred Skills and Experience
  • Experience with Phenom, chatbot/Talent Companion, recruitment marketing platforms, CRM, marketing automation, or candidate engagement technologies.
  • Experience in a global, matrixed, or technology-driven organization.

  • Experience supporting talent attraction campaigns.
  • Basic understanding of UX writing, accessibility, localization, and content governance.
  • Experience working with external vendors or digital platform partners.
  • Knowledge of talent acquisition processes and candidate behavior across the hiring journey.
Profile of the Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate is a hands-on digital talent marketing specialist who is creative, detail-oriented, data-informed, and comfortable working across content, technology, user experience, and marketing operations. They enjoy improving digital experiences, optimizing content, analyzing performance, and collaborating with stakeholders to deliver high-quality candidate-facing experiences.
They are curious, proactive, and comfortable balancing day-to-day execution with continuous improvement. They understand that strong candidate experiences are built through clear content, intuitive journeys, consistent branding, strong usability, search visibility, and ongoing optimization.

title: Creative Head
jobDescription:
Kyptronix is looking for a Creative Head who can turn business ideas into high-performing creative campaigns.

You will lead the creative direction for Kyptronix and its clients across social media, paid advertising, video, branding, website creatives and marketing campaigns.

This is not only a design-management role.

You will be responsible for building a creative system that consistently produces content that gets attention, generates leads and strengthens brands.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the overall creative direction for Kyptronix and client accounts.
  • Lead graphic designers, video editors, content creators and other creative resources.
  • Develop concepts for Meta Ads, Google Ads, LinkedIn campaigns, Reels, Shorts and social media content.
  • Convert marketing briefs into strong hooks, visual concepts, scripts and campaign ideas.
  • Create and supervise storyboards for video advertisements.
  • Build brand guidelines, visual systems and campaign identities.
  • Work closely with the CEO, marketing team, media buyers, content team and sales team.
  • Review every major creative before publishing or launching campaigns.
  • Analyze competitor advertising and identify creative opportunities.
  • Develop multiple creative angles for A/B testing.
  • Improve creatives based on CTR, CPL, engagement, conversions and campaign data.
  • Maintain consistent quality across multiple client brands.
  • Manage deadlines and creative production schedules.
  • Introduce AI tools and automation into the creative production workflow.
  • Build repeatable SOPs for design, video production, approvals and creative testing.

What We Expect

You should understand the difference between:

A creative that looks good
and
a creative that makes people stop, click and buy.

You should be able to take a simple offer and create multiple campaign angles around:

  • Curiosity
  • Pain points
  • Aspirations
  • Authority
  • Social proof
  • FOMO
  • Problemsolution
  • Comparison
  • Founder-led storytelling
  • Direct-response advertising

Key KPIs

Your performance will be measured through:

  • Creative output per week
  • On-time creative delivery
  • Ad CTR improvement
  • Reduction in creative fatigue
  • CPL/CPA improvement
  • Social media engagement
  • Video retention and hook rate
  • Number of creative concepts tested
  • Client approval rate
  • Creative revision rate
  • Brand consistency
  • Team productivity

Required Skills

  • Strong creative strategy and visual storytelling ability
  • Graphic design fundamentals
  • Video advertising and short-form content understanding
  • Meta Ads creative knowledge
  • Branding and campaign development
  • Copywriting and hook-writing ability
  • Storyboarding
  • Social media trends
  • Creative performance analysis
  • Team leadership
  • Project management
  • Strong communication and presentation skills

Experience with tools such as:

  • Adobe Photoshop
  • Illustrator
  • Premiere Pro
  • After Effects
  • Figma
  • Canva
  • CapCut
  • AI creative tools
  • Generative AI platforms

is preferred.

Ideal Candidate

You may be a strong fit if you:

  • Constantly notice advertisements, campaigns and emerging creative trends.
  • Can generate 10 ideas when others generate one.
  • Understand both branding and performance marketing.
  • Can explain why a creative will work instead of relying only on taste.
  • Can manage designers and editors without micromanaging them.
  • Are comfortable working with multiple industries.
  • Think quickly and execute even faster.
  • Take ownership instead of waiting for detailed instructions.

Experience

Preferred: 35 years in creative strategy, advertising, digital marketing, branding or agency environments.

Previous experience as a:

  • Creative Director
  • Creative Lead
  • Associate Creative Director
  • Senior Visualizer
  • Art Director
  • Content Creative Lead

will be an advantage.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, you should be able to:

  • Establish Kyptronix's creative production system.
  • Improve the overall quality of client and internal campaigns.
  • Build a reliable creative testing framework.
  • Reduce unnecessary revisions.
  • Increase creative production speed.
  • Create campaigns capable of generating measurable business results.
  • Develop a creative team that can execute without depending on the CEO for every idea.

We are not looking for someone who only manages creatives.

We are looking for someone who can build the creative engine behind Kyptronix.

title: Associate Professor - Ophthalmology
jobDescription:
JOB DESCRIPTION


Job Title Associate Professor


Department Ophthalmology


Reporting To Head of the Department / Professor


Location Northeast India


Institution Type Premier 500-bed NABH-Accredited Multi-Super

Speciality Teaching Hospital.


Employment Type Full-Time | Teaching Faculty


Regulatory Framework National Medical Commission (NMC) Compliant


POSITION SUMMARY

The Associate Professor in the Department of Ophthalmology will serve as a senior academic and clinical faculty leader at SMIMS & Central Referral Hospital, Gangtok, Sikkim. The incumbent will be responsible for delivering advanced undergraduate and postgraduate medical education in ophthalmology, providing specialist eye care across OPD, IPD, emergency, and Operation Theatre settings, and contributing meaningfully to research and publication activities. This role demands an accomplished ophthalmologist with strong academic credentials, surgical expertise, and a demonstrable commitment to shaping the next generation of eye care specialists in a NABH-accredited, NMC-compliant teaching hospital environment.


CRITICAL ACCOUNTABILITIES


A. Academic & Teaching Responsibilities

Deliver undergraduate (MBBS) theory lectures, tutorials, and clinical classes in Ophthalmology as per university curriculum requirements.

Conduct postgraduate (MS/DNB) classes, bedside clinics, case presentations, seminars, and journal clubs for PG students and interns.

Participate in ward rounds with PG trainees and interns to develop clinical reasoning and examination skills.

Mentor postgraduate residents in thesis formulation, surgical skills, and research methodology.

Participate in curriculum development, examination setting, and academic assessment processes.

Cover duties of other Associate Professors when required to ensure academic continuity.


B. Clinical & Surgical Responsibilities

Attend and manage Outpatient Department (OPD) patients during assigned slots providing specialist ophthalmology consultation, diagnosis, and management.

Manage inpatients admitted under the unit and attend to inpatient referrals from other departments requiring ophthalmic consultation.

Attend to emergency ophthalmic patients during assigned on-call duties including ocular trauma, acute angle-closure glaucoma, and other ophthalmic emergencies.

Attend scheduled Operation Theatre sessions perform ophthalmic surgical procedures independently and supervise and train postgraduate students in surgical techniques.

Provide specialist ophthalmology services across the full spectrum of OPD, IPD, and emergency ophthalmic care.

Participate in ward rounds and case discussions with junior faculty, residents, and students.

Ensure accurate clinical documentation, NABH protocol compliance, and high standards of patient safety.


C. Research & Publications

Publish a minimum of two research papers in indexed national or international journals as per NMC requirements, with the candidate among the first three authors.

Submit articles and medical commentary to professional media and publications on a regular basis.

Lead or participate in departmental research projects in clinical ophthalmology, surgical outcomes, and ophthalmic sciences.

Guide postgraduate thesis work and support research training of PG residents.


D. Administrative & Other Responsibilities

Assist the Head of Department in departmental administration, academic planning, and resource management.

Participate in NABH accreditation activities, hospital quality improvement committees, and patient safety initiatives.

Engage in Continuing Medical Education (CME), national ophthalmology conferences, and professional development activities.

Undertake any additional duties assigned by the Head of Department or institutional management.


MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS & ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA


Educational Qualifications

MBBS from a recognized medical institution.

Postgraduate degree: MS / DNB / MD in Ophthalmology from a recognized institution, as per NMC regulations.


Teaching Experience (as per NMC Regulations)


Candidates must meet one of the following experience criteria:

(a)(i) Minimum 4 years as Assistant Professor in Ophthalmology at a recognized medical institution; OR minimum 5 years for those directly appointed as Assistant Professor in a Government medical institution; OR

(a)(ii) Specialist Medical Officer of the Armed Forces with at least 5 years post-PG clinical experience in Ophthalmology, of which at least 3 years as Assistant Professor in an Armed Forces teaching hospital; OR

(b) Non-teaching Consultant / Specialist / Medical Officer with a PG medical degree and at least 10 years of experience in a Government hospital of at least 220 beds (must complete Basic Course in Medical Education and Basic Course in Biomedical Research within 2 years of appointment).

Note (Aviation / Marine Medicine): Up to 4 years of experience in Flying Squadrons or Diving/Escape Training Schools counts as equivalent to 2 years of teaching experience for Associate Professor eligibility.


Research & Compliance Requirements

Minimum 2 research publications in indexed journals after becoming Assistant Professor (first three authors).

Completed Basic Course in Biomedical Research from an NMC-designated institution.

Must have undergone (or be willing to undergo) the Basic Course in Medical Education, as Ophthalmology is covered under undergraduate training.

Valid registration with the State Medical Council or National Medical Commission.


SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & COMPETENCIES


Clinical & Surgical Expertise

  • Cataract surgery (phacoemulsification)
  • Glaucoma diagnosis & management
  • Retinal disease management
  • Ophthalmic emergency care
  • Slit-lamp & fundus examination
  • Surgical training & OT supervision

Academic & Research
• UG & PG medical teaching

  • Bedside clinical teaching
  • NMC regulatory compliance
  • Indexed journal publication
  • PG thesis guidance & mentoring
  • Curriculum development

Interpersonal & Soft Skills
• Excellent interpersonal skills

  • Strong verbal & written communication
  • Team leadership & collaboration
  • Organised & detail-oriented
  • Patient-centric approach
  • Adaptability in teaching hospital

Job description


Job Title: Billing Engineer (Civil STP/WTP Projects)


Role Overview

The Billing Engineer is responsible for preparing, verifying, and managing all project billing activities, including client billing, subcontractor billing, and quantity tracking for STP/WTP construction projects. The role ensures accurate measurement, documentation, and timely certification of work completed.


Key Responsibilities


1. Quantity Surveying & Measurement

  • Take off quantities from drawings (civil, structural, piping).
  • Prepare BOQ (Bill of Quantities) and compare with tender quantities.
  • Perform site measurements and maintain measurement records (MB).
  • Track executed quantities vs planned quantities.

2. Client Billing

  • Prepare RA (Running Account) bills as per contract terms.
  • Ensure all supporting documents (measurements, abstracts, drawings) are attached.
  • Coordinate with client/consultant for bill verification and certification.
  • Follow up for approvals and payments.

3. Subcontractor Billing

  • Verify subcontractor/vendor bills based on site measurements.
  • Ensure work completion matches claimed quantities.
  • Process bills as per agreed rates and contract conditions.

4. Rate Analysis & Variations

  • Prepare rate analysis for extra/non-BOQ items.
  • Handle variation orders and additional claims.
  • Maintain records for deviations and scope changes.

5. Documentation & Records

  • Maintain billing registers, measurement sheets, and abstracts.
  • Track billing status, payments received, and outstanding amounts.
  • Maintain proper filing of drawings, approvals, and correspondences.

6. Coordination

  • Coordinate with:
    • Site engineers for measurements
    • Planning team for progress tracking
    • Accounts team for invoice processing
    • Client/consultant for approvals

7. Cost Monitoring

  • Assist in cost control by tracking quantities and billing vs budget.
  • Identify discrepancies between executed work and billed quantities.

Required Skills

  • Strong knowledge of civil drawings and quantity take-off
  • Understanding of STP/WTP components (tanks, pipelines, clarifiers, etc.)
  • Familiarity with IS codes and construction standards
  • Proficiency in: Microsoft Excel, AutoCAD
  • Good analytical and documentation skills
  • Strong communication and coordination ability

Qualifications

  • B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Civil Engineering
  • 5 - 8 years of experience in billing/quantity surveying
  • Experience in STP/WTP or infrastructure projects preferred

title: Manager  Regulatory Coordination and Government Affairs

jobDescription:
Job Description
Manager Regulatory Coordination & Government Affairs
Experience: 57 years
Industry: Pharmaceutical / Healthcare
Function: Government Affairs, Regulatory Compliance & Statutory Coordination
Reporting To: Senior Management / Director
Role Purpose
The Manager Government Affairs & Regulatory Compliance will be responsible for managing the company's interactions with government departments, regulatory authorities, statutory bodies and other relevant institutions.
The role will serve as the central point of coordination for obtaining and maintaining government approvals, licences, registrations, certificates, permissions and other statutory requirements applicable to the company's business.
The position will also be responsible for monitoring changes in applicable laws, regulations, notifications, circulars and government procedures, assessing their impact on the organisation.
Key Responsibilities
1. Government Affairs & External Coordination

  • Manage the company's day-to-day interactions with government authorities on matters relating to licences, approvals, registrations, permissions and statutory requirements.
  • Coordinate with government officials regarding applications, submissions, approvals, inspections, clarifications and other official matters.
  • Follow up with relevant authorities and ensure that pending matters are progressed and closed within the required timelines.
  • Coordinate meetings and discussions with government departments and officials as required.
  • Represent the company before government authorities where duly authorised.
  • Understand government processes and procedures and identify the appropriate channels for progressing company matters.
  • Maintain proper records of government communications, submissions, approvals and other official correspondence.

2. Licence, Registration & Permission Management

  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive Licence & Regulatory Compliance Record covering all applicable licences, registrations, certificates, approvals and permissions.
  • Maintain details including:
    • Licence / registration name
    • Issuing authority
    • Licence / registration number
    • Date of issue
    • Expiry date
    • Renewal requirements
    • Applicable department
    • Responsible person
    • Current status

  • Monitor expiry dates and initiate renewal processes sufficiently in advance.
  • Coordinate with concerned departments, consultants and authorities for timely renewal and modification of licences and registrations.
  • Ensure that changes in company structure, business activities, premises, products or personnel are appropriately reflected in applicable registrations and permissions.
  • Identify any missing or additional approvals required as the company's business activities expand.

3. Regulatory & Legal Monitoring

  • Continuously monitor amendments to applicable laws, regulations, rules, government notifications, circulars, guidelines and procedures.
  • Track regulatory developments relevant to the company's pharmaceutical, commercial, employment, tax, corporate, operational and other activities, as applicable.
  • Maintain a Regulatory Amendment & Update Tracker.
  • Identify changes that may impact the company's operations, licences, processes or obligations.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Regulatory Affairs and external advisors where specialist interpretation is required.

4. Implementation of New Regulatory Requirements

  • Assess the practical impact of new or amended laws and regulations on the company's operations.
  • Identify the departments, processes, licences or activities affected by regulatory changes.
  • Coordinate with concerned departments to ensure that required changes are implemented.

5. Compliance Calendar & Monitoring

  • Develop and maintain a central Government & Regulatory Compliance Calendar.
  • Track all recurring and one-time statutory, regulatory and government requirements.
  • Ensure timely initiation and completion of applications, renewals, filings, submissions and other regulatory activities.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external consultants wherever required.
  • Conduct periodic reviews of upcoming compliance requirements.

6. Government Inspections, Notices & Queries

  • Coordinate with relevant departments in preparation for government inspections, audits and regulatory visits.
  • Coordinate responses to government notices, queries, requests for information and official communications.
  • Ensure that responses are prepared and submitted within prescribed timelines.
  • Maintain records of inspection reports, observations, notices and responses.
  • Track corrective actions arising from inspections and ensure timely closure.
  • Escalate significant observations or regulatory risks to senior management.

7. Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Ensure that relevant government requirements and regulatory developments are communicated to the appropriate teams.
  • Coordinate matters where government approvals or permissions require inputs from multiple departments.
  • Track dependencies and ensure that concerned teams complete their respective actions.
  • Support departments in understanding and implementing applicable government requirements.

Key Deliverables / KPIs

  • Timely renewal of all applicable licences, registrations and permissions.
  • No avoidable expiry or lapse of critical licences and approvals.
  • Accuracy and completeness of the Licence & Regulatory Compliance Register.
  • Timely identification and communication of relevant regulatory amendments.
  • Timely implementation of applicable changes in laws and regulations.
  • Timely closure of government queries, notices and inspection observations.
  • Effective tracking and closure of government-related matters.
  • Timely completion of statutory and regulatory requirements.
  • Reduction in delays in obtaining government approvals and permissions.
  • Regular and accurate reporting of government and regulatory matters to management.

Candidate Profile
Experience

  • 57 years of relevant experience in Government Affairs, Regulatory Compliance, Corporate Affairs, Statutory Compliance or a similar role.
  • Experience in the pharmaceutical / healthcare industry is strongly preferred.
  • Prior experience dealing directly with government departments, regulatory authorities and statutory bodies is essential.
  • Experience managing multiple licences, registrations and government approvals would be an advantage.
  • Experience across multiple countries or jurisdictions would be an added advantage.

Required Skills

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Strong follow-up and execution capabilities.
  • Ability to understand and interpret regulatory notifications and amendments.
  • Strong organisational and documentation skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple government and compliance matters simultaneously.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent attention to detail and deadline management.
  • Ability to work independently and proactively identify upcoming requirements.
  • Ability to communicate regulatory requirements clearly to non-legal and non-regulatory teams.

Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate will be a proactive, execution-oriented Government Affairs and Compliance professional who can independently manage the company's government-related requirements from initiation through completion.
The person should be capable of answering, at any point in time:
What approvals and licences do we need? When do they expire? What renewals or permissions are pending? What has changed in the law? Does the change apply to us? What action is required? Who is responsible for implementing it? Has it actually been implemented?
The role is therefore intended to function as a central control point for Government Affairs and Regulatory Compliance, ensuring that the company remains up to date with government requirements and that applicable regulatory changes are effectively implemented across the organisation.

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Team Leader – Credit Operations to manage and oversee loan origination, processing, and documentation activities. 1. Credit Review & Documentation

  • Review loan applications and supporting documents to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with credit and program guidelines.
  • Collect, validate, and organize borrower documentation such as financial statements, tax returns, ownership records, and insurance papers.

  • Prepare loan files for underwriting submission and closing using standardized checklists and quality control measures.

2. Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and manage a team of loan processing and origination specialists.
  • Set clear performance expectations and ensure consistent delivery of high-quality output.

  • Coordinate with Sales, Underwriting, and Closing teams to address documentation gaps and ensure smooth file progression.
  • Act as a key point of contact for internal stakeholders on credit operations matters.

5. Compliance & Quality Assurance

  • Ensure all loan documentation meets regulatory and internal compliance standards.
  • Stay updated with industry trends, lending laws, and regulatory changes.
  • Partner with compliance teams to maintain adherence to policies and procedures.

6. Reporting & Performance Management

  • Track team performance metrics and prepare reports for senior management.
  • Analyze operational data to identify improvement areas and implement process enhancements.

7. Customer Experience

  • Ensure a seamless borrower experience by addressing queries and resolving issues promptly.
  • Maintain clear and professional communication throughout the loan lifecycle.

8. Systems & Record Management

  • Maintain accurate records, updates, and notes in CRM and Loan Origination Systems (LOS).
  • Ensure proper documentation and audit readiness at all times.

9. Training & Development

  • Conduct onboarding and training sessions for new hires.
  • Drive continuous learning and skill development within the team through coaching and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in U.S Credit Operations, Loan Origination, Processing, and Documentation.
  • Minimum 1 year of experience as a Team Leader (official designation/on papers is mandatory).
  • Willingness to work Night Shifts (US Shift) and Work From Office (WFO).
  • Strong understanding of lending practices, credit policies, and compliance requirements.
  • Proven experience in team leadership and people management.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Key Competencies

  • Attention to Detail
  • Leadership & Team Management
  • Process Improvement Mindset
  • Risk & Compliance Awareness
  • Customer-Centric Approach

Note

The selected candidate will play a critical role in strengthening credit operations, improving process efficiency, and ensuring high-quality loan processing standards at R Systems.

title: Head of sales Banquets
tagsAndSkills: Banquet Sales,Hospitality Sales,Sales and Marketing,Catering Sales,Event Sales,Hotel Sales,Sales,Marketing
jobDescription:
Position : Head of Sales Banquets



Job Purpose

To lead and drive the Banquet Sales function by developing and executing sales strategies, maximizing banquet revenue and profitability, and building strong relationships with corporate clients, wedding planners, event agencies, and key accounts. The role will be responsible for achieving revenue targets and ensuring exceptional client experience from enquiry to event execution.

Key Responsibilities


1. Sales & Revenue Management

  • Develop and implement annual and monthly Banquet Sales strategies to achieve revenue targets.
  • Drive business for weddings, conferences, MICE, corporate events, social functions, gala dinners, and other banqueting events.
  • Identify new business opportunities and develop strategies to increase banquet occupancy and revenue.
  • Monitor sales performance, conversion ratios, average banquet spend, and profitability.
  • Develop pricing and sales strategies in coordination with Revenue Management and the Commercial team.
  • Ensure optimum utilization of banquet venues and maximize revenue during peak and off-peak periods.

2. Business Development

  • Identify and develop new corporate, social, wedding, and institutional accounts.
  • Build strong relationships with corporates, event planners, wedding planners, DMCs, PCOs, travel agents, and key influencers.
  • Conduct regular sales calls, client meetings, property visits, presentations, and site inspections.
  • Generate new leads through networking, referrals, industry events, exhibitions, and other business channels.
  • Maintain strong relationships with existing clients to generate repeat and referral business.

3. Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and motivate the Banquet Sales team to achieve individual and departmental targets.
  • Set clear sales targets, KPIs, and performance objectives for team members.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews and provide coaching and feedback.
  • Ensure effective distribution of leads and enquiries among the sales team.
  • Develop the team's sales skills, negotiation capabilities, and product knowledge.

4. Banquet Enquiry & Conversion

  • Oversee the complete banquet sales cycle from enquiry generation to closure and post-event follow-up.
  • Ensure timely response to enquiries and preparation of proposals, quotations, and contracts.
  • Lead negotiations with high-value and strategic clients.
  • Ensure proper documentation of event requirements, commercial terms, and payment conditions.
  • Track lost business and identify reasons for non-conversion to improve future sales performance.

5. Wedding & MICE Business

  • Drive high-value wedding and social event business through strong networking and market intelligence.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with wedding planners, event agencies, and premium clientele.
  • Identify and pursue MICE opportunities, conferences, product launches, exhibitions, and corporate events.
  • Ensure the hotel is positioned as a preferred venue for large-scale events.

6. Client Relationship Management

  • Maintain strong relationships with key clients and ensure high levels of client satisfaction.
  • Personally handle key accounts and major/high-value events.
  • Conduct post-event feedback and develop opportunities for repeat business.
  • Resolve client concerns professionally in coordination with the Operations team.

7. Coordination with Operations

  • Work closely with Banquets, F&B, Front Office, Finance, Revenue Management, and other departments to ensure seamless event execution.
  • Ensure clear communication of client requirements and commercial commitments to the Operations team.
  • Participate in pre-event meetings for major functions and ensure all commitments are properly communicated.
  • Support the Operations team in managing VIP and high-profile events.

8. Market Intelligence & Competition

  • Monitor competitor hotels, banquet venues, pricing, packages, promotions, and market trends.
  • Conduct regular market mapping to identify potential business segments and new opportunities.
  • Provide recommendations to management on market positioning, pricing, packages, and promotional initiatives.

9. Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare and review daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports.
  • Track banquet pipeline, tentative business, confirmed business, lost business, and conversion ratios.
  • Prepare revenue forecasts and provide regular updates to senior management.
  • Analyze sales performance against targets and implement corrective actions where required.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Banquet revenue achievement
  • Revenue growth and profitability
  • Wedding & social events revenue
  • MICE and corporate event revenue
  • Sales conversion ratio
  • New account acquisition
  • Repeat and referral business
  • Average banquet/event revenue
  • Banquet venue utilization
  • Sales pipeline value
  • Client satisfaction and retention
  • Team productivity and target achievement

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Hotel Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, Sales & Marketing, or a related field.
  • 1015 years of relevant experience in hotel sales, with significant experience in Banquet Sales / Catering Sales / Events / MICE.
  • Prior experience in a luxury hotel, large-scale banquet operation, or reputed hospitality brand is preferred.
  • Strong exposure to wedding, social events, corporate and MICE sales.
  • Proven track record of achieving and exceeding revenue targets.
  • Experience in managing and mentoring a sales team.

title: Fleet Coordinator
jobDescription:
Department: Warehouse & Logistics
Designation: Fleet Coordinator
Reporting To: Warehouse Manager / Operations Head
Location: Ernakulam
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience Required: 3 - 6 Years

1. POSITION SUMMARY

The Fleet Coordinator will be responsible for the end-to-end coordination and administration of the company's warehouse fleet, ensuring maximum vehicle availability, efficient utilization, timely deployment, proper maintenance, driver discipline, statutory compliance, and effective control of fleet-related operating costs.

The position will serve as the central point of coordination between the Warehouse, Drivers, Service Centres, Workshops, Insurance Companies, RTO/Transport Authorities, Vendors, Accounts, and Management.

The Fleet Coordinator is expected to proactively monitor vehicle requirements, plan routes, coordinate drivers, track maintenance and breakdowns, ensure timely renewal of all vehicle-related documents, and maintain accurate fleet records and MIS reports.

The role is critical to ensuring uninterrupted warehouse and delivery operations with minimum vehicle downtime and optimum fleet utilization.

2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

A. Fleet Operations & Vehicle Deployment

  • Manage and coordinate the day-to-day operations of the warehouse fleet.
  • Ensure adequate vehicles are available for warehouse deliveries, transfers, collections, and other operational requirements.
  • Prepare daily vehicle deployment plans based on delivery schedules and business requirements.
  • Allocate appropriate vehicles and drivers according to:
    • Route
    • Delivery quantity
    • Vehicle capacity
    • Distance
    • Delivery priority
    • Vehicle availability
  • Monitor vehicle movement and ensure timely reporting and deployment.
  • Maintain daily records of vehicle utilization and availability.
  • Ensure vehicles are used strictly for authorized company purposes.
  • Arrange replacement vehicles in case of breakdown, servicing, accident, or other operational disruptions.
  • Monitor vehicle downtime and take immediate corrective action to restore availability.

B. Route Planning & Optimization

  • Plan and optimize daily delivery routes to achieve maximum operational efficiency and minimum cost.
  • Consider customer locations, delivery priorities, vehicle capacity, traffic conditions, distance, and delivery timelines while planning routes.
  • Group deliveries geographically wherever practical to reduce unnecessary travel.
  • Minimize:
    • Empty trips
    • Excess kilometres
    • Fuel consumption
    • Vehicle idle time
    • Delivery delays
  • Coordinate with the Warehouse and concerned departments regarding daily dispatch requirements.
  • Monitor actual routes against planned routes.
  • Review unusual route deviations and obtain explanations from drivers.
  • Identify opportunities for route consolidation and operational cost reduction.
  • Maintain route-wise and vehicle-wise kilometre records.

3. DRIVER MANAGEMENT & COORDINATION

  • Act as the primary operational point of contact for all warehouse drivers.
  • Prepare and communicate daily driver schedules and vehicle assignments.
  • Monitor driver attendance, punctuality, availability, and duty allocation.
  • Maintain accurate driver records, including:
    • Driving Licence validity
    • Experience
    • Attendance
    • Leave
    • Vehicle allocation
    • Performance
    • Accident/violation history
  • Ensure drivers report for duty on time and follow assigned routes and schedules.
  • Monitor driver discipline and adherence to company policies.
  • Ensure drivers maintain proper trip sheets, logbooks, and vehicle records.
  • Conduct regular communication with drivers regarding:
    • Route plans
    • Delivery schedules
    • Vehicle condition
    • Safety requirements
    • Traffic restrictions
    • Operational instructions
  • Escalate repeated absenteeism, indiscipline, negligence, unsafe driving, or other driver-related issues to the reporting manager/HR.
  • Coordinate with HR regarding driver attendance, disciplinary matters, leave, and other employee-related issues.

4. VEHICLE MAINTENANCE & SERVICE MANAGEMENT

  • Maintain complete vehicle-wise maintenance and service history.
  • Prepare and monitor preventive maintenance schedules for all vehicles.
  • Ensure timely servicing based on:
    • Manufacturer recommendations
    • Kilo meter intervals
    • Time-based service schedules
    • Vehicle condition
  • Coordinate with authorized service centres, workshops, mechanics, and vendors.
  • Track:
    • Engine service
    • Oil changes
    • Brake maintenance
    • Tyre replacement
    • Battery replacement
    • Electrical repairs
    • AC repairs
    • Suspension work
    • General servicing
  • Ensure preventive maintenance is completed before major failures occur.
  • Monitor recurring vehicle problems and recommend corrective action.
  • Identify vehicles requiring major repairs, refurbishment, or replacement.
  • Verify service completion before releasing vehicles for operational use.
  • Maintain detailed records of repair and maintenance costs.

5. VEHICLE COMPLAINT & BREAKDOWN MANAGEMENT

  • Receive and record all vehicle complaints reported by drivers.
  • Maintain a Vehicle Complaint Register with complaint details, action taken, and closure status.
  • Prioritize complaints based on operational and safety impact.
  • Coordinate immediate assistance during vehicle breakdowns.
  • Arrange:
    • Towing
    • Roadside assistance
    • Emergency repairs
    • Replacement vehicles
    • Workshop support
  • Maintain communication with the driver until the breakdown is resolved.
  • Monitor vehicle repair turnaround time.
  • Ensure minimum operational disruption due to vehicle breakdowns.
  • Investigate repeated breakdowns and identify root causes.
  • Escalate major breakdowns and high-value repair requirements to management.

6. VEHICLE INSPECTION & ROADWORTHINESS

  • Conduct or coordinate periodic physical inspection of company vehicles.
  • Ensure vehicles are maintained in safe and roadworthy condition.
  • Monitor the condition of:
    • Tyres
    • Brakes
    • Lights
    • Battery
    • Engine
    • Steering
    • Suspension
    • Mirrors
    • Safety equipment
  • Ensure vehicles are clean and properly maintained.
  • Ensure essential emergency equipment is available.
  • Immediately withdraw unsafe vehicles from operations until the issue is rectified.
  • Maintain periodic vehicle inspection reports.

7. INSURANCE MANAGEMENT

  • Maintain complete records of insurance policies for all company vehicles.
  • Monitor insurance expiry dates and initiate renewal well in advance.
  • Coordinate with insurance companies, brokers, surveyors, and management for policy renewals.
  • Handle initial coordination of vehicle accident claims.
  • Immediately report accidents to the concerned management and insurance representatives.
  • Coordinate with:
    • Insurance Surveyors
    • Workshops
    • Towing Agencies
    • Police Authorities
    • Insurance Companies
  • Track insurance claims from registration through final settlement.
  • Maintain an Insurance Claim Register.
  • Ensure all claim-related documents are collected and submitted on time.
  • Follow up on pending claims until closure.

8. VEHICLE TAX, PERMIT & STATUTORY COMPLIANCE

The Fleet Coordinator will be responsible for ensuring that all company vehicles remain compliant with applicable statutory requirements.

This includes monitoring:

  • Vehicle Registration Certificate (RC)
  • Motor Insurance
  • Road Tax
  • Permit
  • Fitness Certificate
  • Pollution Under Control (PUC)
  • National/State Permit, wherever applicable
  • FAST Tag requirements
  • Other applicable vehicle-related statutory documents

Responsibilities:

  • Maintain a comprehensive Vehicle Compliance & Renewal Tracker.
  • Monitor expiry dates and renewal due dates.
  • Initiate renewal procedures sufficiently in advance.
  • Coordinate with RTO/Transport Authorities and authorized agents where required.
  • Maintain copies of all renewed documents.
  • Ensure no vehicle is deployed with expired mandatory documents.
  • Immediately escalate any compliance risk to management.

9. FUEL MANAGEMENT

  • Monitor vehicle-wise fuel consumption.
  • Maintain fuel consumption and kilometre records.
  • Compare actual mileage against expected vehicle performance.
  • Identify abnormal fuel consumption or unusual kilometre variations.
  • Monitor fuel expenses and investigate discrepancies.
  • Ensure fuel usage is recorded accurately against the respective vehicle.
  • Prepare monthly fuel consumption analysis.
  • Recommend corrective measures for excessive fuel consumption.

10. ODOMETER & VEHICLE UTILIZATION MONITORING

  • Record opening and closing odometer readings.
  • Verify daily kilometres travelled by each vehicle.
  • Compare planned kilometres with actual kilometres.
  • Investigate excessive or unexplained kilometre variations.
  • Monitor vehicle utilization levels.
  • Identify underutilized and overutilized vehicles.
  • Prepare monthly vehicle utilization reports.
  • Use utilization data to support route planning and fleet optimization.

11. VENDOR & WORKSHOP MANAGEMENT

  • Develop and maintain professional relationships with workshops, service centres, tyre dealers, battery suppliers, towing agencies, and other fleet vendors.
  • Obtain quotations for major repairs wherever required.
  • Compare quotations and recommend cost-effective options.
  • Negotiate service charges and turnaround times wherever possible.
  • Monitor vendor performance and service quality.
  • Verify completed repair work before processing bills.
  • Ensure vendors provide proper job cards, estimates, invoices, and supporting documents.
  • Maintain a vendor performance record.
  • Escalate repeated service quality issues to management.

12. FLEET COST CONTROL

  • Monitor vehicle-wise operating costs.
  • Track:
    • Fuel
    • Repairs
    • Maintenance
    • Tyres
    • Batteries
    • Insurance
    • Tax
    • Permit
    • Towing
    • Service charges
    • Other fleet expenses
  • Prepare vehicle-wise monthly cost analysis.
  • Identify abnormal expenses and cost leakages.
  • Recommend cost-saving measures.
  • Ensure fleet-related expenditure is incurred only with appropriate approvals.
  • Monitor cost per kilometre and other relevant fleet efficiency indicators.

13. ACCIDENT MANAGEMENT

  • Coordinate immediate response to vehicle accidents.
  • Ensure management is informed immediately.
  • Coordinate with police, insurance companies, surveyors, workshops, and towing agencies.
  • Ensure accident reports are prepared and submitted.
  • Maintain an Accident Register.
  • Track accident-related repairs and insurance claims.
  • Review accident patterns and identify recurring causes.
  • Recommend preventive measures to improve driver and vehicle safety.

14. VEHICLE DOCUMENTATION & RECORD MANAGEMENT

Maintain updated records for every vehicle, including:

  • RC Copy
  • Insurance Policy
  • Tax Receipt
  • Permit
  • Fitness Certificate
  • PUC Certificate
  • Service History
  • Repair History
  • Accident History
  • Insurance Claims
  • Odometer Records
  • Fuel Records
  • Driver Allocation
  • Vehicle Inspection Reports
  • Maintenance Expenses
  • Vendor Details

All records must be maintained systematically in both physical and digital formats, wherever applicable.

15. MIS & MANAGEMENT REPORTING

The Fleet Coordinator will prepare and submit regular MIS reports to management.

Daily MIS

  • Vehicle deployment
  • Driver allocation
  • Vehicle availability
  • Breakdown status
  • Vehicle complaints
  • Route/kilometre status

Weekly MIS

  • Maintenance status
  • Pending repairs
  • Vehicle downtime
  • Driver issues
  • Compliance renewal status
  • Accident/claim updates

Monthly MIS

  • Vehicle-wise kilometres
  • Fuel consumption
  • Fuel cost
  • Maintenance cost
  • Vehicle downtime
  • Cost per kilometre
  • Vehicle utilization
  • Insurance status
  • Tax/permit renewal status
  • Accident report
  • Insurance claim status
  • Vehicle-wise total operating cost

16. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COORDINATION

The Fleet Coordinator will closely coordinate with:

  • Warehouse Manager
  • Warehouse Team
  • Logistics Team
  • Sales & Operations Teams
  • Accounts & Finance
  • HR & Administration
  • Procurement
  • Management
  • Drivers
  • Workshops
  • Service Centres
  • Insurance Companies/Brokers
  • Surveyors
  • RTO/Transport Authorities
  • External Vendors

The position requires strong coordination and follow-up skills to ensure smooth fleet operations across all stakeholders.


16. EXPERIENCE

Required Experience: 3-6 Years

Candidates should have relevant experience in Fleet Management, Transport Operations, Logistics, Warehouse Operations, or Vehicle Administration.

Preference will be given to candidates with hands-on experience in:

  • Managing commercial/warehouse vehicles
  • Driver coordination
  • Route planning
  • Vehicle maintenance
  • Breakdown management
  • Insurance claims
  • RTO documentation
  • Vehicle tax and permit renewals
  • Fuel and kilometer monitoring
  • Fleet MIS
  • Vendor/workshop coordination

Front Desk & Guest Relations

  • Register new employees on the biometric attendance system and share weekly updates with the HR department.

Appointment & Meeting Coordination

  • Schedule appointments and meetings for internal teams.
  • Coordinate conference room bookings and ensure meeting rooms are ready before scheduled meetings.

Communication

  • Receive, record, and relay messages accurately and promptly.
  • Monitor and respond to general company email inquiries or route them to the relevant department.

Security & Compliance

  • Monitor visitor access and ensure compliance with company security procedures.
  • Maintain visitor registers and access records.
  • Report any suspicious or unauthorized activities to the concerned authorities.

Record Management

  • Maintain accurate records related to visitors, correspondence, office administration, and reception activities.
  • Ensure all reception-related documentation is updated and filed systematically.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Undergraduate or Graduate in any discipline. Additional certifications in administration or customer service will be an advantage.
  • 2+ years of experience as a Front Desk Executive, Receptionist, Guest Relations Executive, or in a similar customer-facing role.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and customer service orientation.
  • Good organizational and multitasking abilities with attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint).
  • Professional appearance, positive attitude, and pleasant personality.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with discretion.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced real estate environment.

Preferred Candidate Profile

  • Friendly, proactive, and service-oriented personality.
  • Strong coordination and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to handle multiple responsibilities efficiently.

Position: Accounts Manager
Location: India

Qualification: B.Com/M.Com/MBA


About the Role


Our Client is looking for a dynamic and detail-oriented Accounts Manager to support its finance function from India while closely collaborating with the finance and leadership teams in the United States. The ideal candidate should have a strong background in manufacturing accounting, coupled with a sound understanding of US accounting principles (US GAAP). This role requires excellent financial acumen, analytical skills, and the ability to work in a global business environment.


Key Responsibilities


  • Manage the complete accounting cycle in compliance with US GAAP and company policies.

  • Oversee General Ledger, journal entries, account reconciliations, accruals, and month-end/year-end closing.
  • Monitor manufacturing costs, inventory valuation, standard costing, BOM costing, overhead allocation, and variance analysis.

  • Partner with manufacturing, procurement, supply chain, and operations teams to ensure accurate financial reporting.

  • Experience working with US-based stakeholders or multinational manufacturing companies will be highly preferred.
  • Proficiency in ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, or similar manufacturing ERP platforms.
  • Excellent skills in Microsoft Excel, financial modelling, and MIS reporting.

Preferred Experience
